records.context: **The annotation work list is diversified by default, and that costs something.** With ``diversity='well'`` the ranked extracted image regions are dealt round-robin across microplate sample positions: position 1 is still the single most uncertain extracted image region, but position 2 is the most uncertain extracted image region in a *different* well, which may be materially less uncertain than the runner-up overall. You give up some per-item uncertainty to stop the annotator labelling the same ambiguity a hundred times — the failure mode of pure uncertainty sampling, where the top 100 extracted image regions routinely come from two microplate sample positions. If ``limit`` is smaller than the number of microplate sample positions, the annotation work list will contain roughly one extracted image region from each of ``limit`` microplate sample positions and none from the rest. Pass ``diversity='none'`` for the pure order, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` for other strata, or ``group_columns=[…]`` for your own — including a cluster id you computed from features, which is the more thorough diversification this trades away for not needing a feature matrix.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.build_queue#3
records.source: **The queue is diversified by default, and that costs something.** With ``diversity='well'`` the ranked crops are dealt round-robin across wells: position 1 is still the single most uncertain crop, but position 2 is the most uncertain crop in a *different* well, which may be materially less uncertain than the runner-up overall. You give up some per-item uncertainty to stop the annotator labelling the same ambiguity a hundred times — the failure mode of pure uncertainty sampling, where the top 100 crops routinely come from two wells. If ``limit`` is smaller than the number of wells, the queue will contain roughly one crop from each of ``limit`` wells and none from the rest. Pass ``diversity='none'`` for the pure order, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` for other strata, or ``group_columns=[…]`` for your own — including a cluster id you computed from features, which is the more thorough diversification this trades away for not needing a feature matrix.
records.translation: **목표 작업 목록은 기본적으로 다양하고, 그것은 무언가를 지불합니다.** ``diversity='well'`` 등급 추출 이미지 영역은 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에 걸쳐 라운드 로빈을 다루고있다 : 위치 1은 여전히 가장 불확실한 추출 이미지 영역이지만 위치 2는 *다른* 잘 추출 된 이미지 지역이지만, 실행자 전체보다 물질적으로 덜 확실 할 수 있습니다. ``limit``은 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치의 수보다 작다면, 어노테이션 작업 목록에는 ``limit`` 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 각각에서 추출 된 이미지 영역과 나머지 영역에서 하나가 포함됩니다. ``diversity='none'`` 순 순서, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` 다른 층, 또는 ``group_columns=[…]`` 자신의 - 특징에서 계산 한 클러스터 ID를 포함하여, 이것은 더 철저한 다양화 이 거래는 특징 매트릭스를 필요로하지 않기 때문에.

Rows where only one of them committed are counted and reported separately as ``n_abstained``. Treating them as disagreements would silently deflate κ in proportion to how far behind the slower annotator is — which is a property of the calendar, not of the annotation.
records.translation: **이 표시되지 않은 세포는 거절이 아니라 분쟁입니다.** 각 쌍은 *both*의 라인에 표시됩니다 (쌍으로 완전한 사례). 그 중 하나만 헌신하는 라인은 ``n_abstained``으로 계산되고 별도로 보고됩니다. 그들을 갈등으로 취급하면 조용히 κ을 얼마나 느린 어노테이션이 뒤에 있는지에 비례하여 흐르게 될 것입니다.이것은 어노테이션의 것이 아니라 일정의 속성입니다.

records.context: **κ has no value when there is no variance.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ). If both annotators put every compared row in the same single class, pₑ = 1 and the denominator vanishes: the answer is *undefined*, not 1.0. If just one annotator used a single class, pₑ collapses onto the other's marginal and κ is identically 0 no matter how well they agree. Both cases return ``nan`` with an explanation attached, because on a screen where 98 % of cells are negative they are the *normal* case, and a returned 0.0 or 1.0 there would misstate the agreement.
records.label: spacr.agreement#7
records.source: **κ has no value when there is no variance.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ). If both annotators put every compared row in the same single class, pₑ = 1 and the denominator vanishes: the answer is *undefined*, not 1.0. If just one annotator used a single class, pₑ collapses onto the other's marginal and κ is identically 0 no matter how well they agree. Both cases return ``nan`` with an explanation attached, because on a screen where 98 % of cells are negative they are the *normal* case, and a returned 0.0 or 1.0 there would misstate the agreement.
records.translation: **κ 변수가 없을 때 가치가 없습니다.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ 만일 두 명의 어노테이터가 각각의 비교 순서를 동일한 클래스에 배치한다면, pₑ = 1 및 명칭이 사라집니다 : 대답은 *불확실성*1.0.만 한 명의 어노테이션이 단일 클래스를 사용하는 경우, pₑ 다른 사람의 경계선에 붕괴하고, κ 동일하다 0 그들이 얼마나 잘 동의하든 상관없이. ``nan`` 왜냐하면 화면에서 98 %의 세포가 부정적이기 때문에 설명이 붙어 있기 때문입니다. *정상적인* 경우, 그리고 반환 0.0 또는 1.0 거기에 계약을 의심 할 것입니다.

records.context: **Raw agreement is reported next to κ, always.** 95 % agreement with κ ≈ 0 is the prevalence paradox (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), not a broken annotator: when one class dominates, chance agreement is already almost as high as the observed agreement, so κ has almost no room left.
records.label: spacr.agreement#8
records.source: **Raw agreement is reported next to κ, always.** 95 % agreement with κ ≈ 0 is the prevalence paradox (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), not a broken annotator: when one class dominates, chance agreement is already almost as high as the observed agreement, so κ has almost no room left.
records.translation: **Raw 합의는 확실히 κ, 항상.** 95 % 합의와 κ ≈ 0은 빈도 모순입니다 (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), 깨진 어노테이션이 아닙니다 : 한 클래스가 지배 할 때, 기회 합의가 이미 관찰 된 합의만큼 거의 높으므로 κ는 거의 공간이 없습니다.

records.context: **Offsets are solved globally, never accumulated.** Chaining microscope image field-to-microscope image field shifts along a row of a 10x10 grid adds every pairwise error together, so the last microscope image field lands tens of pixels out with nothing in the output saying so. Instead every overlapping neighbour pair contributes one equation ``p_j - p_i = d_ij`` and the whole set is solved at once as a weighted least-squares problem over the pair graph (see :func:`solve_positions`). Redundant edges — the diagonal neighbours of a grid, the ``i``/``i+2`` pairs of a heavily-overlapped row — then *cancel* error instead of compounding it, and each microscope image field gets a **residual**: how far its solved position sits from what its own pairs asked for. A large residual is the signal that a microscope image field did not register, and it is written into the table rather than averaged away.
records.label: spacr.align#7
records.source: **Offsets are solved globally, never accumulated.** Chaining tile-to-tile shifts along a row of a 10x10 grid adds every pairwise error together, so the last tile lands tens of pixels out with nothing in the output saying so. Instead every overlapping neighbour pair contributes one equation ``p_j - p_i = d_ij`` and the whole set is solved at once as a weighted least-squares problem over the pair graph (see :func:`solve_positions`). Redundant edges — the diagonal neighbours of a grid, the ``i``/``i+2`` pairs of a heavily-overlapped row — then *cancel* error instead of compounding it, and each tile gets a **residual**: how far its solved position sits from what its own pairs asked for. A large residual is the signal that a tile did not register, and it is written into the table rather than averaged away.
records.translation: **오프 세트는 전 세계적으로 해결되며 결코 축적되지 않습니다.** 체인 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드-마이크로 스코프 이미지 필드 움직임은 10x10 네트워크의 일련을 따라 각 쌍의 오류가 함께 추가됩니다., 그래서 마지막 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드는 출력에서 아무것도 말하지 않고 수십 개의 픽셀을 떨어 뜨립니다. 대신 각 커플 이웃은 ``p_j - p_i = d_ij``의 한 방정식에 기여하고 전체 세트는 커플 차트 ( :func:`solve_positions` 참조) 위의 가중치 최소 평방 문제로 한 번에 해결됩니다. Redundant 가장자리 - 네트워크의 다이아고널 이웃, ``i``/``i+2`` 쌍의 가중치로 과장 된 순서 - 다음 *해지* 오류 대신 그것을 결합, 각 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드는 **구재** : 얼마나 멀리 그것의 해결 된 위치는 그것의 자신의 쌍이 요구하는 것에서 앉아.

records.context: lay ``grid`` out **once per microplate sample position** instead of once across the whole folder. A grid is a property of the acquisition and the acquisition is per microplate sample position — the same microscope field of view pattern is repeated in every microplate sample position — so a folder holding two microplate sample positions imaged 2x2 is two 2x2 grids, not one 2x4. With this off, such a folder was refused with "grid 2x2 has room for 4 microscope image fields but 8 were found", and ``grid=None`` inferred a single 2x4 that laid each microplate sample position out as a 1x4 strip and put its vertical neighbours outside the overlap. :func:`align_folder` passes its own ``group_by_well`` setting through.
records.label: spacr.align.scan_tiles#10
records.source: lay ``grid`` out **once per well** instead of once across the whole folder. A grid is a property of the acquisition and the acquisition is per well — the same field pattern is repeated in every well — so a folder holding two wells imaged 2x2 is two 2x2 grids, not one 2x4. With this off, such a folder was refused with "grid 2x2 has room for 4 tiles but 8 were found", and ``grid=None`` inferred a single 2x4 that laid each well out as a 1x4 strip and put its vertical neighbours outside the overlap. :func:`align_folder` passes its own ``group_by_well`` setting through.
records.translation: ``grid``을 **once로 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치** 대신 전체 폴더에 한 번 배치합니다. 네트워크는 인수의 속성이며, 인수는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에 따라 이루어집니다 - 같은 마이클로스코프 필드 시각 패턴은 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에서 반복됩니다 - 그래서 2x2로 묘사 된 두 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 보유 한 폴더는 하나가 아닌 2x4로 두 개의 2 x2 네트워드입니다. 이와 함께, 그러한 폴더는 "그리드 2x2는 4 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드를위한 공간이 있지만 8 발견되었다"로 거부되었으며, ``grid=None``은 각 마크로 플레이트 샘플을 1x4 스트립으로 배치 한 단 하나의 2x4를 결론 내렸고, 그것의 수직 이웃을 위장 밖으로 놓았습니다. :func:`align_folder`은 자신의 ``group_by_well`` 설정을 통과합니다.

records.context: Each edge ``(i, j, dy, dx, w)`` contributes one weighted equation ``p_j - p_i = (dy, dx)``; each tile contributes one weak equation ``p_i = nominal_i``. Minimising the whole residual at once is what stops error accumulating.

records.context: The canvas is never an in-RAM array. The output file is created at full size up front (so a disk that cannot hold it fails immediately, not at 90%), then filled band by band; the only heap allocations are the band's float32 accumulator, its weight image layer, and one microscope image field window. All three are bounded by ``max_buffer_bytes`` and none of them scales with the canvas.
records.label: spacr.align.write_stack#1
records.source: The canvas is never an in-RAM array. The output file is created at full size up front (so a disk that cannot hold it fails immediately, not at 90%), then filled band by band; the only heap allocations are the band's float32 accumulator, its weight plane, and one tile window. All three are bounded by ``max_buffer_bytes`` and none of them scales with the canvas.
records.translation: 캔버스는 결코 in-RAM 아레이가 아닙니다. 출력 파일은 전면에 완전한 크기로 만들어집니다 (그래서 그것을 잡을 수없는 디스크가 즉시 실패하지 않고 90 %에), 그 다음 밴드에 의해 채워집니다; 유일한 헤프 할당은 밴드의 float32 배터리, 가중치 이미지 레이어, 그리고 하나의 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드 창입니다. 이 세 가지 모두 ``max_buffer_bytes``로 묶여 있으며, 그 중 어느 것도 캔버스와 함께 확장되지 않습니다.

records.context: Seams are **feathered**: each microscope image field's contribution is weighted by a linear ramp that rises from the microscope image field edge inward over :attr:`AlignPlan.feather` pixels, and the band is divided by the total weight. A hard cut would leave a straight, high-contrast edge exactly where two microscope fields of view meet — and a straight edge is the single most reliable thing a downstream segmentation will find and call an object boundary. Feathering costs one extra float32 image layer per band and makes the join a gradient instead. ``blend='average'`` weights every contributor equally and ``blend='none'`` is last-writer-wins, both kept mainly so the difference can be measured.
records.label: spacr.align.write_stack#2
records.source: Seams are **feathered**: each tile's contribution is weighted by a linear ramp that rises from the tile edge inward over :attr:`AlignPlan.feather` pixels, and the band is divided by the total weight. A hard cut would leave a straight, high-contrast edge exactly where two fields meet — and a straight edge is the single most reliable thing a downstream segmentation will find and call an object boundary. Feathering costs one extra float32 plane per band and makes the join a gradient instead. ``blend='average'`` weights every contributor equally and ``blend='none'`` is last-writer-wins, both kept mainly so the difference can be measured.
records.translation: Seams **feathered** : 각 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드의 기여는 :attr:`AlignPlan.feather` 픽셀에 미리 미리 모음 필드 옆에서 상승하는 라인 램프에 의해 가중치가되고, 밴드는 전체 가중치에 의해 분할됩니다. 단단한 절단은 정확히 두 마이코프 시야 필드가 만나는 곳에 직선, 높은 대조 옆을 떠날 것입니다 - 그리고 직선 옆은 가장 신뢰할 수있는 것 하나입니다. 아래 흐름 분할이 발견하고 개체의 경계를 호출합니다. Feathering 비용은 추가 플로트32 이미지 레이어 각 밴드와 그 대신 그룹을 그라디언트로 만듭니다. ``blend='average'`` 가중치 각 기여자 동등하고 ``blend='none'`` 마지막 작가, 두 가지 주로 차이 측정 될 수 있습니다.

records.context: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` drop any feature column containing a NaN. On a real database it often removes every ``pathogen_*`` column, because those columns are NaN for cells without a pathogen. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` drop any object row containing a NaN. Usually removes almost everything, for the same reason; offered because on a single-object-type export it is often exactly right. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Both write a ``layers['missing']`` boolean mask of the same shape by default, so imputed values can be told apart from measured ones; the boolean mask costs 1 byte per cell against 4 for the default ``float32`` ``X``.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#15
records.source: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` drop any feature column containing a NaN. On a real database it often removes every ``pathogen_*`` column, because those columns are NaN for cells without a pathogen. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` drop any object row containing a NaN. Usually removes almost everything, for the same reason; offered because on a single-object-type export it is often exactly right. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Both write a ``layers['missing']`` boolean mask of the same shape by default, so imputed values can be told apart from measured ones; the boolean mask costs 1 byte per cell against 4 for the default ``float32`` ``X``.
records.translation: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` NaN을 포함하는 모든 특징 열을 떨어 뜨립니다. 실제 데이터베이스에서 그것은 종종 각 ``pathogen_*`` 열을 제거하기 때문에이 열은 병원체가없는 세포에 NaN입니다. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` NaN을 포함하는 모든 개체 라인을 떨어 뜨립니다. 일반적으로 같은 이유로 거의 모든 것을 제거합니다. 왜냐하면 단일 개체 유형의 수출에서 그것은 종종 정확히 옳기 때문입니다. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` 부동산 둘 다 기본적으로 동일한 모양의 ``layers['missing']`` 볼레안 마스크를 작성하여 측정된 값과는 달리 말할 수 있습니다. 바울 마스크는 기본 ``float32`` ``X``에 대 한 세포 당 1 바이트 비용을 지불합니다.

records.context: AnnData stores NaN values, but ``sc.pp.scale``, ``sc.pp.pca``, ``sc.pp.neighbors`` and most of scvi-tools either propagate NaN across the whole matrix or raise. Every policy therefore reports the missing values it found. Filling with zero is not the default because in spaCR a NaN usually carries meaning: a ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it, a Zernike column is NaN when mahotas was not installed, and a correlation column is NaN when one channel was flat. Zero-filling the first turns "no pathogen" into "a pathogen of zero size" and puts it into the same distribution as a measured one.

records.context: **A cell is not a homogeneous population.** 43 errors spread evenly over 20 microplate sample positions is a model problem. 43 errors *all from well A01* is a staining problem, and re-labelling any of them is wasted work — the fix is upstream, at the bench. :func:`breakdown_by` and :func:`describe_breakdown` are that check, made before anyone opens a single extracted image region.

records.source: **A cell is not a homogeneous population.** 43 errors spread evenly over 20 wells is a model problem. 43 errors *all from well A01* is a staining problem, and re-labelling any of them is wasted work — the fix is upstream, at the bench. :func:`breakdown_by` and :func:`describe_breakdown` are that check, made before anyone opens a single crop.
records.translation: **세포는 동일한 인구가 아닙니다.** 43 오류가 20 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 평등하게 확산하는 것은 모델 문제입니다. 43 실수 *좋은 A01*에서 모든 것은 염색 문제이며, 그 중 하나를 다시 표시하는 것은 낭비 된 작업입니다. :func:`breakdown_by` 및 :func:`describe_breakdown`는 벤치에서 업 스트림입니다.

records.context: If all 43 errors come from well A01, re-labelling them does not address the cause, which is more likely a staining or focus problem in that well; the text states this concentration so it is seen before re-annotation.

records.source: This used to be a private ``^([A-Pa-p])[ _\-]?(\d{1,2})$`` with an extra ``1 <= column <= 24`` check, so ``Q01`` (row 17) and ``A25`` (column 25) — both perfectly good wells of the 1536-plate the heatmap already draws — came back None and were *renamed* to the next free synthetic address. :func:`spacr.schema.parse_well` is now the parser, and :func:`spacr.schema.plate_format_for` decides whether the position it produced is a well that exists.
records.translation: 이것은 일반적으로 개인적인 것이었다. ``^([A-Pa-p])[ _\-]?(\d{1,2})$`` 또 하나의 추가로 ``1 <= column <= 24`` 확인해 보세요~ ``Q01`` (로 17) 그리고 ``A25`` (열 25) - 이미 끌고있는 1536 실험실 마이크로 플레이트의 완벽하게 좋은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 모두 돌아 왔습니다. None 그리고 그들은 *다시 이름* 다음 무료 합성 주소로 이동합니다. :func:`spacr.schema.parse_well` 지금은 파트너가 되고, 그리고 :func:`spacr.schema.plate_format_for` 그것이 생산하는 위치가 존재하는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치인지 여부를 결정합니다.

records.source: Built from :data:`spacr.schema.PLATE_FORMATS` and rendered by :func:`spacr.schema.well_id`, so a 1536-well plate's rows past ``Z`` come out ``AA``…``AF`` and its columns run to 48. This module used to carry its own ``'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP'`` and ``range(1, 25)``, which is exactly why it could not name a well on a plate bigger than 384.

records.context: Three conventions apply.  image data channel numbers are zero-based and diameters are pixels, so values copied from one magnification are not portable without conversion.  The default v1 mask workflow preserves the directory layout expected by downstream tools; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` is opt-in and writes a different streaming layout.  Finally, removing UMAP cluster noise also removes those objects from the returned frame, keeping the table and the visible embedding aligned rather than silently returning different samples.
records.label: spacr.core#11
records.source: Three conventions apply.  Channel numbers are zero-based and diameters are pixels, so values copied from one magnification are not portable without conversion.  The default v1 mask pipeline preserves the directory layout expected by downstream tools; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` is opt-in and writes a different streaming layout.  Finally, removing UMAP cluster noise also removes those objects from the returned frame, keeping the table and the visible embedding aligned rather than silently returning different samples.
records.translation: 세 개의 컨벤션이 적용됩니다. 이미지 데이터 채널 번호는 0 기반이며 직경은 픽셀이므로 하나의 확대에서 복사 된 값은 변환없이 전송되지 않습니다. 기본 v1 마스크 작업 흐름은 아래 스트림 도구에 의해 예상되는 디렉토리 배열을 유지합니다. ``pipeline_style='v2'``는 opt-in 및 다른 스트림 배치를 작성합니다. 마지막으로, UMAP 클러스터 소음을 제거하는 것은 또한 반환 된 프레임에서 그 개체를 제거하고 테이블과 눈에 띄는 임베딩을 조정하는 대신 조용히 다른 샘플을 반환합니다.

records.context: This landing page currently serves two spaCR tiles.  **Mask** runs :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` to turn raw multichannel acquisitions into preprocessed arrays and Cellpose masks for cells, nuclei, pathogens, and organelles.  **Image UMAP** runs :func:`generate_image_umap` to reduce measured single-object features, cluster them, and optionally place representative extracted image regions on the embedding.  The same module also exposes the timelapse-mask entry point; the two main workflows remain independent, and UMAP does not segment images.
records.label: spacr.core#2
records.source: This landing page currently serves two spaCR tiles.  **Mask** runs :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` to turn raw multichannel acquisitions into preprocessed arrays and Cellpose masks for cells, nuclei, pathogens, and organelles.  **Image UMAP** runs :func:`generate_image_umap` to reduce measured single-object features, cluster them, and optionally place representative image crops on the embedding.  The same module also exposes the timelapse-mask entry point; the two main workflows remain independent, and UMAP does not segment images.
records.translation: 이 착륙 페이지는 현재 두 개의 spaCR 타일을 제공합니다. **마스크**는 :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` 원료 멀티 채널 획득을 사전 처리 뿌리와 Cellpose 세포, 핵, 병원체 및 유기체를위한 마스크로 바꾸기 위해 실행됩니다. **Image UMAP**는 측정 된 단일 개체 특징을 줄이기 위해 :func:`generate_image_umap`를 실행하고, 그들을 클러스터하고, 선택적으로 임베딩에 대표적인 추출 된 이미지 영역을 배치합니다. 같은 모듈은 또한 타임 랩스 마스크 입구 지점을 노출합니다. 두 주요 작업 흐름은 독립적이며, UMAP는 이미지를 분할하지 않습니다.

records.context: Image UMAP needs an existing ``measurements/measurements.db`` for every source, the object tables and features to include, and reduction/clustering settings. It embeds numeric measurements rather than raw pixels.  Thumbnail images come from the measured ``png_list`` table when ``crop_source='png'`` or are cut from ``merged/*.npy`` on demand when ``crop_source='merged'``; the latter is useful when measurement extracted image regions were not saved.
records.label: spacr.core#5
records.source: Image UMAP needs an existing ``measurements/measurements.db`` for every source, the object tables and features to include, and reduction/clustering settings. It embeds numeric measurements rather than raw pixels.  Thumbnail images come from the measured ``png_list`` table when ``crop_source='png'`` or are cut from ``merged/*.npy`` on demand when ``crop_source='merged'``; the latter is useful when measurement crops were not saved.
records.translation: Image UMAP 존재하는 것을 필요로 한다. ``measurements/measurements.db`` 각 출처의 경우, 개체 테이블 및 특징을 포함하고, 감소 / 클러스터 설정.그것은 원료 픽셀 대신 숫자 측정을 포함합니다. ``png_list`` 테이블 언제 ``crop_source='png'`` 아니면 끊어져서 ``merged/*.npy`` 요청에 따라 언제 ``crop_source='merged'``마지막은 측정에서 추출 된 이미지 영역이 저장되지 않았을 때 유용합니다.

records.context: A normal Mask run writes preprocessed stacks, object masks, overlays and segmentation-QC artifacts, settings CSVs, counts in ``measurements.db``, and a run manifest beneath the source tree; it normally returns ``None``.  A dry run instead returns its preflight problem list.  Timelapse mask generation also writes movies and masks relabelled with track identities.
records.label: spacr.core#7
records.source: A normal Mask run writes preprocessed stacks, object masks, overlays and segmentation-QC artifacts, settings CSVs, counts in ``measurements.db``, and a run manifest beneath the source tree; it normally returns ``None``.  A dry run instead returns its preflight problem list.  Timelapse mask generation also writes movies and masks relabelled with track identities.
records.translation: 정상 마스크 실행은 사전 처리 된 스택, 개체 마스크, 위장 및 분할-QC 유물, 설정을 CSVs, ``measurements.db``로 계산하고 출처 나무 아래에서 실행을 나타냅니다; 그것은 일반적으로 ``None``로 돌아갑니다. 대신 건조한 실행이 그것의 사전 빛 문제 목록을 반환합니다. Timelapse 마스크 세대는 또한 트랙 정체성으로 재설정 된 영화와 마스크를 작성합니다.

records.context: Image UMAP returns an annotated DataFrame containing the two-dimensional coordinates and ``cluster`` labels, or a Matplotlib figure when ``return_fig=True``.  Depending on the save and plotting settings, it also writes the embedding, cluster views, representative-extracted image region grids, feature summaries, and the resolved settings alongside the project.
records.label: spacr.core#8
records.source: Image UMAP returns an annotated DataFrame containing the two-dimensional coordinates and ``cluster`` labels, or a Matplotlib figure when ``return_fig=True``.  Depending on the save and plotting settings, it also writes the embedding, cluster views, representative-crop grids, feature summaries, and the resolved settings alongside the project.
records.translation: Image UMAP는 2 차원 코디네이트와 ``cluster`` 라벨을 포함하는 DataFrame를 반환하거나 ``return_fig=True``에서 Matplotlib 숫자를 반환합니다. 저장 및 임베딩 설정에 따라, 그것은 또한 프로젝트 옆에 삽축, 클러스터 보기, 대표적으로 추출 된 이미지 지역 네트워크, 특징 요약 및 해결 된 설정을 작성합니다.

records.context: Reduce per-object features and plot the resulting 2-D embedding.
records.label: spacr.core.generate_image_umap#0
records.source: Reduce per-object features and plot the resulting 2-D embedding.

records.source: Reads measurements from the SQLite backend(s), applies preprocessing and dimensionality reduction, clusters the embedding, and renders scatter/grid plots of the resulting clusters.
records.translation: SQLite 후반(s)에서 측정을 읽고, 사전 처리 및 차원성 감소를 적용하고, 임베딩을 클러스터하고, 결과 클러스터의 분산/그리드 플러스를 던집니다.

records.context: The thumbnails overlaid on the embedding come from whichever extracted-image-region source ``crop_source`` names: ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever an extracted image region folder exists) reads the pre-generated PNGs, ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no folder) cuts each one out of ``merged/*.npy`` on demand through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so the embedding can be drawn on a project that never kept an extracted image region folder — ``png_list`` is not required in that case. Either way the pixels arrive through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so a legacy (pre-341f446) extracted-image-region folder is image data channel-corrected on load and the montage shows the same image the Annotate application view does.
records.label: spacr.core.generate_image_umap#2
records.source: The thumbnails overlaid on the embedding come from whichever crop source ``crop_source`` names: ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever a crop folder exists) reads the pre-generated PNGs, ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no folder) cuts each one out of ``merged/*.npy`` on demand through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so the embedding can be drawn on a project that never kept a crop folder — ``png_list`` is not required in that case. Either way the pixels arrive through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so a legacy (pre-341f446) crop folder is channel-corrected on load and the montage shows the same image the Annotate screen does.
records.translation: 임베딩에 놓인 작은 것들은 누구나 추출된 - 이미지 - 지역 출처에서 나온다. ``crop_source`` 이름 : ``'png'`` (그리고 ``'auto'`` 어디서나 추출된 이미지 지역 폴더가 존재하는 곳)는 사전 생성된 PNGs, ``'merged'`` (그리고 ``'auto'`` 각각 빼앗기지 않으므로 각각의 ``merged/*.npy`` 수요를 통해서 :mod:`spacr.crops`, 그래서 임베딩은 결코 추출 된 이미지 지역 폴더를 유지하지 않은 프로젝트에 인쇄 될 수 있습니다 - ``png_list`` 이 경우에는 필요하지 않습니다.어쨌든 픽셀이 통과하는 방법 :mod:`spacr.crops`, 그래서 유산 (pre-341f446) 추출 이미지-지역 폴더는 이미지 데이터 채널-로드에 수정하고 조립은 Annotate 응용 프로그램 보기와 동일한 이미지를 보여줍니다.

records.context: DataFrame of the input rows plus a ``cluster`` column, or a Matplotlib ``Figure`` when ``return_fig`` is True. With ``remove_cluster_noise`` the noise objects are dropped from the frame as well as from the embedding, so the two always describe the same objects.
records.label: spacr.core.generate_image_umap#5
records.source: DataFrame of the input rows plus a ``cluster`` column, or a Matplotlib ``Figure`` when ``return_fig`` is True. With ``remove_cluster_noise`` the noise objects are dropped from the frame as well as from the embedding, so the two always describe the same objects.
records.translation: 입력 라인의 DataFrame 플러스 ``cluster`` 열, 또는 Matplotlib ``Figure`` ``return_fig`` True 때. ``remove_cluster_noise``의 경우 소음 물체는 프레임과 임베딩에서 떨어져 있으므로 두 개는 항상 동일한 물체를 설명합니다.

records.context: when ``resnet_features`` is set; embedding raw extracted image regions with ResNet features is not implemented.
records.label: spacr.core.generate_image_umap#7
records.source: when ``resnet_features`` is set; embedding raw crops with ResNet features is not implemented.
records.translation: ``resnet_features``이 설정되면 ResNet 특징을 사용하여 원료 추출 된 이미지 영역을 임베딩하지 않습니다.

records.context: Given a source folder ``src`` of multi-image data channel images, this workflow (1) optionally consolidates inputs from nested folders, (2) renames files to the Yokogawa layout used downstream, (3) preprocesses per-image data channel arrays, (4) generates masks for cell / nucleus / pathogen / organelle image data channels via Cellpose (SAM variant), (5) optionally reconciles the cell mask against nuclei + pathogen overlays, and (6) writes overlay plots and a ``gen_mask_settings.csv`` next to the outputs.
records.label: spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks#1
records.source: Given a source folder ``src`` of multi-channel images, this pipeline (1) optionally consolidates inputs from nested folders, (2) renames files to the Yokogawa layout used downstream, (3) preprocesses per-channel arrays, (4) generates masks for cell / nucleus / pathogen / organelle channels via Cellpose (SAM variant), (5) optionally reconciles the cell mask against nuclei + pathogen overlays, and (6) writes overlay plots and a ``gen_mask_settings.csv`` next to the outputs.
records.translation: 다중 이미지 데이터 채널 이미지의 출처 폴더 ``src``를 고려하여,이 작업 흐름 (1) 선택적으로 둥근 폴드에서 입력을 통합, (2) 다운로드 스트리밍에 사용 된 Yokogawa 레이아웃에 파일을 재명, (3) 사전 프로세스 매일 이미지 채널 라인, (4) Cellpose (SAM 변형)를 통해 세포 / 핵 / 병원체 / 유기 이미지 데이터를위한 마스크를 생성, (5) 선택적으로 핵 + 병원체 과잉에 대한 세포 마스크와 합의, 그리고 (6) 출력 옆에 과잉 플로트와 ``gen_mask_settings.csv``를 작성합니다.

records.context: ``adjust_cells`` — reconcile cell masks against nuclei+pathogen.
records.label: spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks#10
records.source: ``adjust_cells`` — reconcile cell masks against nuclei+pathogen.
records.translation: ``adjust_cells`` - 핵 + 병원체에 대한 조화 세포 마스크.

The pre-SAM ``toxo_pv_lumen`` / ``toxo_cyto`` names are gone and resolve to ``cpsam``; a path to a fine-tuned checkpoint is used, and a path that does not exist stops the run instead of falling back to stock weights.
records.label: spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks#7
records.source: ``pathogen_model`` — path to a Cellpose-SAM checkpoint to segment pathogens with, instead of stock ``cpsam``. The pre-SAM ``toxo_pv_lumen`` / ``toxo_cyto`` names are gone and resolve to ``cpsam``; a path to a fine-tuned checkpoint is used, and a path that does not exist stops the run instead of falling back to stock weights.
records.translation: ``pathogen_model`` - Cellpose-SAM 체크 포인트로의 경로는 주식 ``cpsam`` 대신 병원체를 분할합니다. SAM ``toxo_pv_lumen`` / ``toxo_cyto`` 이름은 사라지고 ``cpsam``로 해결됩니다.

records.context: The number of extracted image regions is capped by default. Sixty thousand extracted image regions of 96x96x3 take 1.6 GB before embedding, which can exhaust memory on a machine that could embed the first two thousand. :attr:`CropQuery.limit` therefore has a non-zero default, and the plan states what was left out -- "the first 2,000 of 61,433".
records.label: spacr.crop_loader#6
records.source: The number of crops is capped by default. Sixty thousand crops of 96x96x3 take 1.6 GB before embedding, which can exhaust memory on a machine that could embed the first two thousand. :attr:`CropQuery.limit` therefore has a non-zero default, and the plan states what was left out -- "the first 2,000 of 61,433".
records.translation: 추출 된 이미지 영역의 수는 기본적으로 캡처됩니다. 96x96x3의 수십만 개의 추출된 이미지 지역은 임베딩하기 전에 1.6 GB를 취할 수 있으며, 이는 첫 번째 2 천 개를 흡수 할 수있는 기계에서 메모리를 낭비 할 수 있습니다. :attr:`CropQuery.limit` 따라서 제로가 아닌 기본을 가지고 있으며, 계획은 "61,433의 첫 번째 2,000"이 남아있는 것을 나타냅니다.

records.context: The extracted-image-region source has two main values, named as in the other spaCR panels: load images and stream images. Training previously used its own terms (``pre_generated`` / ``on_demand``) for the same choice, so the annotation and training panels presented one setting under two sets of names.
records.label: spacr.crop_source#1
records.source: The crop source has two main values, named as in the other spaCR panels: LOAD IMAGES and STREAM IMAGES. Training previously used its own terms (``pre_generated`` / ``on_demand``) for the same choice, so the annotation and training panels presented one setting under two sets of names.
records.translation: 추출 이미지-지역 소스는 다른 spaCR 패널에서 이름으로 두 가지 주요 값을 가지고있다 : 로드 이미지 및 스트림 이미지. 훈련 이전에 같은 선택을 위해 자신의 용어 (``pre_generated`` / ``on_demand``)를 사용하여, 그래서 어노테이션 및 교육 패널은 이름의 두 세트 아래에 하나의 설정을 제시했다.

records.context: **Why streaming exists.** Pre-cutting every extracted image region writes a copy of the dataset to disk before a single epoch runs, and every change of extracted image region size or channel selection writes another. Cutting as training processing sessions costs a slice per object and no disk at all.
records.label: spacr.crop_source#4
records.source: **Why streaming exists.** Pre-cutting every crop writes a copy of the dataset to disk before a single epoch runs, and every change of crop size or channel selection writes another. Cutting as training runs costs a slice per object and no disk at all.
records.translation: **스트리밍이 존재하는 이유.** 사전 절단 각 추출 된 이미지 지역은 하나의 에포크가 실행되기 전에 데이터 세트에서 디스크에 복사본을 작성하고 추출된 이미지 지역 크기 또는 채널 선택의 모든 변경 사항은 다른 것을 작성합니다.

records.context: Two independent tests are applied: the object type, as a substring of the path (e.g. ``cell_png``), and the file format, as the extension. Keeping them separate allows selections such as "every nucleus extracted image region, any format" or "every TIFF, any object".
records.label: spacr.crop_source.matches_path#1
records.source: Two independent tests are applied: the object type, as a substring of the path (e.g. ``cell_png``), and the file format, as the extension. Keeping them separate allows selections such as "every nucleus crop, any format" or "every TIFF, any object".
records.translation: 두 개의 독립적 인 테스트가 적용됩니다 : 개체 유형, 경로의 기초 (예 ``cell_png``), 그리고 파일 형식, 확장으로. 그들을 분리 유지하는 것은 "모든 핵 추출 이미지 지역, 어떤 형식"또는 "어떤 TIFF, 어떤 개체"와 같은 선택을 허용합니다.

records.context: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` writes a per-object PNG for every object it measures (``<root>/data/.../{cell,nucleus,pathogen,cytoplasm}_png/``) and records the paths in the ``png_list`` table of ``measurements/measurements.db``. Every downstream consumer -- the annotation GUIs, the classification datasets, the image UMAP -- reads those PNGs. That costs disk, has to be regenerated whenever an extracted image region setting changes, and goes stale silently.
records.label: spacr.crops#2
records.source: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` writes a per-object PNG for every object it measures (``<root>/data/.../{cell,nucleus,pathogen,cytoplasm}_png/``) and records the paths in the ``png_list`` table of ``measurements/measurements.db``. Every downstream consumer -- the annotation GUIs, the classification datasets, the image UMAP -- reads those PNGs. That costs disk, has to be regenerated whenever a crop setting changes, and goes stale silently.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` 개체에 대해 글을 쓴다. PNG 각각의 개체를 측정하기 위해서(``<root>/data/.../{cell,nucleus,pathogen,cytoplasm}_png/``(그리고 그 길을 기록하는 것) ``png_list`` 테이블의 ``measurements/measurements.db``모든 하단 스트림 소비자 - 어노테이션 GUIs, 분류 데이터 세트, 이미지 UMAP 그들은 그들을 읽는다. PNGs 이 비용 디스크, 추출 된 이미지 지역 설정 변경을 할 때마다 재생되어야하고, 조용히 멈추게됩니다.

records.context: The intensity image data channels come first (the subset selected by ``settings['channels']`` at preprocessing time), then one ``uint16`` label-mask image layer per segmented object class, always in the order **cell, nucleus, pathogen, organelle** -- each present only if that class was segmented. ``settings['cell_mask_dim']`` / ``nucleus_mask_dim`` / ``pathogen_mask_dim`` / ``organelle_mask_dim`` record the resulting image layer indices; spaCR's default four-image data channel layout is ``{cell: 4, nucleus: 5, pathogen: 6, organelle: 7}`` (:data:`DEFAULT_MASK_DIMS`).

records.source: The intensity channels come first (the subset selected by ``settings['channels']`` at preprocessing time), then one ``uint16`` label-mask plane per segmented object class, always in the order **cell, nucleus, pathogen, organelle** -- each present only if that class was segmented. ``settings['cell_mask_dim']`` / ``nucleus_mask_dim`` / ``pathogen_mask_dim`` / ``organelle_mask_dim`` record the resulting plane indices; spaCR's default four-channel layout is ``{cell: 4, nucleus: 5, pathogen: 6, organelle: 7}`` (:data:`DEFAULT_MASK_DIMS`).

records.context: **A corrected dataset must be distinguishable from a raw one.** A hand-edited mask is otherwise indistinguishable from a segmented one, and it is later impossible to say which microscope fields of view were edited, by whom, or what they looked like before. Every correction here therefore goes through :class:`CurationLog`: an append-only ledger, written beside the artefact it describes, recording what changed, when, and to what. Every correction made through the supported edit methods leaves an entry. The public layer and table objects remain accessible to views and advanced callers; mutating those objects directly bypasses this provenance guarantee.

records.context: Under the shipped rollback journal that combination starves the writer. A reader holds SHARED for the length of its statement, and a writer cannot COMMIT until every SHARED lock is gone, so with enough workers there is almost always someone reading and the committing worker waits out its busy timeout and raises "database is locked" -- usually surfacing on the next process's ``has_table``, which is the statement in the reporter's traceback.

records.source: Under the shipped rollback journal that combination starves the writer. A reader holds SHARED for the length of its statement, and a writer cannot COMMIT until every SHARED lock is gone, so with enough workers there is almost always someone reading and the committing worker waits out its busy timeout and raises "database is locked" -- usually surfacing on the next process's ``has_table``, which is the statement in the reporter's traceback.
records.translation: 한 독자는 그의 발언의 길이에 대해 공유하고, 작가는 모든 공유 잠금이 사라질 때까지 COMMIT 할 수 없습니다, 그래서 충분한 워커와 거의 항상 누군가가 읽고, 헌신하는 워커는 그의 바쁜 시간을 기다리고 "database is locked" - 일반적으로 다음 과정의 ``has_table``에 나타납니다, 이는 기자의 트래픽에있는 발언입니다.

records.context: spaCR's other two routes from image to numbers both depend on prior choices. The measured panel in :mod:`spacr.measure` computes a fixed, hand-designed set -- intensity, shape, texture, distances -- so it captures only named properties. The supervised path in :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr` fine-tunes a backbone against annotations, so it captures only annotated classes. A phenotype with no corresponding column or annotation (for example a subtle vacuole mislocalisation) is not detected by either route.
records.label: spacr.embeddings#1
records.source: spaCR's other two routes from image to numbers both depend on prior choices. The measured panel in :mod:`spacr.measure` computes a fixed, hand-designed set -- intensity, shape, texture, distances -- so it captures only named properties. The supervised path in :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr` fine-tunes a backbone against annotations, so it captures only annotated classes. A phenotype with no corresponding column or annotation (for example a subtle vacuole mislocalisation) is not detected by either route.
records.translation: spaCR의 다른 두 경로는 이미지에서 숫자로 둘 다 이전 선택에 따라 달라집니다. :mod:`spacr.measure`의 측정 패널은 고정된, 수동으로 설계된 세트를 계산합니다 - 강도, 모양, 구조, 거리 - 그래서 그것은 단지 명칭 된 속성을 캡처합니다. :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr`의 감독 된 경로는 어노테이션에 대 한 뒷줄을 촬영하므로 그것은 오직 기록 된 클래스를 촬영합니다. 일치하는 열이나 기록이없는 현상 (예를 들어, 미묘한 액포 오류)은 어떤 경로에서도 발견되지 않습니다.

records.label: spacr.embeddings#3
records.source: Per-channel, then concatenate (:data:`CHANNEL_PER_CHANNEL`, the default). Each channel is encoded on its own and the vectors are joined. Channel identity is preserved: dimension 517 belongs to channel 2 only, so :mod:`spacr.attribution_columns` can report which stain a hit came from and a reader can drop a channel without re-embedding. Costs N forward passes.
records.translation: 매 이미지 데이터 채널, 그 다음 concatenate (:data:`CHANNEL_PER_CHANNEL`, 기본). 각 이미지 데이터채널은 자체로 암호화되고 벡터가 연결됩니다. 이미지 데이터 채널 정체성은 보존됩니다 : 차원 517은 이미지 정보 채널 2에만 속하므로 :mod:`spacr.attribution_columns`는 어떤 히트가 나왔는지 보고 할 수 있으며, 독자는 다시 임베딩하지 않고 이미지 데이터 채너를 떨어 뜨릴 수 있습니다.

records.context: spaCR processes batches — 384 microplate sample positions, thousands of microscope fields of view, dozens of image files. A single unreadable image must not abort the laboratory microplate, so almost every batch loop in the codebase wraps its body in ``try/except Exception`` and carries on. The historical problem was not the surviving; it was that the survival left no trace: forty microplate sample positions would fail to segment, forty lines would scroll past in a log nobody was watching, ``measurements.db`` would be written anyway, and every downstream regression would silently run on 344 microplate sample positions while reporting as if it had 384.
records.label: spacr.errors#1
records.source: spaCR processes batches — 384 wells, thousands of fields, dozens of image files. A single unreadable image must not abort the plate, so almost every batch loop in the codebase wraps its body in ``try/except Exception`` and carries on. The historical problem was not the surviving; it was that the survival left no trace: forty wells would fail to segment, forty lines would scroll past in a log nobody was watching, ``measurements.db`` would be written anyway, and every downstream regression would silently run on 344 wells while reporting as if it had 384.
records.translation: spaCR 프로세스 패치 - 384 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치, 수천 마이클로스코프 시야, 수십 개의 이미지 파일. 단일 읽을 수없는 이미지는 실험실 마이크를 낙태해서는 안되므로 코드베이스의 거의 모든 패치 루프는 ``try/except Exception``에서 자신의 몸을 빼앗아 가고 계속됩니다. 역사적인 문제는 생존자가 아니었다; 그것은 생존이 흔적을 남기지 않았다는 것입니다 : 네 개의 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치가 세그먼트에 실패 할 것입니다, 40 라인은 아무도 관찰하지 않는 로고에서 지나갈 것입니다, ``measurements.db``는 어쨌든 쓰여질 것입니다, 그리고 아래의 각 흐름의 회복은 344 마이크로 플레이트 위치를 보고하는 동안 조용히 실행 할 것입니다.

records.context: **Unit of replication.** spaCR measures thousands of cells across a handful of microplate sample positions. Testing across cells when the replicate is the microplate sample position is pseudoreplication and can return p < 1e-10 on pure noise, because n is inflated about a thousandfold. Every result states what n counted, and :func:`compare` takes a ``unit`` so a caller can aggregate first.
records.label: spacr.figures.stats#5
records.source: **Unit of replication.** spaCR measures thousands of cells across a handful of wells. Testing across cells when the replicate is the well is pseudoreplication and can return p < 1e-10 on pure noise, because n is inflated about a thousandfold. Every result states what n counted, and :func:`compare` takes a ``unit`` so a caller can aggregate first.
records.translation: **복제 단위.** spaCR는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 통해 수천 개의 세포를 측정합니다. 복제 된 경우 셀을 통해 테스트하는 것은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치는 pseudoreplication이며 p < 1e-10을 순수한 소음으로 반환 할 수 있기 때문에 n은 약 천 번 팽창합니다. 각 결과는 n가 계산 한 것을 나타내고 :func:`compare`는 ``unit``를 가져 가서 호출자가 먼저 집합 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: a frame whose columns use the CANONICAL identity names -- what :func:`read_identity` returns, having aliased them on the way out. Membership is tested exactly and case-sensitively, with no alias lookup: a raw ``SELECT *`` from a database that spells them ``plate`` and ``row`` contributes none of the microplate sample position structured-data names, and such a frame yields ``["object_label"]`` alone. That is why nothing merges on the result of this function without putting it through :func:`require_full_identity` first -- an object label is unique only WITHIN a microscope field of view, so merging on it alone collides objects across laboratory microplates, microplate sample positions and microscope fields of view. Only column names are inspected; no values are touched.

records.source: a frame whose columns use the CANONICAL identity names -- what :func:`read_identity` returns, having aliased them on the way out. Membership is tested exactly and case-sensitively, with no alias lookup: a raw ``SELECT *`` from a database that spells them ``plate`` and ``row`` contributes none of the well keys, and such a frame yields ``["object_label"]`` alone. That is why nothing merges on the result of this function without putting it through :func:`require_full_identity` first -- an object label is unique only WITHIN a field, so merging on it alone collides objects across plates, wells and fields. Only column names are inspected; no values are touched.
records.translation: 캐논 식별 이름을 사용하는 열을 가진 프레임 - 무엇 :func:`read_identity` 멤버십은 정확하고 사례 민감하게 테스트되며, 알래스 검색이 없습니다 : 원료 ``SELECT *`` 그들을 묘사하는 데이터베이스에서 ``plate`` 그리고 ``row`` 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 구조 데이터 이름의 어느 것도 기여하지 않으며, 그러한 프레임 결과 ``["object_label"]`` 그러므로 아무것도 이 기능의 결과에 융합하지 않고 그것을 통과하지 않는다. :func:`require_full_identity` 첫째 - 개체 라벨은 현미경 시야 필드와 함께만 독특하므로, 그것에 혼자 융합하면 실험실 마이크로 플레이트, 샘플 마이크를 통해 개체가 충돌하고 미생물을 시야를 통해 오직 이름만 검사됩니다. 가치가 영향을받지 않는다.

records.context: This is a merge onto the canonical structured-data names rather than a substitution for them because the canonical tables carry things a foreign table cannot reproduce: every spaCR feature column, and ``cell_id``, the link from a nucleus or pathogen back to the cell that contains it. records.source: This is a merge onto the canonical keys rather than a substitution for them because the canonical tables carry things a foreign table cannot reproduce: every spaCR feature column, and ``cell_id``, the link from a nucleus or pathogen back to the cell that contains it. Replacing the table would drop both, and a parent-child link is not recoverable from what is left. ``conversion_map`` gets the same treatment — merged on the output filename, never replaced — so a project's provenance back to its own original files survives an import into it.
records.translation: 이것은 캐논 구조 데이터 이름 대신 그들을 대체하기 때문에 캐논 테이블은 물건을 운반하는 외국 표는 복제 할 수 없습니다 : 각 spaCR 함수 열, 그리고 ``cell_id``, 핵 또는 병원체에서 다시 그것을 포함하는 세포에 대한 링크. 대체 테이브는 둘 다 떨어질 것입니다, 그리고 부모-어린이 연결은 남아있는 것에서 회복되지 않습니다. ``conversion_map`` 같은 치료를 얻습니다 - 출력 파일 이름에 합쳐, 결코 대체되지 않습니다 - 그래서 프로젝트의 출처는 자신의 원본 파일에 다시 수입 생존합니다.

records.context: Their measurement rows have to line up with the objects in their masks. The structured-data name is ``(field, object label)``: an ``image_key`` column that says which image a row belongs to, and a ``label_key`` column holding the integer label of the object in that image's mask. Both are stated in the plan, and both are *verified* against the label images before anything is written — :class:`JoinReport` counts the rows that resolve to no microscope field of view, the rows whose label is in no mask, and the mask objects that no row measures. Unmatched rows are counted and reported rather than dropped by an inner join.
records.label: spacr.foreign#19
records.source: Their measurement rows have to line up with the objects in their masks. The key is ``(field, object label)``: an ``image_key`` column that says which image a row belongs to, and a ``label_key`` column holding the integer label of the object in that image's mask. Both are stated in the plan, and both are *verified* against the label images before anything is written — :class:`JoinReport` counts the rows that resolve to no field, the rows whose label is in no mask, and the mask objects that no row measures. Unmatched rows are counted and reported rather than dropped by an inner join.
records.translation: 그들의 측정 라인은 그들의 마스크에있는 개체와 일치해야합니다. 구조화 된 데이터 이름은 ``(field, object label)``입니다 : ``image_key`` 컬럼은 어떤 그림 라인이 속하는지 말하고, 그 이미지의 마스크에서 개체의 전체 라인을 보유 ``label_key`` 컬러. 둘 다 계획에 표시되며, 둘 다 *검증* 라인 이미지에 대 한 무엇이든 작성되기 전에 - :class:`JoinReport` 라인을 계산하는 것은 현미경 시야 필드에 해결되지 않습니다, 라인에 표시되지 않습니다 마스크, 그리고 마스크 개체는 라인을 측정하지 않습니다.

records.context: ``fraction_threshold`` removes a gRNA from a microplate sample position when its share of reads is below the selected limit. This changes the number and normalized abundance of guides assigned to each microplate sample position and therefore affects downstream coefficients.

records.source: ``fraction_threshold`` removes a gRNA from a well when its share of reads is below the selected limit. This changes the number and normalized abundance of guides assigned to each well and therefore affects downstream coefficients.
records.translation: ``fraction_threshold`` 제거 A gRNA 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에서 읽기의 비율이 선택한 한도 아래에있을 때.이것은 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 할당 된 가이드의 숫자와 정상화 된 풍부함을 변경하고 따라서 낮은 흐름 요소에 영향을 미칩니다.

records.context: For each candidate threshold, this module compares the positive-control read fraction from sequencing with the positive phenotype fraction from imaging. Candidates are scored by the median absolute microplate sample position-level disagreement, ``median(abs(imaging - sequencing))``. The fit uses the median of pairwise slopes to reduce sensitivity to one-sided contamination from screen hits. Slope, intercept, residual, disagreement and guides per microplate sample position are retained for review at every candidate.
records.label: spacr.fraction_calibration#2
records.source: For each candidate threshold, this module compares the positive-control read fraction from sequencing with the positive phenotype fraction from imaging. Candidates are scored by the median absolute well-level disagreement, ``median(abs(imaging - sequencing))``. The fit uses the median of pairwise slopes to reduce sensitivity to one-sided contamination from screen hits. Slope, intercept, residual, disagreement and guides per well are retained for review at every candidate.
records.translation: 각 후보의 한계를 위해,이 모듈은 긍정적 인 컨트롤 읽기 부분을 추적에서 이미지에서 유사한 현상 부분과 비교합니다. 후보자는 중간 절대 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 수준의 분쟁, ``median(abs(imaging - sequencing))``에 의해 점수됩니다. 적합한 측면은 쌍방향 스프레이의 중간을 사용하여 스크린 샷에서 단일 측면 오염에 대한 민감성을 줄입니다. 스프링, 캡처, 나머지, 분쟁 및 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 대한 가이드는 각 후보에 검토를 위해 유지됩니다.

records.context: Comparisons can use cells, microplate sample positions, or laboratory microplates as observations. Statistical test selection is delegated to :mod:`spacr.sp_stats`, and each result records its normality, equal-variance, and sample-size evidence. Cell-level tests treat individual cells as observations and do not account for cells that share a microplate sample position; use the microplate sample position level when microplate sample positions are the experimental units.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare#1
records.source: Comparisons can use cells, wells, or plates as observations. Statistical test selection is delegated to :mod:`spacr.sp_stats`, and each result records its normality, equal-variance, and sample-size evidence. Cell-level tests treat individual cells as observations and do not account for cells that share a well; use the well level when wells are the experimental units.
records.translation: 비교는 세포, 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치, 또는 실험실 마이크를 관찰으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 통계적 테스트 선택은 :mod:`spacr.sp_stats`로 할당되며 각 결과는 정상성, 동등한 변형 및 템플 크기 증거를 기록합니다. 세포 수준 테스트는 개별 세포를 관측으로 취급하고 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 공유하는 세포에 대해 계산하지 않습니다. 마이크라 플레트 샘폴 위치 수준을 사용하면 마이크라는 샘블 위치가 실험 단위입니다.

records.context: Identifier columns are excluded from the measurements. `pathogen_object_label` came out at p=2.5e-07 for EAF1, but it is a label: the selected cells sit lower in the segmentation's numbering, which is a position in a list. `pathogen_pathogen` is the same column under another name (spearman 0.9979, identical in 141,626 of 226,467 rows).
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_sweep#4
records.source: Identifier columns are excluded from the measurements. `pathogen_object_label` came out at p=2.5e-07 for EAF1, but it is a label: the selected cells sit lower in the segmentation's numbering, which is a position in a list. `pathogen_pathogen` is the same column under another name (spearman 0.9979, identical in 141,626 of 226,467 rows).
records.translation: 측정에서 식별자 열이 제외됩니다. `pathogen_object_label`는 EAF1의 p=2.5e-07에서 나왔지만, 그것은 레이블입니다 : 선택된 세포는 분할의 숫자에 아래에 위치하고 있으며, 이는 목록의 위치입니다. `pathogen_pathogen`는 다른 이름으로 동일한 열입니다 (스파르만 0.9979, 동일 141,626 의 226,467 라인).

records.context: x is the gene's effective microplate sample position count (``effective_wells``, the participation ratio that sets the degrees of freedom of each p-value) and y is how many measurements it moved past the correction. With at least eight genes, a dotted line shows the linear trend. A gene above the line has more significant measurements than its effective microplate sample position count predicts; a gene at the far right with a high count may owe its count to statistical weight.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_sweep.plot_effect_against_representation#2
records.source: x is the gene's effective well count (``effective_wells``, the participation ratio that sets the degrees of freedom of each p-value) and y is how many measurements it moved past the correction. With at least eight genes, a dotted line shows the linear trend. A gene above the line has more significant measurements than its effective well count predicts; a gene at the far right with a high count may owe its count to statistical weight.
records.translation: x는 유전자의 효과적인 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 계산 (``effective_wells``, 각 p 값의 자유의 정도를 설정하는 참여 비율) 및 y는 그것이 수정을 넘어 얼마나 많은 측정입니다. 적어도 8 개의 유전자와 함께, 도트 라인은 선형 추세를 보여줍니다. 라인 위의 유전자는 그것의 효율적인 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 계좌 예측보다 더 중요한 측정이있다; 높은 계산을 가진 멀리 오른쪽에있는 유전자가 통계 가중치로 계산 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: The x axis uses effective microplate sample positions rather than `share`. `share` is the median fraction a gene takes of the microplate sample positions it is present in, so a rare gene can score high on it. On this module's test fixture a gene in 18 of 120 microplate sample positions has share 0.44 and one in all 120 has 0.20, the opposite of their statistical detection sensitivity. The participation ratio is the quantity the test used.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_sweep.plot_effect_against_representation#3
records.source: The x axis uses effective wells rather than `share`. `share` is the median fraction a gene takes of the wells it is present in, so a rare gene can score high on it. On this module's test fixture a gene in 18 of 120 wells has share 0.44 and one in all 120 has 0.20, the opposite of their statistical power. The participation ratio is the quantity the test used.
records.translation: x axis는 `share` 대신 효과적인 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 사용합니다. `share`는 중간 부분은 그것에 존재하는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에서 유전자를 가져옵니다, 그래서 희귀 한 유전자는 그것에 높은 점수를 얻을 수 있습니다.이 모듈의 테스트 고정에 18 개의 120 마이크는 샘폴 위치에 유전자가 0.44를 공유하고 모든 120에서 하나는 0.20을 가지고, 그들의 통계적 인식 민감성의 반대입니다. 참여 비율은 테스트 사용 된 양입니다.

records.source: Shows the measurements past the correction for ``gene`` (or, when none pass, its largest effects), ordered by absolute effect, for example "GRA14 raises pathogen intensity and lowers pathogen area".
records.translation: ``gene`` (또는, 아무것도 통과하지 않을 때, 그것의 가장 큰 효과)에 대한 수정 이전의 측정을 나타내는 절대 효과에 의해 주문, 예를 들어 "GRA14는 병원체 강도를 증가시키고 병원체 영역을 낮추고있다."

records.context: **Results differ between backends.** cuML's UMAP is not bit-identical to umap-learn's, and its KMeans and DBSCAN can assign boundary points differently, so a figure regenerated on another machine can change. The accelerator is therefore opt-in per call and reports which backend ran; a caller that pins a seed for reproducibility should keep the CPU path.
records.label: spacr.gpu_reduce#6
records.source: **Results differ between backends.** cuML's UMAP is not bit-identical to umap-learn's, and its KMeans and DBSCAN can assign boundary points differently, so a figure regenerated on another machine can change. The accelerator is therefore opt-in per call and reports which backend ran; a caller that pins a seed for reproducibility should keep the CPU path.
records.translation: **결과는 후방점 사이에 다릅니다.** cuML의 UMAP는 umap의 학습과 비트 동일하지 않으며, KMeans와 DBSCAN는 경계점을 다른 방식으로 할당할 수 있으므로 다른 기계에서 재생된 숫자가 변경될 수 있습니다. 따라서 가속기는 전화 및 후속으로 진행되는 보고서에 따라 opt-in입니다. 재생 가능성을 위해 시드를 지정하는 호출자는 CPU 경로를 유지해야합니다.

records.label: spacr.guide_attribution.preflight#7
records.source: A guide is counted callable in a well when :func:`attributable` says so in that well -- the answer differs between wells because the prior does, and a guide at 0.6 of one well and 0.02 of another is not the same question.
records.translation: 가이드는 :func:`attributable`이 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에서 그렇게 말할 때 숫자로 계산됩니다 - 대답은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 따라 다르기 때문에 이전이 할 수 있으며, 가이드 0.6의 하나의 마이크와 0.02의 다른 위치에있는 것은 동일한 질문이 아닙니다.

records.context: The screening experiment unit is the microplate sample position.  Each guide is tested separately after both its microplate sample position-level read fraction and the microplate sample position-level phenotype have been residualized against nuisance covariates.  Empirical two-sided P values are obtained with Freedman--Lane residual permutations restricted within the experimental block (normally ``plateID``), followed by a user-selected multiple-testing correction within each outcome and minimum-support family.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation#1
records.source: The screen unit is the well.  Each guide is tested separately after both its well-level read fraction and the well-level phenotype have been residualized against nuisance covariates.  Empirical two-sided P values are obtained with Freedman--Lane residual permutations restricted within the experimental block (normally ``plateID``), followed by a user-selected multiple-testing correction within each outcome and minimum-support family.
records.translation: 스크린링 실험 단위는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치입니다. 각 가이드는 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 레벨 읽기 부분과 미생물을 표준 위치 페노 타입이 괴롭힘 코바리아트에 대항하여 재구성 된 후에 별도로 테스트됩니다. 공감적 인 두 측면의 P 값은 Freedman-Lane의 실험 블록 내에서 제한 된 나머지 변환 (일반적으로 ``plateID``), 각 결과 및 최소 지원 가족 내에서 사용자가 선택한 다중 테스트 수정에 따라 추적됩니다.

records.context: This is exactly the quantity the parametric gene fit regresses on: :func:`spacr.ml.check_and_clean_data` defines ``gene_fraction`` as the sum of the gene's gRNA fractions within a microplate sample position, and this builds the same number from the microplate sample position-by-guide matrix. The two paths therefore test the same regressor, one with a t statistic and one with a permutation null.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.gene_fraction_matrix#1
records.source: This is exactly the quantity the parametric gene fit regresses on: :func:`spacr.ml.check_and_clean_data` defines ``gene_fraction`` as the sum of the gene's gRNA fractions within a well, and this builds the same number from the well-by-guide matrix. The two paths therefore test the same regressor, one with a t statistic and one with a permutation null.
records.translation: 이것은 정확히 파라미터 유전자가 적합한 숫자입니다 : :func:`spacr.ml.check_and_clean_data`는 ``gene_fraction``를 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 내에서 유전자의 gRNA 부분의 합으로 정의하고, 이 숫자는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치-방향 매트릭스에서 동일한 수를 구축합니다.이 두 경로는 따라서 같은 회복기를 테스트합니다, 하나는 t 통계와 하나는 permutation null.

records.context: The test does not combine per-guide P values. Fisher's and Stouffer's methods both assume the p-values being combined are independent, and two guides measured in the same microplate sample positions are not: they share the microplate sample position's phenotype, the microplate sample position's laboratory microplate effect and the microplate sample position's cells. Combining them would report a confidence the design cannot support.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.gene_freedman_lane_test#2
records.source: The test does not combine per-guide P values. Fisher's and Stouffer's methods both assume the p-values being combined are independent, and two guides measured in the same wells are not: they share the well's phenotype, the well's plate effect and the well's cells. Combining them would report a confidence the design cannot support.
records.translation: 테스트는 per-guide P 값을 결합하지 않습니다. Fisher와 Stouffer의 방법은 모두 p 값이 결합되는 것을 가정하는 것은 독립적이며, 같은 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에서 측정되는 두 가지 가이드는 아닙니다 : 그들은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 현상을 공유하고, 미생물을 샘크 위치의 실험실 마이크를 효과하고, 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 세포를 결합하면 디자인이 지원할 수없는 신뢰를보고 할 것입니다.

records.context: This module generalises :func:`spacr.core.reducer_hyperparameter_search`, which already swept UMAP/tSNE + DBSCAN/KMeans parameters and drew the resulting embeddings as a grid of small multiples. That function stays where it is (it still owns the database read + the image-glyph plotting); what lives here is the search machinery it lacked: recorded trials, failed trials that do not abort the sweep, an incremental progress callback, early stopping, reproducible sampling, and — most importantly — an explicit, named scoring criterion instead of an unscored eyeball grid.
records.label: spacr.hyperparam#1
records.source: This module generalises :func:`spacr.core.reducer_hyperparameter_search`, which already swept UMAP/tSNE + DBSCAN/KMeans parameters and drew the resulting embeddings as a grid of small multiples. That function stays where it is (it still owns the database read + the image-glyph plotting); what lives here is the search machinery it lacked: recorded trials, failed trials that do not abort the sweep, an incremental progress callback, early stopping, reproducible sampling, and — most importantly — an explicit, named scoring criterion instead of an unscored eyeball grid.
records.translation: 이 모듈은 :func:`spacr.core.reducer_hyperparameter_search`을 일반화하고, 이미 UMAP/tSNE + DBSCAN/KMeans의 매개 변수를 끌고 결과 임베딩을 작은 숫자의 네트워크로 끌고 있습니다.이 기능은 여전히 그것이있는 곳에 남아 있습니다 (그것은 여전히 데이터베이스 읽기 + 이미지-글리프 임베딩을 소유하고있다); 여기에서 살아있는 것은 그것이 부족한 검색 엔진입니다 : 녹음 된 테스트, 실패한 테스트는 임베딩을 멈추지 않습니다, 증가하는 진보 호출, 일찍 멈추고, 재생 가능한 샘플링, 그리고 - 가장 중요한 것은 - 명시적이고 명칭 된 점수 기준 대신 녹음되지 않은 눈 벨트 네트워크.

records.context: **UMAP has no ground truth.** There is no measurement that says one embedding is correct and another is wrong. Every criterion here (trustworthiness, continuity, silhouette) rewards a *different* property, and they routinely disagree about which ``n_neighbors``/``min_dist`` wins. The scores are an aid for ranking a panel of embeddings you then look at; they are not a verdict. Anything that prints "best embedding" without naming the criterion is misleading, so :func:`format_search` always names it and always prints the caveat.
records.label: spacr.hyperparam#3
records.source: **UMAP has no ground truth.** There is no measurement that says one embedding is correct and another is wrong. Every criterion here (trustworthiness, continuity, silhouette) rewards a *different* property, and they routinely disagree about which ``n_neighbors``/``min_dist`` wins. The scores are an aid for ranking a panel of embeddings you then look at; they are not a verdict. Anything that prints "best embedding" without naming the criterion is misleading, so :func:`format_search` always names it and always prints the caveat.
records.translation: **UMAP 근본적인 진실은 없다.** 하나의 임베딩이 올바르고 다른 하나가 잘못되었다고 말하는 측정은 없습니다. 여기서 모든 기준 (신뢰성, 연속성, 실루엣)은 보상을 받습니다. *다른 것들* 자산, 그리고 그들은 일상적으로 어떤 것에 동의하지 않는다. ``n_neighbors``/``min_dist`` 승리. 점수는 당신이 볼 수있는 포장 패널을 순위하는 데 도움이됩니다; 그들은 판결이 아닙니다. "best embedding" 그 기준을 명칭하지 않고는 잘못된 것입니다, 그래서 :func:`format_search` 언제나 이름을 붙이고 언제나 카페트를 인쇄합니다.

records.context: **Selecting on the test split leaks.** :func:`cv_search` scores every trial on cross-validation folds, never on test, and refuses to execute if a caller hands it folds that touch the held-out test indices. It defaults to *grouped* folds (``group_by='well'``) and reuses :func:`spacr.io.make_cv_folds` — extracted image regions from one microplate sample position share focus, illumination and seeding density, so an ungrouped search picks the model that memorised microplate sample positions and reports an inflated score.
records.label: spacr.hyperparam#4
records.source: **Selecting on the test split leaks.** :func:`cv_search` scores every trial on cross-validation folds, never on test, and refuses to run if a caller hands it folds that touch the held-out test indices. It defaults to *grouped* folds (``group_by='well'``) and reuses :func:`spacr.io.make_cv_folds` — crops from one well share focus, illumination and seeding density, so an ungrouped search picks the model that memorised wells and reports an inflated score.
records.translation: **시험 분할 흐름에 선택.** :func:`cv_search`는 테스트에서 결코 테스트되지 않은 크로스 인증 폴더에 대한 모든 시험을 점수하고, 그것은 홀트 밖의 테스트 지표를 만지는 호출자 손에 그것을 점수를 실행하는 것을 거부합니다. 그것은 *그룹화 된*폴더 (``group_by='well'``)로 가상화하고 :func:`spacr.io.make_cv_folds`를 다시 사용합니다. - 하나의 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에서 추출 된 이미지 영역의 공유 초점, 조명 및 접종 밀도, 그래서 무그룹 검색은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 기억하고 인플레이션 점수를보고하는 모델을 고정합니다.

records.context: *Why the surface fit on top.* Illumination is a physically smooth, low-frequency function of position: a lamp profile plus a vignette. Fitting a low-order 2-D polynomial (default degree 4, 15 terms) to the per-pixel median imposes exactly that prior, so residual object structure and photon noise cannot leak into the gain map and be baked into every measurement on the laboratory microplate. The fit is trimmed twice against a MAD threshold, so a persistent bright artefact -- a fluorescent speck in the same place on every microscope field of view -- is rejected rather than smeared into the surface. For illumination that is genuinely not polynomial (a dust shadow, a sharply structured lamp) pass ``estimator='smooth'``: the same per-pixel median, Gaussian-smoothed at 1/16 of the short side and interpolated back to full resolution.
records.label: spacr.illumination#10
records.source: *Why the surface fit on top.* Illumination is a physically smooth, low-frequency function of position: a lamp profile plus a vignette. Fitting a low-order 2-D polynomial (default degree 4, 15 terms) to the per-pixel median imposes exactly that prior, so residual object structure and photon noise cannot leak into the gain map and be baked into every measurement on the plate. The fit is trimmed twice against a MAD threshold, so a persistent bright artefact -- a fluorescent speck in the same place on every field -- is rejected rather than smeared into the surface. For illumination that is genuinely not polynomial (a dust shadow, a sharply structured lamp) pass ``estimator='smooth'``: the same per-pixel median, Gaussian-smoothed at 1/16 of the short side and interpolated back to full resolution.
records.translation: *왜 표면이 상단에 맞는가.* 조명은 물리적으로 부드럽고 낮은 주파수 위치 기능입니다 : 램프 프로파일 플러스 비네이트. 낮은 순서 2-D 폴리노미얼 (기본 등급 4, 15 용어)을 per-pixel median에 맞추는 것은 정확히 이전의 것을 강요, 그래서 남은 개체 구조와 photon 소음은 수익지도에 유출 할 수 없으며 실험실 마이크로 플레이트에있는 모든 측정에 포장 될 수 없습니다. 피트는 MAD 임계값에 두 배로 자르므로 지속적인 밝은 유물 - 각 마이크로스코프 시야에서 동일한 장소에있는 플루로 레센트 스펙트럼 - 표면에 자르는 대신 거부됩니다. 진정으로 폴리노미아가 아닌 조명( 먼지 그림자, 뚜렷하게 구조화된 램프)은 ``estimator='smooth'``을 통과한다: 동일한 픽셀 미디어, 짧은 측면의 1/16에 가시안이 부드럽고 완전한 해상도로 다시 인터폴링된다.

records.context: *Why not BaSiC.* BaSiC's low-rank + sparse decomposition is the better estimator when you have hundreds of microscope fields of view and a genuine dark-microscope field of view to recover, but it is an iterative optimisation with its own convergence failure modes, and its dark-microscope field of view term is only identifiable because of those extra assumptions. From a single acquisition, ``dark`` and ``flat`` are not separately identifiable at all: multiplying ``flat`` by a constant and absorbing it into the per-microscope field of view brightness leaves every observation unchanged. Estimating a dark-microscope field of view anyway -- for instance from the per-pixel minimum across microscope fields of view, which is the usual shortcut -- returns *dark plus the dimmest background*, and subtracting it removes real signal. ``dark`` is therefore not estimated: it is 0 unless you supply the camera offset you measured from a dark frame, via ``illumination_dark``.
records.label: spacr.illumination#11
records.source: *Why not BaSiC.* BaSiC's low-rank + sparse decomposition is the better estimator when you have hundreds of fields and a genuine dark-field to recover, but it is an iterative optimisation with its own convergence failure modes, and its dark-field term is only identifiable because of those extra assumptions. From a single acquisition, ``dark`` and ``flat`` are not separately identifiable at all: multiplying ``flat`` by a constant and absorbing it into the per-field brightness leaves every observation unchanged. Estimating a dark-field anyway -- for instance from the per-pixel minimum across fields, which is the usual shortcut -- returns *dark plus the dimmest background*, and subtracting it removes real signal. ``dark`` is therefore not estimated: it is 0 unless you supply the camera offset you measured from a dark frame, via ``illumination_dark``.
records.translation: *왜 BaSiC.*의 낮은 랭크 + 스파르스 분해는 수백 개의 현미경 시야 필드와 진정한 어두운 미생물을 볼 수있는 시야가 회복 될 때 더 나은 추정치입니다. 그러나 그것은 자신의 convergence failure 모드와 함께 이테라브 최적화, 그리고 그것의 어두운 마이크로스코프 시야 필드는 이러한 추가 가정 때문에만 식별 가능합니다. 단일 인수에서, ``dark``과 ``flat``은 별도로 식별 할 수 없습니다 : ``flat``를 일정으로 번식하고 각 미생물 광선에 흡수하면 각 관찰이 변함없이 남아 있습니다. 어두운 마이크로스코프 시야를 추정하는 것은 어쨌든 - 예를 들어, 현미경 시야의 각 픽셀 최소에서, 이것은 일반적인 단축입니다 - *어두워지고 더러운 배경*을 반환하고, 그것을 추출하면 실제 신호를 제거합니다. ``dark``는 따라서 추정되지 않습니다 : 당신이 ``illumination_dark``를 통해 어둠의 프레임에서 측정 한 카메라 할인을 제공하지 않는 한 0입니다.

records.context: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` each worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry, so a correction registered only in the parent is applied to no field, and the processing session completes without an error while every number is uncorrected. :func:`enable_illumination_correction` therefore does more than register the hook: it writes the model path to :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` and appends ``spacr.illumination:install`` to ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``, which every start method inherits, so each worker installs the correction for itself. :func:`worker_delivery_status` reports whether that is actually in place, and :func:`enable_illumination_correction` prints it.
records.label: spacr.illumination#13
records.source: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` each worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry, so a correction registered only in the parent is applied to no field, and the run completes without an error while every number is uncorrected. :func:`enable_illumination_correction` therefore does more than register the hook: it writes the model path to :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` and appends ``spacr.illumination:install`` to ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``, which every start method inherits, so each worker installs the correction for itself. :func:`worker_delivery_status` reports whether that is actually in place, and :func:`enable_illumination_correction` prints it.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`은 :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`의 필드를 측정합니다. ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` 아래 각 워커는 빈 호크 레지스트리를 가진 신선한 번역가이므로 부모에만 등록된 수정은 필드에 적용되지 않으며 처리 세션은 오류없이 완료되며 각 번호는 수정되지 않습니다. 따라서 :func:`enable_illumination_correction`은 호크를 기록하는 것보다 더 많은 일을합니다 : 그것은 모델 경로를 :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR`로 작성하고 ``spacr.illumination:install``에서 ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``로 첨부하여 각 시작 방법이 상속되므로 각 워커는 자신을 위해 수정을 설치합니다. :func:`worker_delivery_status`은 그것이 실제로 존재하는지 여부를 보고하고 :func:`enable_illumination_correction`은 그것을 인쇄합니다.

records.context: No microscope lights a microscope field of view evenly. A lamp profile, vignetting in the objective, a tilted condenser and dirt on the optics together make the same cell measure brighter at the centre of the microscope field of view than at its edge -- routinely 10-40 % between the middle and a corner on a widefield screening experiment. Every intensity feature spaCR writes (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, the radial distribution, the texture image data channels that are computed on intensity) therefore carries a **position-dependent bias**, and because objects are not distributed identically over every microplate sample position, that bias does not average out: it survives into the per-microplate sample position aggregate, and from there into classification and regression as an effect that looks entirely real and is entirely an artefact of the optics.
records.label: spacr.illumination#2
records.source: No microscope lights a field of view evenly. A lamp profile, vignetting in the objective, a tilted condenser and dirt on the optics together make the same cell measure brighter at the centre of the field than at its edge -- routinely 10-40 % between the middle and a corner on a widefield screen. Every intensity feature spaCR writes (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, the radial distribution, the texture channels that are computed on intensity) therefore carries a **position-dependent bias**, and because objects are not distributed identically over every well, that bias does not average out: it survives into the per-well aggregate, and from there into classification and regression as an effect that looks entirely real and is entirely an artefact of the optics.
records.translation: 마이크로스코프가 동등하게 시야 필드를 조명하지 않습니다. 램프 프로파일, 렌즈에 휘발성, 끈화 된 콘덴서와 광학에 흙이 함께 같은 세포 측정을 미생물의 시야의 중심에 그것의 가장자리보다 밝게 만듭니다 - 일상적으로 10-40 % 중간과 넓은 필드 스크린 실험에서 각 강도 특징 spaCR (``*_mean_intensity``, ``*_percentile_*``, 방사선 분배, 텍스트 이미지 데이터 채널은 강도에 의해 계산) 따라서 **위치에 의존하는 bias**를 운반하고, 물체가 동일하게 분배되지 않기 때문에, 그것은 평균을 초과하지 않는다 : 그것은 샘플링 퍼그레이트 위치, 그리고 거기에서 클래식화와 회복은 완전히 실제로 보이는 효과이며 광학의 완전한 유물입니다.

records.context: This module builds a report from existing tables and runs no image processing: thirteen of the sixteen candidate infection metrics can be derived from tables Measure has already written. records.label: spacr.infection#1
records.source: This module builds a report from existing tables and runs no image processing: thirteen of the sixteen candidate infection metrics can be derived from tables Measure has already written. The three that do not -- intracellular fraction, vacuoles per cell, distance to the host boundary -- belong to the invasion module and to segmentation, and are deliberately absent here rather than approximated.
records.translation: 이 모듈은 기존 테이블에서 보고서를 구축하고 이미지를 처리하지 않습니다 : 16 개의 후보 감염 메트릭 중 13 개는 이미 작성 된 테이브에서 추출 할 수 있습니다. 세 가지가 아닌 - 내세포 부분, 세포 당 액포, 호스트 경계까지의 거리 - 침입 모듈과 분할에 속하며, 여기에서 의도적으로 부재하는 대신 접근.

records.context: ``io.py`` drops pathogens with no ``cell_id`` and can filter rows by ``pathogen_prcfo_count``. Neither touches the cell table. A numerator built from a filtered pathogen table over an unfiltered cell table counts two different populations, and the ratio looks entirely plausible.
records.label: spacr.infection#4
records.source: ``io.py`` drops pathogens with no ``cell_id`` and can filter rows by ``pathogen_prcfo_count``. Neither touches the cell table. A numerator built from a filtered pathogen table over an unfiltered cell table counts two different populations, and the ratio looks entirely plausible.
records.translation: ``io.py``은 ``cell_id``이없는 병원체를 떨어 뜨리고 ``pathogen_prcfo_count``로 라인을 필터링 할 수 있습니다. 또한 세포 테이블을 만지지 않습니다. 필터화 된 병원체 테이브에서 구성된 숫자는 필터되지 않은 세포테이블 위에 두 개의 다른 인구를 계산하고 비율은 완전히 안정적으로 보입니다.

records.context: pathogens cleared and cells kept -- a host cell whose only parasite touched the edge is still in the cell table, now with a count of zero. It reads as uninfected and deflates the rate.
records.label: spacr.infection.border_rules_agree#3
records.source: pathogens cleared and cells kept -- a host cell whose only parasite touched the edge is still in the cell table, now with a count of zero. It reads as uninfected and deflates the rate.
records.translation: 병원체가 청소되고 세포가 유지되었습니다 - 유일한 기생충이 가장자리에 접촉 한 숙주 세포는 여전히 세포 테이블에 있으며, 이제는 0의 숫자로 있습니다.

records.context: cells cleared and pathogens kept -- a parasite can name a cell that is no longer in the cell table, so it is counted in neither numerator nor denominator and the infection index drifts.
records.label: spacr.infection.border_rules_agree#4
records.source: cells cleared and pathogens kept -- a parasite can name a cell that is no longer in the cell table, so it is counted in neither numerator nor denominator and the infection index drifts.
records.translation: 세포가 청소되고 병원체가 보존됩니다 - 기생충은 더 이상 세포 테이블에 있지 않은 세포를 지정할 수 있으므로 숫자 또는 명칭에 계산되지 않으며 감염 지수가 흐르지 않습니다.

records.context: This is the same kind of problem as `include_uninfected`: a setting that changes what a table contains, and therefore what a ratio over it means, without any indication in the output. `include_uninfected` made every microplate sample position 1.000000 on a real laboratory microplate; a border mismatch instead deflates the rate, which can be mistaken for a biological effect.
records.label: spacr.infection.border_rules_agree#5
records.source: This is the same kind of problem as `include_uninfected`: a setting that changes what a table contains, and therefore what a ratio over it means, without any indication in the output. `include_uninfected` made every well 1.000000 on a real plate; a border mismatch instead deflates the rate, which can be mistaken for a biological effect.
records.translation: 이것은 `include_uninfected`과 같은 유형의 문제입니다 : 테이블이 포함 된 것을 변경하고 따라서 그것에 대한 비율이 무엇을 의미하는지, 출력에 아무런 지시도 없이 변경하는 설정. `include_uninfected` 각 마이크로 플레이트 샘플은 실제 실험실 마이크로플레이트에 1000000 위치를 만들었습니다; 한계 오류는 대신 비율을 차단합니다, 이는 생물학적 효과를 위해 잘못 될 수 있습니다.

records.context: The answer determines what the cell table holds. `include_uninfected=False` -- the default for a screen that only extracted image regions infected cells, and what the TSG101 laboratory microplates were measured with -- means Measure wrote no row for a cell with no parasite. records.source: The answer determines what the cell table holds. `include_uninfected=False` -- the default for a screen that only crops infected cells, and what the TSG101 plates were measured with -- means Measure wrote no row for a cell with no parasite. The cell table is then a selection of infected cells rather than the segmented population, and `infected / cells` is 1.0 for every well no matter what the biology did.

records.context: **Every panel uses one world-units-per-pixel scale.** That is the whole difficulty, and it is why this is a class rather than three :meth:`Canvas.covering` calls. Confocal stacks in this codebase are routinely 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z; a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin, and it does not look wrong — it looks like a slightly flat cell. Nuclear sphericity, colocalisation depth and every 3-D shape feature read off such a picture are wrong by a factor nobody sees. Here the side views are :math:`z_{span}/step` pixels tall, so a 10-slice 2 µm stack is 31 px of a 0.65 µm/px view, not 10.
records.label: spacr.layers.OrthoViews#5
records.source: **Every panel uses one world-units-per-pixel scale.** That is the whole difficulty, and it is why this is a class rather than three :meth:`Canvas.covering` calls. Confocal stacks in this codebase are routinely 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z; a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin, and it does not look wrong — it looks like a slightly flat cell. Nuclear sphericity, colocalisation depth and every 3-D shape feature read off such a picture are wrong by a factor nobody sees. Here the side views are :math:`z_{span}/step` pixels tall, so a 10-slice 2 µm stack is 31 px of a 0.65 µm/px view, not 10.
records.translation: **모든 패널은 1개의 세계 단위/픽셀 스케일을 사용합니다.** 이것이 전체 어려움이며, 이것이 3개의 :meth:`Canvas.covering` 호출을 대신 클래스입니다. 이 코드베이스의 혼합 스택은 정기적으로 0.65 µm xy 및 2 µm z입니다. 슬라이드 당 1 픽셀을 끌어가는 측면 전망은 3 배 너무 얇고 잘못 보이지 않습니다 - 약간 평평한 세포처럼 보입니다. 핵 구체성, 위치 깊이 및 그러한 그림을 읽는 모든 3D 형식 특징은 아무도 볼 수없는 요소에 의해 잘못됩니다. 여기에서 측면 전망은 :math:`z_{span}/step` 픽셀 높이, 그래서 10 슬라이드 2 µm 스택은 0.65 µm/px 전망의 31 px, 10이 아닌.
