records.context: Build cell → nucleus → pathogen object trees from measurement tables.
records.label: spacr.lineage#0
records.source: Build cell → nucleus → pathogen object trees from measurement tables.
records.translation: 측정 테이블에서 → 핵 → 병원체 개체 나무를 구축합니다.

records.context: Every object table in ``measurements.db`` is flat, and the relationships between them are already stored: :mod:`spacr.schema` gives ``nucleus`` and ``pathogen`` a ``cell_id`` pointing at the cell they sit inside (:data:`spacr.schema.CHILD_OBJECT_TABLES`). This module assembles those links into a tree, so a question such as "cell 41 in field 3 has one nucleus and four pathogens, and one of those pathogens has an area that would be impossible inside that nucleus" can be answered by inspecting one cell.
records.label: spacr.lineage#1
records.source: Every object table in ``measurements.db`` is flat, and the relationships between them are already stored: :mod:`spacr.schema` gives ``nucleus`` and ``pathogen`` a ``cell_id`` pointing at the cell they sit inside (:data:`spacr.schema.CHILD_OBJECT_TABLES`). This module assembles those links into a tree, so a question such as "cell 41 in field 3 has one nucleus and four pathogens, and one of those pathogens has an area that would be impossible inside that nucleus" can be answered by inspecting one cell.
records.translation: ``measurements.db``의 각 개체 테이블은 평평하며, 그들 사이의 관계는 이미 저장되어 있습니다: :mod:`spacr.schema`는 ``nucleus``와 ``pathogen``에 앉아있는 세포를 지적하는 ``cell_id``를 제공합니다 (:data:`spacr.schema.CHILD_OBJECT_TABLES`).이 모듈은 그 링크를 나무에 모으므로 "필드 3의 41 세포는 하나의 핵과 4 개의 병원체를 가지고 있으며, 그 중 하나는 그 핵 안에서 불가능한 영역을 가지고있다"와 같은 질문에 대답 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: A join answers "give me every pathogen with its cell's area". A tree answers "what is inside this cell", which is a different question and the one a person looking at an extracted image region actually has. The difference shows up in the failures: a join silently drops a cell with no pathogens and silently drops a pathogen whose ``cell_id`` names a cell that is not there. Both of those are findings — the first is the negative control working, the second is a segmentation bug — so :func:`build_forest` keeps childless parents and :func:`orphans` returns the unattached children rather than discarding them.
records.label: spacr.lineage#4
records.source: A join answers "give me every pathogen with its cell's area". A tree answers "what is inside this cell", which is a different question and the one a person looking at a crop actually has. The difference shows up in the failures: a join silently drops a cell with no pathogens and silently drops a pathogen whose ``cell_id`` names a cell that is not there. Both of those are findings — the first is the negative control working, the second is a segmentation bug — so :func:`build_forest` keeps childless parents and :func:`orphans` returns the unattached children rather than discarding them.
records.translation: 연합 응답 "그것의 세포의 영역으로 모든 병원체를 주십시오."나무는 "이 세포 안에 무엇이 있는지"에 대답합니다.이 질문은 다른 질문이며, 한 사람이 추출 된 이미지 영역을보고 실제로 가지고 있습니다.이 차이점은 실패에서 나타납니다 : 연합은 조용히 병원체가없는 세포를 떨어 뜨리고 조용하게 ``cell_id``이 존재하지 않는 세포라고 불리는 병원을 떨어 둡니다.이 두 가지 모두 발견 - 첫 번째는 부정적인 통제 작동, 두 번째는 분할 오류입니다 - 그래서 :func:`build_forest`는 아이가없는 부모를 유지하고 :func:`orphans`는 그들을 배제하는 대신에 접촉되지 않은 아이들을 반환합니다.

records.context: Tree nodes use :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys`. The same identifier appears in three views: UMAP, the plate view, and the crop grid. Selecting a tree node therefore publishes an identifier understood by all three. Resolve each child's parent *only inside its own field*. ``cell_id`` is a label rather than a unique key; label 7 can appear in each field.
records.label: spacr.lineage#6
records.source: Nodes are keyed by :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys`, the same string the UMAP, the plate view and the crop grid use, so selecting a node in the tree publishes something every other view already understands. A child's parent is resolved *within its own field*: ``cell_id`` is a label, not a key, and label 7 exists in every field on the plate.
records.translation: 나무 노드는 :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys`을 사용합니다. 같은 식별자는 3 개의 뷰에서 나타납니다: UMAP, 플레이트 뷰, 그리고 크롭 네트워크. 나무 코드를 선택하면 따라서 3 개 모두가 이해하는 식별자를 게시합니다. 각 어린이의 부모 *만 자신의 필드* 내부에서 해결합니다. ``cell_id``는 독특한 키가 아닌 레이블입니다. 레이블 7은 각 필드에 나타날 수 있습니다.

records.context: :data:`spacr.selection.OBJECT_KEY_COLUMNS` used to be the microscope field of view plus the object label, with no table in it, so a nucleus labelled 1 and a pathogen labelled 1 in the same microscope field of view had **the same structured-data name**. A lineage tree is where that became visible, because a cell's own children are exactly the objects most likely to collide: four objects opened as three extracted image regions and which one you got depended on the row order of ``png_list``.
records.label: spacr.lineage#8
records.source: :data:`spacr.selection.OBJECT_KEY_COLUMNS` used to be the field plus the object label, with no table in it, so a nucleus labelled 1 and a pathogen labelled 1 in the same field had **the same key**. A lineage tree is where that became visible, because a cell's own children are exactly the objects most likely to collide: four objects opened as three crops and which one you got depended on the row order of ``png_list``.
records.translation: :data:`spacr.selection.OBJECT_KEY_COLUMNS`은 미크로스코프 시야 플러스 개체 레이블로 사용되며, 그 안에 테이블이 없습니다., 따라서 동일한 마이크로스코프 시야에서 1을 표시한 핵과 1에 표시된 병원체가 **같은 구조화된 데이터 이름**을 가지고 있었다., 왜냐하면 세포 자체의 자녀들은 정확히 충돌할 가능성이 가장 높은 물체이기 때문입니다.: 4 개의 개체는 3 개의 추출 된 이미지 영역으로 열려 있으며 ``png_list``의 순서 순서에 의존하는 하나를 얻었습니다.

records.context: **As long as the subtree**, now that the shared key carries the object type. It used not to be: a nucleus 1 and a pathogen 1 inside the same cell were one key, de-duplicating was required (sending the same key twice would draw the same extracted image region twice), and four objects opened as three. :meth:`key_collisions` is the check that this no longer happens — it returns nothing on a typed forest.
records.label: spacr.lineage.LineageNode.keys#2
records.source: **As long as the subtree**, now that the shared key carries the object type. It used not to be: a nucleus 1 and a pathogen 1 inside the same cell were one key, de-duplicating was required (sending the same key twice would draw the same crop twice), and four objects opened as three. :meth:`key_collisions` is the check that this no longer happens — it returns nothing on a typed forest.
records.translation: **이 지하 나무** 동안, 이제 공유 키는 개체 유형을 가지고있다.그것은 아니었다 : 원자 1과 같은 세포 내부의 병원체 1은 하나의 키였고, 복제가 필요했습니다 (똑같은 키를 두 번 보내는 것은 동일한 추출 된 이미지 영역을 두 번 끌 것입니다), 그리고 4 개의 개체는 세 번으로 열립니다. :meth:`key_collisions`이 더 이상 일어나지 않는다는 체크입니다 - 그것은 타입 된 숲에 아무것도 반환하지 않습니다.

records.context: put each node's object table into its shared structured-data name, so a cell's nucleus 1 and its pathogen 1 are two structured-data names. ``False`` rebuilds the untyped structured-data names spaCR wrote before object types existed — kept so the collapse can be *reproduced* rather than only remembered, which is what makes :meth:`LineageNode.key_collisions` a test with two sides to it.
records.label: spacr.lineage.build_forest#3
records.source: put each node's object table into its shared key, so a cell's nucleus 1 and its pathogen 1 are two keys. ``False`` rebuilds the untyped keys spaCR wrote before object types existed — kept so the collapse can be *reproduced* rather than only remembered, which is what makes :meth:`LineageNode.key_collisions` a test with two sides to it.
records.translation: 각 노드의 개체 테이블을 그것의 공유 구조 데이터 이름에 넣어, 그래서 세포의 핵 1과 그것의 병원체 1은 두 개의 구조 된 데이터 이름입니다. ``False`` 구조화되지 않은 데이터 이름을 재구성합니다. spaCR 개체 유형이 존재하기 전에 작성되었으므로 붕괴가 발생할 수 있도록 유지되었습니다. *재생산* 오히려 단순히 기억하는 것보다, 그것이 무엇을 만드는지 :meth:`LineageNode.key_collisions` 그것에 대한 두 측면을 가진 테스트.

records.context: when the root table is absent or unusable. A missing *child* table is not an error — a run that measured cells and not pathogens produces a forest of childless cells.
records.label: spacr.lineage.build_forest#5
records.source: when the root table is absent or unusable. A missing *child* table is not an error — a run that measured cells and not pathogens produces a forest of childless cells.
records.translation: 뿌리 테이블이 없거나 사용할 수없는 경우 *아기* 테이브가 없으면 오류가 아닙니다 - 측정 된 세포가 아닌 병원체가 아기없는 세포의 숲을 생성하는 과정입니다.

records.context: Childless roots are kept. A cell with no pathogens in an infection assay is the negative control working, and a tree that dropped it would show the infected population as if it were the whole laboratory microplate.
records.label: spacr.lineage.build_forest#6
records.source: Childless roots are kept. A cell with no pathogens in an infection assay is the negative control working, and a tree that dropped it would show the infected population as if it were the whole plate.
records.translation: 감염 검사에서 병원체가없는 세포는 부정적인 통제 작업이며, 그것을 떨어 뜨린 나무는 전체 실험실 마이크로 플레이트처럼 감염 된 인구를 보여줍니다.

records.context: ``cell_id`` is an object *label*, and label 7 exists in every microscope field of view of every laboratory microplate. Matching children to parents on the label alone attaches every microscope field of view's nuclei to every microscope field of view's cell 7, which produces a tree that looks plausible and is wrong everywhere.
records.label: spacr.lineage.field_key#1
records.source: ``cell_id`` is an object *label*, and label 7 exists in every field of every plate. Matching children to parents on the label alone attaches every field's nuclei to every field's cell 7, which produces a tree that looks plausible and is wrong everywhere.
records.translation: ``cell_id``는 *라벨*의 개체이며, 라벨 7은 각 실험실 마이크로 플레이트의 각 현미경 시야에서 존재합니다. 라벨에있는 부모와 아이를 맞추는 것은 각 미소 스코프 필드의 시야의 핵을 시야 셀 7의 모든 미소스코프 영역에 붙어있어 모든 곳에서 잘못된 것처럼 보이는 나무를 생성합니다.

records.context: Collisions are counted *within a family*, not across the whole forest: two different cells' pathogens both labelled 1 in the same microscope field of view cannot happen (the label is unique per mask), while a nucleus 1 and a pathogen 1 inside one cell is the ordinary case. Merging the two would report a collision on every laboratory microplate.
records.label: spacr.lineage.forest_key_collisions#1
records.source: Collisions are counted *within a family*, not across the whole forest: two different cells' pathogens both labelled 1 in the same field cannot happen (the label is unique per mask), while a nucleus 1 and a pathogen 1 inside one cell is the ordinary case. Merging the two would report a collision on every plate.
records.translation: 충돌이 계산되고 있다. *한 가족 안에서*, 전체 숲을 통과하지 않습니다 : 같은 마이크로스코프 필드에서 1을 표시하는 두 개의 다른 세포의 병원체가 발생할 수 없습니다 (표시는 마스크 당 독특합니다), 한 개의 세포 내에서 1 핵과 1 병원은 일반적인 경우입니다.

records.context: which table it came from. ``None`` builds the untyped structured-data name spaCR wrote before object types existed — the one that gives a cell's nucleus 1 and its pathogen 1 the same name.
records.label: spacr.lineage.node_key#2
records.source: which table it came from. ``None`` builds the untyped key spaCR wrote before object types existed — the one that gives a cell's nucleus 1 and its pathogen 1 the same name.
records.translation: 어떤 테이블에서 왔는지. ``None`` 구조화되지 않은 데이터 이름을 구축합니다. spaCR 이전에 개체 유형이 존재하기 전에 썼다 - 세포의 핵 1과 그것의 병원체 1을 동일한 이름으로 부여하는 것.

records.context: A finding, not an error. A nucleus whose ``cell_id`` is 12 in a microscope field of view whose cell table has no object 12 means the two masks disagree — the nucleus segmentation found something the cell segmentation did not — and that is worth showing rather than dropping on the way into a tree.
records.label: spacr.lineage.orphans#1
records.source: A finding, not an error. A nucleus whose ``cell_id`` is 12 in a field whose cell table has no object 12 means the two masks disagree — the nucleus segmentation found something the cell segmentation did not — and that is worth showing rather than dropping on the way into a tree.
records.translation: 셀 테이블이 12 개의 대상이없는 미크로스코프 시야에서 ``cell_id``이있는 핵은 두 마스크가 동의하지 않는다는 것을 의미합니다 - 핵 분할은 세포 분할이하지 않은 것을 발견했습니다 - 그리고 그것은 나무로 가는 길에 떨어지는 대신 보여줄 가치가 있습니다.

records.context: spaCR's ``merged/`` arrays store the image data channels first and then one integer label-mask slice per object class (cell, nucleus, pathogen, organelle). The measurements database records, for every object, its integer ``object_label``, the merged ``.npy`` it came from (``path_name``), its well/microscope field of view metadata, and its features (e.g. ``cell_area``). This function queries that database for the objects you want, then for each hit slices the object out of its array using ``object_label`` and the class mask, assembles the image data channels you ask for into an image, and saves a PNG.
records.label: spacr.measure.generate_object_dataset#1
records.source: spaCR's ``merged/`` arrays store the image channels first and then one integer label-mask slice per object class (cell, nucleus, pathogen, organelle). The measurements database records, for every object, its integer ``object_label``, the merged ``.npy`` it came from (``path_name``), its well/field metadata, and its features (e.g. ``cell_area``). This function queries that database for the objects you want, then for each hit slices the object out of its array using ``object_label`` and the class mask, assembles the channels you ask for into an image, and saves a PNG.
records.translation: spaCR's ``merged/`` 뿌리는 이미지 데이터 채널을 먼저 저장하고 다음 개체 클래스 (세포, 핵, 병원체, organelle)에 대한 하나의 전체 레이블 마스크 슬라이드입니다. ``object_label``융합된 것들 ``.npy`` 그것은 나온 것입니다 (``path_name``), 그것의 벽 / 마이크로스코프 필드 시각 메타 데이터, 그리고 그것의 특징 (예 : ``cell_area``이 기능은 원하는 개체에 대한 데이터베이스를 묻고, 각 타격을 위해 해당 개체가 그 범위에서 벗어나는 것을 사용합니다. ``object_label`` 그리고 클래스 마스크, 당신이 요청하는 이미지 데이터 채널을 이미지에 모으고, PNG.

records.context: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Under ``fork`` (the Linux default) a worker inherits this module's registries from the parent and hooks registered with :func:`register_preprocessing_hook` work without additional setup. Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` (Windows, macOS, or ``SPACR_START_METHOD``) a worker is a fresh interpreter that has never seen them, so an in-process registration would be a **silent no-op in every worker**. For that case set :data:`HOOKS_ENV_VAR`

records.translation: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`은 :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`의 필드를 측정합니다. ``fork`` (기본 Linux) 아래에서 워커는 추가 설정없이 :func:`register_preprocessing_hook` 작업으로 등록 된 부모와 호크에서이 모듈의 기록을 상속합니다. ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` (Windows, macOS, 또는 ``SPACR_START_METHOD``) 아래에서 워커는 그들을 본 적이없는 신선한 해석자입니다, 그래서 프로세스 등록은 각 워커**에서**의 조용한 no-op이 될 것입니다. 이 경우 :data:`HOOKS_ENV_VAR`을 설정합니다.

records.context: Measured on a synthetic infected/uninfected table with twelve pathogen columns, the median fill produced a centroid gap of 0.06 -- almost nothing -- and a dispersion ratio of 0.11. The centroid statistic alone would not have detected it, because a median fill puts the missing objects in the middle of the present ones rather than away from them. Both are reported, and ``severity`` is whichever is worse.
records.label: spacr.merge_tables.missingness_leak#10

records.context: ``centroid_gap`` the missing objects sit elsewhere. Near 0 means they have no spread of their own.

records.context: Two consequences follow. First, the digest is the contract: anything the prose may quote has to be *in* it, which is why the digest carries the alpha, the confidence level and the seed as numbers rather than leaving the model to supply the obvious ones. Second, there is a deterministic renderer — :func:`render_methods` and :func:`render_results` — that writes the same sections from the same digest with no model at all. It is what executes when no AI provider is configured, it is what a rejected draft falls back to, and it is what the number-provenance tests assert against, because a test that plants a number in the digest and requires it in the output must not be testing a stub.
records.label: spacr.methods_export#5
records.source: Two consequences follow. First, the digest is the contract: anything the prose may quote has to be *in* it, which is why the digest carries the alpha, the confidence level and the seed as numbers rather than leaving the model to supply the obvious ones. Second, there is a deterministic renderer — :func:`render_methods` and :func:`render_results` — that writes the same sections from the same digest with no model at all. It is what runs when no AI provider is configured, it is what a rejected draft falls back to, and it is what the number-provenance tests assert against, because a test that plants a number in the digest and requires it in the output must not be testing a stub.
records.translation: 두 가지 결과가 이어집니다. 첫째, 소화는 계약입니다 : 프로세스가 인용 할 수있는 모든 것이 *in* 그것이되어야합니다, 그래서 소화가 알파, 신뢰 수준과 시드를 숫자로 가져 오기보다는 분명한 것을 공급하기 위해 모델을 떠나는 이유입니다. 둘째, 같은 소화에서 동일한 섹션을 작성하는 결정적 인 렌더가있다 - :func:`render_methods` 및 :func:`render_results` 전혀 모델이 없습니다. 그것은 AI 공급자가 구성되지 않을 때 실행되는 것입니다.

records.context: A regression processing session is configured with ``paired_data``: ordered score/count CSV pairs whose laboratory microplate and microplate sample position identities agree.  Older ``score_data`` and ``count_data`` lists are migrated positionally, but explicit pairs are safer. Choose the score column with ``dependent_variable`` and provide the relevant control microplate sample positions, laboratory microplate metadata, analysis ``level`` (guide, gene, or both), multiple-testing threshold, and either a supported ``regression_type`` or ``None`` for distribution-based selection.  Family-specific settings are validated rather than silently ignored.  The classical-ML path instead needs one or more ``measurements.db`` files, labelled positive and negative controls or an annotation column, and a model choice such as XGBoost, logistic regression, or random forest.
records.label: spacr.ml#4
records.source: A regression run is configured with ``paired_data``: ordered score/count CSV pairs whose plate and well identities agree.  Older ``score_data`` and ``count_data`` lists are migrated positionally, but explicit pairs are safer. Choose the score column with ``dependent_variable`` and provide the relevant control wells, plate metadata, analysis ``level`` (guide, gene, or both), multiple-testing threshold, and either a supported ``regression_type`` or ``None`` for distribution-based selection.  Family-specific settings are validated rather than silently ignored.  The classical-ML path instead needs one or more ``measurements.db`` files, labelled positive and negative controls or an annotation column, and a model choice such as XGBoost, logistic regression, or random forest.
records.translation: 회복 처리 세션은 ``paired_data``로 구성됩니다 : 주문 점수 / 계산 CSV 쌍의 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 및 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 정체성이 동의합니다. 오래된 ``score_data`` 및 ``count_data`` 목록은 위치로 이주하지만 명확한 쌍은 더 안전합니다. ``dependent_variable``로 점수 열을 선택하고 관련 컨트롤 마이크록 플레이 위치, 실험소 마이크는 메타 데이터, 분석 ``level`` (가이드, 유전자 또는 둘 다), 다중 테스트 경계, 그리고 분배 기반 선택을위한 지원 ``regression_type`` 또는 ``None``. 가족 특정 설정은 조용히 무시하는 대신 유효합니다. 대신 클래식-ML 경로는 하나 이상의 ``measurements.db`` 파일, 긍정적이고 부정적인 컨트롤 또는 기록 열을 표시하고 XGBoost, 물류 회복 또는 우연한 숲과 같은 모델 선택이 필요합니다.

records.context: Regression results go into a new, non-overwriting ``<output root>/results/<analysis kind>[_n]`` directory.  ``results.csv`` is the primary combined table; ``results_grna.csv`` and ``results_gene.csv`` make the fitted levels explicit, and ``results_significant.csv`` records thresholded hits.  The same directory holds summaries, diagnostics, volcano and laboratory microplate figures, optional publication-panel packages, resource measurements, or a detailed failure report.  A requested level with no fitted rows is kept as a header-only CSV so downstream tools can distinguish "tested, no rows" from a missing artifact.  Classical ML writes predictions, feature-importance tables, evaluation results, and a laboratory microplate heatmap beneath ``results``.
records.label: spacr.ml#6
records.source: Regression results go into a new, non-overwriting ``<output root>/results/<analysis kind>[_n]`` directory.  ``results.csv`` is the primary combined table; ``results_grna.csv`` and ``results_gene.csv`` make the fitted levels explicit, and ``results_significant.csv`` records thresholded hits.  The same directory holds summaries, diagnostics, volcano and plate figures, optional publication-panel packages, resource measurements, or a detailed failure report.  A requested level with no fitted rows is kept as a header-only CSV so downstream tools can distinguish "tested, no rows" from a missing artifact.  Classical ML writes predictions, feature-importance tables, evaluation results, and a plate heatmap beneath ``results``.
records.translation: Regression 결과는 ``<output root>/results/<analysis kind>[_n]`` 디렉토리에 새롭고 과장되지 않은 디렉터리로 이동합니다. ``results.csv``은 기본 결합 테이블입니다. ``results_grna.csv`` 및 ``results_gene.csv``은 설정된 레벨을 명확하게 만들고, ``results_significant.csv``는 경계 히트를 기록합니다. 같은 디렉토리에는 요약, 진단, 화산 및 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 숫자, 선택적 인 출판 패널 패키지, 자원 측정 또는 상세한 실패 보고서가 포함되어 있습니다. 고정된 라인이없는 요청된 레벨은 헤더로 유지됩니다-만 CSV 그래서 아래 스트림 도구는 실종된 아티팩트에서 "검사, 라인 없음"을 구별할 수 있습니다. 클래식 ML은 예측, 특징 중요성 테이블, 평가 결과 및 ``results`` 아래의 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 열지도를 작성합니다.

records.context: ``lasso`` and ``elasticnet`` do not rely on this at all — :data:`NO_P_VALUE_TYPES` routes them to a bootstrap selection frequency instead. ``ridge`` does, because it never sets a coefficient to exactly zero and so has no selection frequency to report (every feature would score 1.0), and a conservative test is a better answer than no test. ``tests/test_regression_orientation.py`` pins the null case, which is where an anticonservative version of this would show.
records.label: spacr.ml.calculate_p_values#2
records.source: ``lasso`` and ``elasticnet`` do not rely on this at all — :data:`NO_P_VALUE_TYPES` routes them to a bootstrap selection frequency instead. ``ridge`` does, because it never sets a coefficient to exactly zero and so has no selection frequency to report (every feature would score 1.0), and a conservative test is a better answer than no test. ``tests/test_regression_orientation.py`` pins the null case, which is where an anticonservative version of this would show.
records.translation: ``lasso`` 및 ``elasticnet``는 전혀 이것에 의존하지 않습니다 - :data:`NO_P_VALUE_TYPES` 대신에 그들을 bootstrap 선택 주파수로 이동합니다. ``ridge``는, 그것은 정확히 0에 동율을 설정하지 않기 때문에 보고 할 선택 주파수가 없습니다 (모든 특징은 1.0을 점수 할 것입니다), 그리고 보수적 인 테스트는 테스트가없는 것보다 더 나은 대답입니다. ``tests/test_regression_orientation.py``는 null 사례를 핀, 이것은 이것의 보수적 인 버전이 표시 될 것입니다.

records.context: A head is a trained machine-learning classification model: it is handed a batch of extracted image regions and returns a class and a probability for each. records.context: ``listAnnotations()`` is deliberately called **without** a namespace filter and the filtering is done here. The filter is what decides whether an annotation gets written to, and that decision must not depend on a server honouring a query parameter: a server that ignored ``ns=`` would otherwise hand back a stranger's annotation and this module would update it.
records.label: spacr.omero.list_spacr_annotations#1
records.source: ``listAnnotations()`` is deliberately called **without** a namespace filter and the filtering is done here. The filter is what decides whether an annotation gets written to, and that decision must not depend on a server honouring a query parameter: a server that ignored ``ns=`` would otherwise hand back a stranger's annotation and this module would update it.
records.translation: ``listAnnotations()``은 의도적으로 **없이** 이름 공간 필터로 불리며 필터링은 여기에서 수행됩니다. 필터는 어노테이션이 쓰여지는지 여부를 결정하는 것이며, 그 결정은 쿼리 매개 변수를 존중하는 서버에 의존해서는 안됩니다. ``ns=``을 무시한 서버는 그렇지 않으면 낯선 사람의 어노테이션을 반환하고이 모듈은 그것을 업데이트 할 것입니다.

records.context: **Why there is a cap.** A spaCR object table has 300-600 columns. A MapAnnotation with 400 entries renders in OMERO.web as a 400-row scrolling table in a 300 px panel, which hides the annotations worth showing. So the annotation is a *summary*, capped at ``max_pairs`` (:data:`MAX_MAP_PAIRS` = 50 by default) and ordered so the useful structured-data names are the ones that survive: ``priority`` structured-data names first in the order given, then the row's own order. When anything is cut, the last pair is :data:`TRUNCATION_KEY`, saying how many were dropped and that the full table is the CSV attached under :data:`NS_FILE`. The full table is never *only* in the annotation.
records.label: spacr.omero.measurement_pairs#2
records.source: **Why there is a cap.** A spaCR object table has 300-600 columns. A MapAnnotation with 400 entries renders in OMERO.web as a 400-row scrolling table in a 300 px panel, which hides the annotations worth showing. So the annotation is a *summary*, capped at ``max_pairs`` (:data:`MAX_MAP_PAIRS` = 50 by default) and ordered so the useful keys are the ones that survive: ``priority`` keys first in the order given, then the row's own order. When anything is cut, the last pair is :data:`TRUNCATION_KEY`, saying how many were dropped and that the full table is the CSV attached under :data:`NS_FILE`. The full table is never *only* in the annotation.
records.translation: **왜 캡이 있는가.** A spaCR 개체 테이블에는 300-600 열이 있습니다. 400 개의 입력을 가진 지도에 대한 기록 OMERO.web 300 px 패널에있는 400 루프 스크롤 테이블으로, 표시 가치가있는 어노테이션을 숨기고 있습니다. *요약*캡처된 에 ``max_pairs`` (:data:`MAX_MAP_PAIRS` = 기본적으로 50) 그리고 주문하여 유용한 구조화 된 데이터 이름은 살아남는 이름입니다 : ``priority`` 구조화된 데이터 이름은 먼저 주어진 순서에, 그 다음 순서의 자신의 순서입니다. :data:`TRUNCATION_KEY`얼마나 많은 사람들이 사라졌는지, 그리고 테이블이 완전하다고 말한다. CSV 아래에 붙어있다 :data:`NS_FILE`전체 테이블은 결코 *오직* 어노테이션에 포함되어 있습니다.

records.label: spacr.omero.omero_indices#1

records.translation: 라운드 트레일은 수출이 spaCR per-microplate 샘플 위치 요약을 OMERO 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치로 돌려보내는 것을 허용합니다.

records.context: a microplate sample position name (``'A01'``, ``'aa1'``, ``'AF48'``) or a spaCR ``(rowID, columnID)`` pair already joined, e.g. ``'r1_c1'`` is *not* accepted — pass the microplate sample position name.
records.label: spacr.omero.omero_indices#2
records.source: a well name (``'A01'``, ``'aa1'``, ``'AF48'``) or a spaCR ``(rowID, columnID)`` pair already joined, e.g. ``'r1_c1'`` is *not* accepted — pass the well name.
records.translation: 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 이름 (``'A01'``, ``'aa1'``; ``'AF48'``) 또는 이미 첨부된 spaCR ``(rowID, columnID)`` 쌍, 예를 들어 ``'r1_c1'``는 *not* 받아 들여지며 - 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 이름을 통과합니다.

records.context: Under :data:`REPLACE` — the default — an annotation whose namespace is *exactly* ``namespace`` is updated in place. Nothing is created, nothing is unlinked and **nothing is deleted**; a re-run therefore leaves one annotation rather than a growing pile, and an annotation in any other namespace (a colleague's, OMERO's own bulk annotations) is never even considered. When more than one already exists — only possible after an :data:`APPEND` run or a concurrent writer — the oldest (lowest id) is updated and the rest are reported in ``duplicates`` rather than removed, because an annotation may be linked elsewhere.
records.label: spacr.omero.plan_annotation#2
records.source: Under :data:`REPLACE` — the default — an annotation whose namespace is *exactly* ``namespace`` is updated in place. Nothing is created, nothing is unlinked and **nothing is deleted**; a re-run therefore leaves one annotation rather than a growing pile, and an annotation in any other namespace (a colleague's, OMERO's own bulk annotations) is never even considered. When more than one already exists — only possible after an :data:`APPEND` run or a concurrent writer — the oldest (lowest id) is updated and the rest are reported in ``duplicates`` rather than removed, because an annotation may be linked elsewhere.
records.translation: :data:`REPLACE` - 기본적으로 - 이름 공간이 *exactly* ``namespace``인 어노테이션이 업데이트됩니다. 아무것도 만들어지지 않으며 **아무것도 삭제되지 않습니다**; 따라서 다시 실행하는 것은 성장하는 덩어리 대신 하나의 기록을 남기고 다른 이름 공간 (동료, OMERO 자체 대량 기록)의 기록은 결코 고려되지 않습니다. 이미 하나 이상이있을 때 - :data:`APPEND` 라운드 또는 동일한 작가 후에만 가능하다 - 가장 오래된 (최소 ID)은 업데이트되고 나머지는 ``duplicates``으로보고되기보다는 제거되기 때문에 어노테이션이 다른 곳에 링크 될 수 있습니다.

records.context: Underscores are stripped along with every other non-alphanumeric character, because the ``cellvoyager`` regex splits the laboratory microplate from the microplate sample position on ``_``, so a laboratory microplate literally called ``my run`` would move the split point and misparse every microplate sample position. This is the same rule as ``spacr.convert._sanitise``, which is the function that already governs the rest of spaCR's conversions.
records.label: spacr.omero.plate_token#1
records.source: Underscores are stripped along with every other non-alphanumeric character, because the ``cellvoyager`` regex splits the plate from the well on ``_``, so a plate literally called ``my run`` would move the split point and misparse every well. This is the same rule as ``spacr.convert._sanitise``, which is the function that already governs the rest of spaCR's conversions.
records.translation: 하위 점수는 다른 모든 비 알파노 숫자 캐릭터와 함께 분리되기 때문에 ``cellvoyager`` 레지크스는 ``_``의 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에서 실험실 마이크를 분리하므로 ``my run``라는 문자 그대로 이름의 실험소 마이크는 분리 포인트를 움직이고 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 혼란스럽게합니다. 이것은 ``spacr.convert._sanitise``과 동일한 규칙이며, 이는 이미 spaCR의 나머지 변환을 지배하는 기능입니다.

records.context: The mean of each numeric column over the rows that actually have a value there, plus ``n_objects``. Missing values are *excluded from their own column's mean* rather than zero-filled: in spaCR a NaN is usually structural (a ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it), and zero-filling turns "no pathogen" into "a pathogen of zero size". A column with no usable value in any row is reported as ``None``, which :func:`measurement_pairs` renders as ``NaN``.
records.label: spacr.omero.summarise_rows#1
records.source: The mean of each numeric column over the rows that actually have a value there, plus ``n_objects``. Missing values are *excluded from their own column's mean* rather than zero-filled: in spaCR a NaN is usually structural (a ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it), and zero-filling turns "no pathogen" into "a pathogen of zero size". A column with no usable value in any row is reported as ``None``, which :func:`measurement_pairs` renders as ``NaN``.
records.translation: 실제로 거기에 가치가있는 행 위의 각 숫자 열의 평균, 플러스 ``n_objects``잃어버린 가치들은 *자신의 열의 중간에서 제외* 제로 채워진 대신 : spaCR a NaN 일반적으로 구조적 (a) ``pathogen_*`` 컬러는 NaN 그 안에 병원체가 없는 세포를 위해), 그리고 0 채우는 회전 "no pathogen" "제로 크기의 병원제"로 표시됩니다. 어떤 순서에서도 사용 가능한 값이 없는 열은 다음과 같습니다. ``None``그리고 어떤 :func:`measurement_pairs` 렌더는 그대로 ``NaN``.

records.context: Non-numeric columns are carried through when every row agrees on the value — that is how ``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID`` and ``condition`` reach the microplate sample position annotation — and dropped when they disagree, because a single microplate sample position cannot have two laboratory microplate ids and picking one would be a guess.
records.label: spacr.omero.summarise_rows#2
records.source: Non-numeric columns are carried through when every row agrees on the value — that is how ``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID`` and ``condition`` reach the well annotation — and dropped when they disagree, because a single well cannot have two plate ids and picking one would be a guess.
records.translation: 숫자없는 열은 각 줄이 값에 동의 할 때 통과됩니다 - 즉 ``plateID``, ``rowID``,``columnID`` 및 ``condition``가 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 표시에 도달하는 방법입니다 - 그들이 동의하지 않을 때 떨어지기 때문에 단일 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치는 두 개의 실험실 마이크라 플레트 ID를 가지고 있지 않으며 하나를 선택하는 것은 추측이 될 것입니다.

records.context: Images in a *Dataset* have no laboratory microplate geometry — a Dataset is a flat bag — so the only place a microplate sample position can come from is the name the acquisition software gave the file. This reads the first delimited token that parses as a microplate sample position within a 1536-position laboratory microplate (32 rows, 48 columns).
records.label: spacr.omero.well_from_image_name#1
records.source: Images in a *Dataset* have no plate geometry — a Dataset is a flat bag — so the only place a well can come from is the name the acquisition software gave the file. This reads the first delimited token that parses as a well within a 1536-well plate (32 rows, 48 columns).
records.translation: *Dataset*에있는 이미지에는 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 지질이 없습니다 - Dataset는 평평한 가방입니다 - 그래서 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에서 나올 수있는 유일한 장소는 소프트웨어가 파일을 제공 한 이름입니다.

records.context: Everything downstream — every group-by, every laboratory microplate heatmap, every microplate sample position-level statistic — is keyed off ``rowID``/``columnID``, so a one-row offset would put the controls in the wrong place.
records.label: spacr.omero.well_position#1
records.source: Everything downstream — every group-by, every plate heatmap, every well-level statistic — is keyed off ``rowID``/``columnID``, so a one-row offset would put the controls in the wrong place.
records.translation: 모든 downstream - 각 그룹-by, 각 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 온도지도, 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 수준의 통계 - ``rowID``/``columnID``에서 열쇠를 꺼내므로 하나의 롤 오프셋은 제어를 잘못된 장소에 넣을 것입니다.

records.context: The GPU-suitable steps of OPS are the per-window affine warp, peak finding, the unmixing matrix multiply and Cellpose segmentation (which has its own GPU path), and, for the merge, ORB detection with Hamming descriptor matching and mutual-nearest-neighbour cell matching. These reduce to three primitives: a windowed maximum, a matrix multiply and a nearest-neighbour search. They are collected here so device handling lives in one place.
records.label: spacr.ops_accel#1
records.source: The GPU-suitable steps of OPS are the per-window affine warp, peak finding, the unmixing matrix multiply and Cellpose segmentation (which has its own GPU path), and, for the merge, ORB detection with Hamming descriptor matching and mutual-nearest-neighbour cell matching. These reduce to three primitives: a windowed maximum, a matrix multiply and a nearest-neighbour search. They are collected here so device handling lives in one place.
records.translation: OPS의 GPU- 적합한 단계는 윈도우에 접근  워프, 피크 찾기, 혼합되지 않은 매트릭스 번식 및 Cellpose 분할 (그것은 자신의 GPU 경로를 가지고), 그리고, 합병을 위해, 햄링 설명서 일치 및 상호-가까운 셀 일치와 ORB 탐지입니다.이 세 가지 원시적입니다 : 창으로 최대, 마트릭스를 번식하고 가장 가까운 검색.

records.context: Used for unmixing: correcting dye bleed-through applies one small matrix to every spot of every cycle, a large multiply by a tiny operand that suits a GPU.
records.label: spacr.ops_accel.matmul#1
records.source: Used for unmixing: correcting dye bleed-through applies one small matrix to every spot of every cycle, a large multiply by a tiny operand that suits a GPU.
records.translation: 혼합하지 않기 위해 사용됩니다 : 염료 번짐(bleed-through)을 보정하는 것은 각 사이클의 각 지점에 하나의 작은 매트릭스를 적용하며, GPU에 맞는 작은 오페란드에 의해 큰 번식입니다.

records.context: sqrt of the mean coverage: averaging n independent samples of one signal divides the noise by sqrt(n). Reported over covered pixels only, because a microplate sample position's corners are reached by one microscope image field and including the uncovered background would report a gain for pixels nothing measured.
records.label: spacr.ops_compose.overlap_gain#1
records.source: sqrt of the mean coverage: averaging n independent samples of one signal divides the noise by sqrt(n). Reported over covered pixels only, because a well's corners are reached by one tile and including the uncovered background would report a gain for pixels nothing measured.
records.translation: 중간 커버의 sqrt : 한 신호의 평균 n 독립적 인 샘플은 sqrt(n)에 의해 소음을 분할합니다. 덮인 픽셀에만 보고되기 때문에 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 각도는 하나의 미생물 이미지 필드에 도달하고 발견 된 배경을 포함하여 아무것도 측정되지 않은 픽슐에 대한 이익을보고합니다.

records.context: Only microscope image fields that touch the window are opened, not the whole well. Six anchors need about nine microscope image fields each; testing readability over every placement instead would read all 333 of the reference well's sequencing microscope image fields, and ``tifffile`` reads the whole five-image layer 1,480 px file for one image layer of it -- 22 MB each, about 7 GB over NFS per well, before ``compose_window`` re-reads the nine it needs. The overlap test is the same rounding ``compose_window`` uses, so a microscope image field is offered here exactly when it would have been used there; a microscope image field that will not read is dropped so the composer never sees a None.
records.label: spacr.ops_engine._phenotype.usable_under#3
records.source: Only tiles that touch the window are opened, not the whole well. Six anchors need about nine tiles each; testing readability over every placement instead would read all 333 of the reference well's sequencing tiles, and ``tifffile`` reads the whole five-plane 1,480 px file for one plane of it -- 22 MB each, about 7 GB over NFS per well, before ``compose_window`` re-reads the nine it needs. The overlap test is the same rounding ``compose_window`` uses, so a tile is offered here exactly when it would have been used there; a tile that will not read is dropped so the composer never sees a None.
records.translation: 창을 만지는 미생물 이미지 필드만 열리며 전체가 잘 열리지 않습니다. 6 개의 앵커는 각각 약 9 개의 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드를 필요로합니다. 각 배치에 대한 읽기 테스트는 대신 참조 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 순서 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드의 모든 333을 읽을 것이고, ``tifffile``은 전체 다섯 이미지 레이어 파일을 읽고, 그것의 하나의 이미 레이어에 대해 1,480 px - 각각 22 MB, NFS 당 약 7 GB, ``compose_window``이 필요로하는 9 개를 다시 읽기 전에. 오버 랩 테스트는 동일한 회전 ``compose_window`` 사용, 그래서 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드는 정확히 그것이 거기에 사용되었을 때 여기에 제공됩니다; 읽지 않는 미크로스코프 이미지 필드가 떨어져서 작곡기는 None을 결코 볼 수 없습니다.

records.translation: :func:`_unseen_report` 이름은 가장 큰 그룹과 치료법입니다.이 기록은 관찰이 여전히 기억에 남아있는 동안 거부 된 각 그룹을 설명합니다, 그래서 처리 세션 보고서는 나중에 클립에서 동반자가없는 Cellpose 조각을 말할 수 있습니다, 그 완전한 관찰 합류가 놓친, 다시 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 분할하지 않고.

records.context: The consensus is therefore used as a seed. This module finds the correspondences the seed implies, re-solves the similarity from those correspondences in closed form, and repeats on the correspondences the improved transform implies. :func:`align_by_triangles` already re-estimates its translation from the matched vertices once the scale and rotation are fixed; here the scale and the rotation are re-solved as well.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype#6
records.source: The consensus is therefore used as a seed. This module finds the correspondences the seed implies, re-solves the similarity from those correspondences in closed form, and repeats on the correspondences the improved transform implies. :func:`align_by_triangles` already re-estimates its translation from the matched vertices once the scale and rotation are fixed; here the scale and the rotation are re-solved as well.
records.translation: 따라서 합의는 시드로 사용됩니다.이 모듈은 시드가 의미하는 상호 작용을 발견하고, 닫힌 형태의 그 상호작용에서 유사성을 다시 해결하고, 개선된 변환이 의미되는 상호 작업을 반복합니다. :func:`align_by_triangles` 이미 스케일과 회전이 고정되면 일치하는 궤도에서 번역을 다시 평가합니다.

records.context: The result also reports how many nuclei agree, which the triangle consensus does not. `align_by_triangles` returned a transform for every pair it was given, including phenotype microscope image fields and sequencing microscope image fields from opposite sides of the microplate sample position, because three coincidentally similar triangles can always be found in two sets of a few hundred points. An alignment is accepted only when enough nuclei agree (:data:`MIN_INLIERS`, :data:`MIN_CHANCE_RATIO`).
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype#7
records.source: The result also reports how many nuclei agree, which the triangle consensus does not. `align_by_triangles` returned a transform for every pair it was given, including phenotype tiles and sequencing tiles from opposite sides of the well, because three coincidentally similar triangles can always be found in two sets of a few hundred points. An alignment is accepted only when enough nuclei agree (:data:`MIN_INLIERS`, :data:`MIN_CHANCE_RATIO`).
records.translation: 결과는 또한 삼각형 합의가 동의하지 않는 핵의 수를보고합니다. `align_by_triangles`은 그것이 주어진 각 쌍에 대한 변환을 반환, 페노 타입 미크로스코프 이미지 필드를 포함하여, 그리고 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치의 반대 측면에서 미크라 스코프 이미지 필드를 순서화, 왜냐하면 세 우연히 유사한 삼각형은 항상 몇 백 포인트의 두 세트에서 찾을 수 있기 때문에. 조정은 충분한 핵이 동의하는 경우에만 받아 들여집니다 (:data:`MIN_INLIERS`, :data:`MIN_CHANCE_RATIO`).

records.source: Correct base intensities for dye bleed-through between channels.
records.translation: 이미지 데이터 채널 간 염료 번짐(bleed-through)에 대해 염기 강도를 보정합니다.
records.retired_reason: 2026-10-18: superseded by the direct exact-source retranslation of the API summary paragraph in 2026-10-18-api-summary-retranslation.json; kept verbatim as evidence, not loaded.

records.context: Without correction the raw argmax is biased: each dye emits into its neighbours' channels, so a channel that is bright overall wins comparisons it should lose, and the bias is systematic rather than noise: it mis-calls the same base everywhere.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.compensate_crosstalk#1
records.source: Without correction the raw argmax is biased: each dye emits into its neighbours' channels, so a channel that is bright overall wins comparisons it should lose, and the bias is systematic rather than noise: it mis-calls the same base everywhere.
records.translation: 수정이 없으면 원료 argmax는 비어있다 : 각 염료는 이웃의 채널에 배출, 그래서 밝은 전체 채널은 비교를 얻는 그것은 잃어야하고, 비어는 소음 대신 체계적입니다 : 그것은 잘못 동일한 기초를 모든 곳에서.

records.context: The correction is fitted from the data rather than from a calibration file, because it depends on the stain, the filters and the exposure -- which are properties of the run, not of the instrument. For each image data channel, the spots where that image data channel dominates are found, and their mean vector becomes that image data channel's axis; the matrix of those axes, inverted, maps observed intensity back onto base identity.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.compensate_crosstalk#2
records.source: The correction is fitted FROM THE DATA rather than from a calibration file, because it depends on the stain, the filters and the exposure -- which are properties of the run, not of the instrument. For each channel, the spots where that channel dominates are found, and their mean vector becomes that channel's axis; the matrix of those axes, inverted, maps observed intensity back onto base identity.
records.translation: 수정은 칼리브레이션 파일이 아닌 데이터에서 구성되어 있기 때문에, 그것은 염색, 필터 및 노출에 달려있다 - 이것은 도구가 아닌 실행의 특성입니다. 각 이미지 데이터 채널의 경우, 그 이미지 데이터채널이 지배하는 지점이 발견되며, 그 중간 벡터는 그 이미지 데이터 채너의 좌석이됩니다.

records.context: ignore maxima below this. ``None`` keeps every local maximum and leaves the decision to the caller, which is the right default because the useful cutoff depends on the stain.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.find_peaks#4

records.translation: 예를 들어, "The number of features"은 레이블을 반복하는 대신 결과에 설정의 효과를 설명합니다. "더 많은 특징이 더 많은 과잉을 찾고 시간과 메모리 비용을 지불합니다. 약 2000 아래에 넓은 필드가 일치하는 것을 멈추게합니다."그것을 높이거나 낮추는 효과를 나타냅니다.

records.context: Positions come from a least-squares solve, not a walk along the edges. Chaining placements from a seed gives every microscope image field the accumulated error of whatever path reached it, and on a round well the paths are long; solving all the edges at once spreads the residual instead and gives one answer no matter which microscope image field is called the origin.
records.label: spacr.ops_solve.solve_placements#1
records.source: Positions come from a least-squares solve, not a walk along the edges. Chaining placements from a seed gives every tile the accumulated error of whatever path reached it, and on a round well the paths are long; solving all the edges at once spreads the residual instead and gives one answer no matter which tile is called the origin.
records.translation: 시드에서 쇠사슬 위치는 각 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드를 그것에 도달하는 어떤 경로의 축적 된 오류를 제공하고, 라운드에 좋은 경로는 길다; 한 번에 모든 경로를 해결하는 대신 나머지 부분을 확산하고 어떤 마이크로는 이미지 필드가 출처라고 불리는지에 상관없이 하나의 대답을 제공합니다.

records.context: :mod:`spacr.ops_layout` says which microscope image fields touch, :mod:`spacr.ops_register` says how far apart a touching pair is, :mod:`spacr.ops_solve` says where each microscope image field ends up, and this runs the three of them over a microplate sample position and reports what happened.
records.label: spacr.ops_stitch#1
records.source: :mod:`spacr.ops_layout` says which tiles touch, :mod:`spacr.ops_register` says how far apart a touching pair is, :mod:`spacr.ops_solve` says where each tile ends up, and this runs the three of them over a well and reports what happened.
records.translation: :mod:`spacr.ops_layout`는 어떤 마이크로스코프 이미지 필드가 터치하는지, :mod:`spacr.ops_register`는 터치 커플이 얼마나 멀리 있는지 말하고 :mod:`spacr.ops_solve`는 각 마이크로는 이미지가 끝나는 곳을 말하며, 이 세 개는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 넘어서 무슨 일이 일어 났는지 보고합니다.

records.source: **several wells in one image** -- a whole plate, or a strip. Segmenting that directly counts every plaque in every well into one number and loses which well each came from.
records.translation: **한 이미지의 상위 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치** - 전체 실험실 마이크, 또는 스트립. 각 덩어리의 각 플레드를 직접 하나의 숫자로 계산하고 각각에서 온 숫자를 잃어 버리는 분할.

records.context: The microplate sample position is measured, not only cropped. Plaque *area* in pixels is a property of the microscope, not of the biology. The same plaque imaged at two magnifications gives two areas, and a study that pools them is comparing optics. A microplate sample position, by contrast, is a manufactured object of known physical size -- a 6-position laboratory microplate microplate sample position is 34.8 mm whatever images it. So the microplate sample position's diameter in pixels is a ruler that is present in the image itself, and dividing by it turns every area into a physical one that can be pooled across microscopes, objectives and days.
records.label: spacr.plaque#5
records.source: The well is measured, not only cropped. Plaque *area* in pixels is a property of the microscope, not of the biology. The same plaque imaged at two magnifications gives two areas, and a study that pools them is comparing optics. A well, by contrast, is a manufactured object of known physical size -- a 6-well plate well is 34.8 mm whatever images it. So the well's diameter in pixels is a ruler that is present in the image itself, and dividing by it turns every area into a physical one that can be pooled across microscopes, objectives and days.
records.translation: 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치는 측정되지 않습니다. 픽셀의 *영역* 플래크는 생물학이 아닌 미생물의 속성입니다. 두 개의 확대에서 묘사 된 동일한 플레크는 두 가지 영역을 제공하고, 그들을 수영하는 연구는 광학을 비교합니다. 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치는 대조적으로 알려진 물리적 크기의 제조 된 개체입니다 - 6 위치의 실험실 마이크 마이크는 그것을 이미지하는 무엇이든 34.8 mm입니다. 그래서 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 직경은 이미지 자체에 존재하는 컨트롤러이며, 그것에 의해 분할 각 영역은 마이크, 객체 및 날짜를 통해 분할 될 수있는 물리적인 하나로 변환됩니다.

records.context: A row of the regression input table is one laboratory microplate: its score CSV, its count CSV and now its measurements database. This module is the headless half of that feature -- given ``{plate: database path}``, the tables the user ticked and the anchor they chose, it returns the merged frame.
records.label: spacr.plate_measurements#1
records.source: A row of the regression input table is one plate: its score CSV, its count CSV and now its measurements database. This module is the headless half of that feature -- given ``{plate: database path}``, the tables the user ticked and the anchor they chose, it returns the merged frame.
records.translation: 회전 입력 테이블의 일련은 하나의 실험실 마이크로 플레이트입니다 : 그것의 점수 CSV, 그것의 계산 CSV 그리고 지금 그것의 측정 데이터베이스입니다.이 모듈은 그 특징의 헤드없는 절반입니다 - ``{plate: database path}``, 사용자가 탭하고 그들이 선택한 앵커, 그것은 결합 된 프레임을 반환합니다.

records.context: This module adds no merge logic of its own. spaCR already has four places that join measurement tables, and one of them (``io._read_and_join_tables``) aggregates every numeric column with ``mean``, which turns four pathogens' total area into an average area and a minimum into a mean of minima. This module composes existing functions instead:
records.label: spacr.plate_measurements#2
records.source: This module adds no merge logic of its own. spaCR already has four places that join measurement tables, and one of them (``io._read_and_join_tables``) aggregates every numeric column with ``mean``, which turns four pathogens' total area into an average area and a minimum into a mean of minima. This module composes existing functions instead:
records.translation: 이 모듈은 자신의 합병 논리를 추가하지 않습니다. spaCR는 이미 측정 테이블에 합류하는 4 개의 장소를 가지고 있으며, 그 중 하나 (``io._read_and_join_tables``)는 각 숫자 열을 ``mean``로 집합하여 4 병원체의 총 영역을 평균 영역과 최소 영역으로 변환합니다.

records.context: :meth:`spacr.merge_tables.MergePolicy.how_for` decides the join per table, because the cardinality differs -- a cell has one cytoplasm and many pathogens, and an uninfected cell is still a cell.
records.label: spacr.plate_measurements#5
records.source: :meth:`spacr.merge_tables.MergePolicy.how_for` decides the join PER TABLE, because the cardinality differs -- a cell has one cytoplasm and many pathogens, and an uninfected cell is still a cell.
records.translation: :meth:`spacr.merge_tables.MergePolicy.how_for` 의 테이블에 합류를 결정하기 때문에 카디나성은 다릅니다 - 한 세포에는 하나의 시토플라스마와 여러 병원체가 있으며, 감염되지 않은 세포는 여전히 세포입니다.

records.context: Less than :attr:`rows_read_per_source` wherever an inner join removed objects -- a nucleus-less cell, or a pathogen-less one when ``keep_uninfected=False``. The pair is what lets a panel say how many rows were dropped instead of only how many are left.
records.label: spacr.plate_measurements.PlateMerge.rows_per_source#1
records.source: Less than :attr:`rows_read_per_source` wherever an inner join removed objects -- a nucleus-less cell, or a pathogen-less one when ``keep_uninfected=False``. The pair is what lets a panel say how many rows were dropped instead of only how many are left.
records.translation: :attr:`rows_read_per_source`보다 적은 내부 연결이 어디서나 제거된 물체 - 핵이없는 세포, 또는 ``keep_uninfected=False``에서 병원체가 적은 세포.이 쌍은 패널이 얼마나 많은 줄을 떨어 뜨렸는지 대신 몇 줄을 남겼는지 말해 줄 수 있습니다.

records.context: A text identifier that takes ``first`` must have one value per group. When it has more, the column is reported rather than resolved silently. A cell with three pathogens has one ``path_name`` if all three came from the same image; if it has three, ``first`` would name one of them and the merged row would claim a provenance the data does not support.
records.label: spacr.plate_measurements.ambiguous_identifiers#1
records.source: A text identifier that takes ``first`` must have one value per group. When it has more, the column is reported rather than resolved silently. A cell with three pathogens has one ``path_name`` if all three came from the same image; if it has three, ``first`` would name one of them and the merged row would claim a provenance the data does not support.
records.translation: ``first``을 차지하는 텍스트 식별자는 그룹 당 하나의 값을 가져야 합니다. 더 많은 경우, 열은 조용히 해결되는 대신 보고됩니다. 세 가지 병원체를 가진 세 개의 셀은 같은 이미지에서 온 경우 ``path_name``를 가져옵니다. 3 개가 있다면 ``first``는 그들 중 하나를 지정하고 합병 된 행은 데이터가 지원하지 않는 출처를 주장합니다.

records.context: The outer ring of a microtitre laboratory microplate evaporates faster, sits at a different temperature and is handled differently from the interior. A microplate sample position in row A or column 24 that reads three sigma from the laboratory microplate mean is therefore much more likely to be an artefact of *where it sits* than of what is in it.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#1
records.source: The outer ring of a microtitre plate evaporates faster, sits at a different temperature and is handled differently from the interior. A well in row A or column 24 that reads three sigma from the plate mean is therefore much more likely to be an artefact of *where it sits* than of what is in it.
records.translation: 마이크로 타이틀 실험실 마이크로플레이트의 외부 반지는 더 빨리 증발하고, 다른 온도에 앉아서 내부와 다르게 처리됩니다. A 라인 또는 열 24의 마이크를 샘플하는 것은 실험실 마이크로플레이트를 중간으로부터 세 개의 시그마를 읽는 것이므로 *가 앉아있는 곳*의 유물이 될 가능성이 훨씬 더 높습니다.

records.context: **Rank tests, not t-tests.** Per-microplate sample position aggregates of object measurements are routinely skewed and heavy-tailed — a microplate sample position with three enormous cells is not a normal deviate. The ring comparison is a two-sided Mann-Whitney U; the gradient test is Spearman. Neither assumes a shape.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#5
records.source: **Rank tests, not t-tests.** Per-well aggregates of object measurements are routinely skewed and heavy-tailed — a well with three enormous cells is not a normal deviate. The ring comparison is a two-sided Mann-Whitney U; the gradient test is Spearman. Neither assumes a shape.
records.translation: **랭크 테스트, t 테스트가 아닙니다.** 개체 측정의 각 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 집합은 일상적으로 스케이트 및 무거운 테이블 - 3 개의 거대한 세포가있는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치는 정상적인 변동이 아닙니까. 반지 비교는 두 측면의 Mann-Whitney U입니다; 그라디언 테스트는 Spearman입니다.

records.context: False when the laboratory microplate could not be tested at all (empty frame, one microplate sample position, no interior); :attr:`notes` says why.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc.EdgeEffectReport#5
records.source: False when the plate could not be tested at all (empty frame, one well, no interior); :attr:`notes` says why.
records.translation: False 실험실 마이크로 플레이트가 전혀 테스트 될 수 없을 때 (빈 프레임, 하나의 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치, 내부가 없음); :attr:`notes` 이유를 설명합니다.

records.context: zero-based distance from the laboratory microplate edge: zero is the outermost ring, one is one microplate sample position inward, and so on.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc.RingStats#1
records.source: zero-based distance from the plate edge: zero is the outermost ring, one is one well inward, and so on.
records.translation: 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 측면에서 0 기반 거리 : 0은 가장 밖의 반지이며, 하나는 내부에 하나의 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치이며, 등등입니다.

records.context: The outer ring is compared against everything inside it with a two-sided Mann-Whitney U — rank-based, because per-microplate sample position aggregates of object measurements are skewed often enough that a t-test would be testing its own assumptions rather than the laboratory microplate. The accompanying Cliff's delta comes off the same U statistic, so effect size and p-value cannot disagree about which comparison was made.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc.detect_edge_effect#1
records.source: The outer ring is compared against everything inside it with a two-sided Mann-Whitney U — rank-based, because per-well aggregates of object measurements are skewed often enough that a t-test would be testing its own assumptions rather than the plate. The accompanying Cliff's delta comes off the same U statistic, so effect size and p-value cannot disagree about which comparison was made.
records.translation: 외부 반지는 두 측면의 Mann-Whitney U와 비교됩니다 - 순위 기반으로, 왜냐하면 개체 측정의 각 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 집합은 종종 T 테스트가 실험실 마이크로플레이트 대신 자신의 추측을 테스트 할 정도로 충분히 스케이트됩니다.

records.context: The result always spans every row and column of the inferred format, with ``NaN`` — never ``0`` — where a microplate sample position is absent, so a heatmap cannot pass an empty microplate sample position off as a measurement.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc.layout_matrix#1
records.source: The result always spans every row and column of the inferred format, with ``NaN`` — never ``0`` — where a well is absent, so a heatmap cannot pass an empty well off as a measurement.
records.translation: 결과는 항상 결론 형식의 각 라인과 열을 뻗어 ``NaN`` - 결코 ``0`` - 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치가 없으므로 온도지도는 측정으로 빈 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 통과 할 수 없습니다.

records.context: Only the columns needed to place and colour a microplate sample position are selected — a spaCR feature table can be 500 columns wide and half a million rows long, so ``SELECT *`` is avoided.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc.load_plate_frame#1
records.source: Only the columns needed to place and colour a well are selected — a spaCR feature table can be 500 columns wide and half a million rows long, so ``SELECT *`` is avoided.
records.translation: 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치의 위치와 색상에 필요한 열만 선택됩니다 - spaCR 특징 테이블은 500 열 넓고 반 백만 줄 길이 될 수 있으므로 ``SELECT *``는 피됩니다.

records.context: **The grid is nominal, not observed.** The plotter's axes span the microplate sample positions that are present; these span the whole inferred format, so a row nobody pipetted still holds its place on the laboratory microplate and the ring geometry :func:`detect_edge_effect` needs stays intact.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc.plate_layout#4
records.source: **The grid is nominal, not observed.** The plotter's axes span the wells that are present; these span the whole inferred format, so a row nobody pipetted still holds its place on the plate and the ring geometry :func:`detect_edge_effect` needs stays intact.
records.translation: **네트워크는 명칭적이며 관찰되지 않습니다.** 플로터의 좌석은 존재하는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 확장합니다; 이들은 완전한 포맷을 확장하므로 아무도 파이페트하지 않은 라인은 여전히 실험실 마이크로플레이트에 위치하고 있으며 반지 지질 :func:`detect_edge_effect` 필요는 무결하게 남아 있습니다.

records.context: One output row per laboratory microplate row and per laboratory microplate column, each carrying the number of microplate sample positions behind it — a row average over three surviving microplate sample positions is not the same claim as one over twenty-four, which is why ``n_wells`` is reported.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc.row_column_trends#1
records.source: One output row per plate row and per plate column, each carrying the number of wells behind it — a row average over three surviving wells is not the same claim as one over twenty-four, which is why ``n_wells`` is reported.
records.translation: 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 라인에 한 번의 출력 라인, 각각 그 뒤에 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 수를 운반하는 실험소 마이크는 숫자 - 3 생존 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 대한 라인 평균은 24 개 이상의 하나와 동일한 주장이 아닙니다, 그래서 ``n_wells`` 보고됩니다.

records.context: The grid is **read off the data**. It used to be pinned to ``r1..r16`` by ``c1..c27``, so every microplate sample position of a 1536 laboratory microplate past row P or past column 27 fell outside the ``Categorical``, became NaN, and was dropped by the groupby — measured, in the database, and absent from the figure with nothing said. Rows and columns now go through :func:`spacr.plate_qc.parse_row_label` / ``parse_column_label`` (which is :mod:`spacr.schema`'s letter walk, so ``AA``…``AF`` and beyond are real rows), and the axes span exactly the microplate sample positions present: a 96 laboratory microplate is still 8x12 and a 384 still 16x24, because nothing is padded out to the largest format that exists.
records.label: spacr.plot.generate_plate_heatmap#1
records.source: The grid is **read off the data**. It used to be pinned to ``r1..r16`` by ``c1..c27``, so every well of a 1536 plate past row P or past column 27 fell outside the ``Categorical``, became NaN, and was dropped by the groupby — measured, in the database, and absent from the figure with nothing said. Rows and columns now go through :func:`spacr.plate_qc.parse_row_label` / ``parse_column_label`` (which is :mod:`spacr.schema`'s letter walk, so ``AA``…``AF`` and beyond are real rows), and the axes span exactly the wells present: a 96 plate is still 8x12 and a 384 still 16x24, because nothing is padded out to the largest format that exists.
records.translation: 네트워크는 **데이터를 읽어보세요**그것은 옛날에 덮여 있었다. ``r1..r16`` 에 의해 ``c1..c27``, 그래서 1536 실험실 마이크로 플레이트의 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치는 이전 라인 P 또는 이전 열 27 밖에서 떨어졌습니다. ``Categorical``그가 되었으니 NaN, 그리고 그룹비에 의해 떨어졌다 - 데이터베이스에서 측정, 그리고 아무 말도하지 않은 숫자에서 부재. :func:`spacr.plate_qc.parse_row_label` / ``parse_column_label`` (그것은 무엇인가 :mod:`spacr.schema`편지 걷기, 그래서 ``AA``…``AF`` 그리고 그 밖에는 실제 라인이 있고), 그리고 좌석은 정확히 현재의 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 확장합니다 : 96 실험실 마이크로는 여전히 8x12이고 384는 여전히 16x24이기 때문에 아무것도 존재하는 가장 큰 형식으로 묶여 있지 않습니다.

records.context: Outcome of the normality check, which selects the family of test: True runs Tukey HSD, False runs Dunn's test with an automatically chosen p-adjustment. It only matters when post-hoc testing runs at all — see ``unique_groups``. It must be the verdict :meth:`perform_normality_tests` returned, which is :func:`spacr.figures.stats.check_normality`'s. A hand-computed one puts the omnibus test and the pairwise tests on different footing — Kruskal-Wallis across the groups followed by Tukey between them is two different assumptions about one dataset — and it is how the statistical detection sensitivity floor gets bypassed: three replicates buy Dunn's, not Tukey.
records.label: spacr.plot.spacrGraph.perform_posthoc_tests#1
records.source: Outcome of the normality check, which selects the family of test: True runs Tukey HSD, False runs Dunn's test with an automatically chosen p-adjustment. It only matters when post-hoc testing runs at all — see ``unique_groups``. It must be the verdict :meth:`perform_normality_tests` returned, which is :func:`spacr.figures.stats.check_normality`'s. A hand-computed one puts the omnibus test and the pairwise tests on different footing — Kruskal-Wallis across the groups followed by Tukey between them is two different assumptions about one dataset — and it is how the power floor gets bypassed: three replicates buy Dunn's, not Tukey.
records.translation: 정상성 검사의 결과, 테스트 가족을 선택합니다 : True 실행 Tukey HSD에 대하여, False Dunn의 테스트를 자동으로 선택한 p 조정으로 실행합니다. post-hoc 테스트가 실행되는 경우에만 중요합니다. ``unique_groups``그것이 판결이 되어야 한다. :meth:`perform_normality_tests` 돌아오는 것, 그것은 :func:`spacr.figures.stats.check_normality`'s. 수동으로 컴퓨팅 한 사람은 omnibus 테스트와 쌍방향 테스트를 다른 발자국에 놓습니다. - Kruskal-Wallis 그룹에 따라 다음과 같습니다. Tukey 그들 사이에 하나의 데이터 세트에 대한 두 가지 다른 가정이있다 - 그리고 그것은 통계 감지 민감성 바닥이 과장되는 방법입니다 : 세 개의 복제품은 Dunn를 구입하지 않습니다. Tukey.

records.context: **Well dropout from too few imaged cells** (:func:`drop_low_cell_wells`, ``min_cells_per_well=``). A well where the microscope found three cells enters the fit as one observation next to a well with four hundred. Its positive fraction can only be 0, 1/3, 2/3 or 1, and its standard error is several times the machine-learning classification model's whole signal gap. The Poisson offset stops it dominating the scale of the fit; it does not stop its read-fraction covariate being paired with noise. Dropping such microplate sample positions is what an analyst does by hand, and it costs microplate sample positions — so which way the trade comes out is a thing to simulate rather than assert.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate#20
records.source: **Well dropout from too few imaged cells** (:func:`drop_low_cell_wells`, ``min_cells_per_well=``). A well where the microscope found three cells enters the fit as one observation next to a well with four hundred. Its positive fraction can only be 0, 1/3, 2/3 or 1, and its standard error is several times the classifier's whole signal gap. The Poisson offset stops it dominating the scale of the fit; it does not stop its read-fraction covariate being paired with noise. Dropping such wells is what an analyst does by hand, and it costs wells — so which way the trade comes out is a thing to simulate rather than assert.
records.translation: **Well은 너무 적은 이미지 세포** (:func:`drop_low_cell_wells`, ``min_cells_per_well=``)에서 떨어집니다. 마이크로스코프가 세 개의 세포를 발견 한 바닥은 400 개의 바닥 옆에 하나의 관찰으로 적합한 바닥에 들어갑니다. 그것의 긍정적 인 부분은 단지 0, 1/3, 2/3 또는 1이 될 수 있으며, 그것의 표준 오류는 기계 학습 분류 모델의 전체 신호 거리가 여러 배입니다. 물고기 보상은 그것이 적합의 규모를 지배하는 것을 멈추게합니다. 그것은 그것의 읽기-분열 코바리아트가 소음으로 파이어되는 것을 멈추지 않습니다. 그러한 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 떨어 뜨리는 것은 분석가가 수동으로하는 일이며, 그것은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 지불합니다 - 그래서 무역이 나오는 방법은 주장하는 대신 시뮬레이션해야 할 일입니다.

records.context: The Poisson offset does part of the job: a microplate sample position with three cells has a small expected count, so it does not dominate the *scale* of the fit. What the offset does not do is stop the microplate sample position's read-fraction covariate from being paired with a response that is almost pure noise, and in a screen with a long tail of thin microplate sample positions those noisy pairs dilute the covariate-response relationship.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.drop_low_cell_wells#2

records.translation: Poisson 혜택은 작업의 일부입니다 : 3 개의 세포가있는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치는 예상 숫자가 작으므로 적합의 *스케일*을 지배하지 않습니다. 혜산이하지 않는 것은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 읽기 분열 코바리아트가 거의 순수한 소음으로 반응하는 것을 막는 것입니다.

records.context: ``numpy.random.Generator.dirichlet`` draws independent gammas and normalises them. At small concentration the individual gamma draws underflow to exactly ``0.0``, so a gene gets an abundance of exactly zero — measured here, at ``alpha = 0.05`` with 452 categories, numpy produces exact zeros in roughly one draw in ten, and this routine produces none. A zero abundance removes the gene from every well, and the downstream read fraction for that gene becomes ``0 / 0`` in any well where nothing else amplified.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.rdirichlet_stable#1

records.context: **Where the under-dispersed case is approximate, and which way.** A binomial has an integer number of trials, so it cannot hit an arbitrary ``(mean, var)`` pair. Given the rounded ``n``, the success probability is set to ``mean / n`` so the **mean is exact** and the realised variance is ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``, the nearest value the family attains — within about ``1/n`` relative of the request. The mean is the one preserved because it is the biologically meaningful quantity (cells per well) and it sets the scale of everything downstream, whereas a variance off by a percent changes only how wide the well-to-well spread is. Rounding ``n`` while keeping ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` — the naive inversion — biases the *mean* instead, by up to half a count, which is a systematic error in every well of a sweep.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.sample_count_mean_variance#8
records.source: **Where the under-dispersed case is approximate, and which way.** A binomial has an integer number of trials, so it cannot hit an arbitrary ``(mean, var)`` pair. Given the rounded ``n``, the success probability is set to ``mean / n`` so the **mean is exact** and the realised variance is ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``, the nearest value the family attains — within about ``1/n`` relative of the request. The mean is the one preserved because it is the biologically meaningful quantity (cells per well) and it sets the scale of everything downstream, whereas a variance off by a percent changes only how wide the well-to-well spread is. Rounding ``n`` while keeping ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` — the naive inversion — biases the *mean* instead, by up to half a count, which is a systematic error in every well of a sweep.
records.translation: **어디에 분산 된 사례가 대략적이며, 어떤 방식으로.** binomial은 전체 수의 테스트를 가지고 있으므로 자발적인 테스트에 도달 할 수 없습니다. ``(mean, var)`` 둘째, 둥글게 쳐다보면 ``n``성공의 확률은 설정되어 있습니다. ``mean / n`` 그러므로 이 **메인은 정확하다** 실현된 변형은 ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``가장 가까운 가치가 가족에 도달합니다 - 내부에 대 한 ``1/n`` 중간은 생물학적으로 의미있는 양이기 때문에 보존되며, 모든 것의 규모를 아래로 흐르고, 변수는 한 퍼센트로 변하는 반면, 그것은 잘 널리 퍼져있는 넓이를 변경합니다. ``n`` 유지하는 동안 ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` - 낙관적 인 반전 - 비아스 *의미* 대신, 최대 절반의 계산으로, 이는 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 체계적인 오류입니다.

records.context: ``imaging_n_cells_per_well`` is the microplate sample position total, repeated on every row of the microplate sample position. It **is not in the R output** — ``R/fit_model.R`` reads it as the Poisson offset, R's ``$`` partial matching finds three columns with that prefix and returns ``NULL``, and the fit silently loses its offset. It is emitted here because the model half needs it.

records.context: 1. Cells contributing DNA: ``gene_in_well * Count(lambda, var)``. This is normally far larger than the *imaged* count, because sequencing sees the whole well and the microscope sees a few microscope fields of view. 2. Amplification: one lognormal PCR factor per well, ``pcr_factor ~ LogNormal(meanlog=pcr_factor_mu, sdlog=sqrt(pcr_factor_var))``. Note both parameters are on the **log** scale despite their names; a ``pcr_factor_mu`` of 2.0 is a median amplification of ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``. The factor is per well, not per gene, because a well is one PCR reaction — which is exactly why read counts within a well are not independent. 3. Sequencing: reads are drawn from the amplified barcode pool **without replacement** (multivariate hypergeometric), because a finite flow cell reading a finite library is sampling without replacement, and modelling it as multinomial overstates how much independent information deep microplate sample positions carry. 4. **Mis-assignment**, when ``sequencing_error_rate > 0``: a fraction of the reads is credited to the wrong gene. Off by default, because it is not in the R and a silently different baseline would make every number already quoted from this module wrong. See :func:`misassign_reads` for what it models and why it always costs power.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_sequencing_plate#2

Note both parameters are on the **log** scale despite their names; a ``pcr_factor_mu`` of 2.0 is a median amplification of ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``. The factor is per well, not per gene, because a well is one PCR reaction — which is exactly why read counts within a well are not independent. 3. Off by default, because it is not in the R and a silently different baseline would make every number already quoted from this module wrong. See :func:`misassign_reads` for what it models and why it always costs power.
records.translation: 1개 DNA : ``gene_in_well * Count(lambda, var)``에 기여하는 세포. 이것은 일반적으로 *imaged*의 계산보다 훨씬 더 크기 때문에 순서화는 전체를 잘 볼 수 있으며 미생물은 몇 개의 마이크로스코프 시야를 볼 수 있습니다. 2장 확장: 1 개의 lognormal PCR 요소, ``pcr_factor ~ LogNormal(meanlog=pcr_factor_mu, sdlog=sqrt(pcr_factor_var))``. 두 개의 매개 변수는 이름에도 불구하고 **log** 스케일에 있습니다. ``pcr_factor_mu`` of 2.0은 ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``의 중간 증폭이다. 요소는 유전자에 의해서는 안되며, 유전자가 하나의 PCR 반응이기 때문에, 바로 그 이유는 유전자의 내부에서 읽는 계산이 독립적이지 않기 때문입니다. 셋째 순서화 : 읽기는 확장 된 바코드 폴에서 추출됩니다 **대체없이** (다양한 하이퍼지오메트리), 왜냐하면 최종 흐름 세포는 최종 도서관을 읽는 것은 대체없이 샘플링하고, 그것을 모델링하는 것은 멀티미얼이 얼마나 독립적 인 정보 깊은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 운반하는지. 넷째 **Mis-assignment**, ``sequencing_error_rate > 0``: 읽기의 한 부분이 잘못된 유전자에 신용됩니다. 기본적으로 끄기 때문에 그것은 R에 있지 않으며 조용히 다른 기초 라인은이 모듈에서 이미 인용 된 모든 숫자를 잘못 만들 것입니다. 그것이 무엇을 모델링하고 왜 항상 전력 비용을 지불하는지에 대한 :func:`misassign_reads`을 참조하십시오.

records.context: Spectral unmixing comes first. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control microplate sample positions ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw microscope field of view is unmixed across all its image data channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured image data channels and unmixes each microscope field of view before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved processing-session settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#3

records.context: The slot is queued onto the main GUI execution path, so it executes *after* the OS independent execution path has gone. ``make_thread`` also wires ``thread.finished -> thread.deleteLater``, and the same pump that delivers this call flushes that deferred delete first — so ``isRunning()`` raises ``RuntimeError: Internal C++ object already deleted`` from inside a Qt slot. The list comprehension never completes and **every** pair is retained, forever, along with its worker.

records.source: The slot is queued onto the GUI thread, so it runs *after* the OS thread has gone. ``make_thread`` also wires ``thread.finished -> thread.deleteLater``, and the same pump that delivers this call flushes that deferred delete first — so ``isRunning()`` raises ``RuntimeError: Internal C++ object already deleted`` from inside a Qt slot. The list comprehension never completes and **every** pair is retained, forever, along with its worker.
records.translation: 슬롯은 주요 GUI 실행 경로로 묶여 있으므로 *after*를 실행합니다. ``make_thread`` 또한 ``thread.finished -> thread.deleteLater``을 전달하고, 이 호출을 제공하는 동일한 펌프가 먼저 삭제됩니다 - 그래서 ``isRunning()``는 Qt 슬롯의 내부에서 ``RuntimeError: Internal C++ object already deleted``를 올립니다. 목록 이해는 결코 완료되지 않으며 **every** 커플은 워커와 함께 영원히 유지됩니다.

records.context: Some thresholds are not offered here. Local mean and local Gaussian thresholding are not offered again: they are the Adaptive threshold mode, which runs the organelle engine's ``adaptive`` branch with a block size and an offset. Local OTSU is not offered again either: it is the "Local threshold (uneven illumination)" switch in plain Otsu mode, used by whole-image detection. Other named thresholds ignore saved Local Otsu and class-count settings; Multi-Otsu alone uses the selected class count and band in both scopes. Plain Otsu retains its legacy magnifier preprocessing, while the other thresholds use the whole-image engine on the requested extracted image region. Niblack uses ``T = m - k*s``; Sauvola uses ``T = m*(1 + k*(s/R - 1))``, where ``m`` and ``s`` are the local mean and standard deviation. The engine supplies float32 values without rescaling their range, so scikit-image's default Sauvola ``R`` is 1. These formulas are different, and changing the intensity scale can change Sauvola's result.
records.label: spacr.qt.cpu_modes#4
records.source: Some thresholds are not offered here. Local mean and local Gaussian thresholding are not offered again: they are the Adaptive threshold mode, which runs the organelle engine's ``adaptive`` branch with a block size and an offset. Local OTSU is not offered again either: it is the "Local threshold (uneven illumination)" switch in plain Otsu mode, used by whole-image detection. Other named thresholds ignore saved Local Otsu and class-count settings; Multi-Otsu alone uses the selected class count and band in both scopes. Plain Otsu retains its legacy magnifier preprocessing, while the other thresholds use the whole-image engine on the requested crop. Niblack uses ``T = m - k*s``; Sauvola uses ``T = m*(1 + k*(s/R - 1))``, where ``m`` and ``s`` are the local mean and standard deviation. The engine supplies float32 values without rescaling their range, so scikit-image's default Sauvola ``R`` is 1. These formulas are different, and changing the intensity scale can change Sauvola's result.
records.translation: 일부 제한은 여기에 제공되지 않습니다. 현지 중간 및 현지 가우스 제한은 다시 제공되지 않습니다 : 그들은 블록 크기와 할인으로 organelle 엔진의 ``adaptive`` 지점을 실행하는 적응제 제한 모드입니다. 현지 OTSU는 다시 제공되지 않습니다 : 그것은 전체 이미지 탐지에 의해 사용되는 평평한 Otsu 모드에서 "현지 경계 (불평등한 조명)" 스위치입니다. 다른 이름의 한계는 저장된 지역 Otsu 및 클래스 계산 설정을 무시합니다. Multi-Otsu만이 선택한 클래스 숫자와 밴드를 양쪽으로 사용합니다. Plain Otsu는 그것의 유산 확대기 사전 처리를 유지하고, 다른 임계값은 요청 된 추출 된 이미지 지역에 전체 이미지 엔진을 사용합니다. Niblack는 ``T = m - k*s``을 사용합니다. Sauvola는 ``T = m*(1 + k*(s/R - 1))``을 사용하고, ``m``과 ``s``은 지역의 중간 및 표준 변동입니다. 엔진은 그 범위를 재발점하지 않고 float32 값을 공급합니다. 그래서 scikit-image의 기본 Sauvole ``R``은 1.이 수식은 다르며, 강도 스케일을 변경하면 Sauvoli의 결과를 변경할 수 있습니다.

records.context: Extracted image region PNGs are not ordinary images. Anything spaCR wrote before the BGR fix has the first stain in the *blue* image data channel, and a 16-bit single-image data channel extracted image region opened with ``convert('RGB')`` is clipped to solid white by PIL. Both are corrected by :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`, which is therefore the only loader used here, so a hover preview shows the same colours as the annotation grid.
records.label: spacr.qt.crop_thumbs#7
records.source: Crop PNGs are not ordinary images. Anything spaCR wrote before the BGR fix has the first stain in the *blue* channel, and a 16-bit single-channel crop opened with ``convert('RGB')`` is clipped to solid white by PIL. Both are corrected by :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`, which is therefore the only loader used here, so a hover preview shows the same colours as the annotation grid.
records.translation: 추출 된 이미지 영역 PNGs은 일반적인 이미지가 아닙니다. BGR 고정 전에 작성 된 모든 spaCR은 이미지 데이터 채널 *블루*에서 첫 번째 염색을 가지고 있으며, ``convert('RGB')``로 열려있는 16 비트 단일 이미지 데이터 영역은 PIL에 의해 단단한 흰색으로 클립됩니다. 둘 다 :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.load_crop_image`로 수정되며, 따라서 여기에 사용되는 유일한 충전기입니다.

records.context: The defect is not specific to the preview. CPython runs an automatic collection whenever an allocation pushes a generation past its threshold, so the collection executes on the independent execution path that allocated most recently. A Cellpose pass allocates heavily in a background execution unit, so that worker is the likely independent execution path to execute the collection and therefore to destroy unrelated widgets the main GUI execution path released earlier. The resulting crash is timing-dependent, occurs away from the code that created the cycle, and names no file.
records.label: spacr.qt.gc_policy#3
records.source: The defect is not specific to the preview. CPython runs an automatic collection whenever an allocation pushes a generation past its threshold, so the collection runs on the thread that allocated most recently. A Cellpose pass allocates heavily in a worker thread, so that worker is the likely thread to run the collection and therefore to destroy unrelated widgets the GUI thread released earlier. The resulting crash is timing-dependent, occurs away from the code that created the cycle, and names no file.
records.translation: 결함은 사전 보기에 특정하지 않습니다. CPython은 할당이 그 한계를 넘어 세대를 밀어 넣을 때마다 자동 컬렉션을 실행합니다, 그래서 컬레이션은 최근에 할당 된 독립적 인 실행 경로에서 실행됩니다. Cellpose 패스는 배경 실행 단위에 심하게 할당되어, 그래서 워커는 수집을 수행 할 가능성이 독립적으로 실행하는 경로이며 따라서 이전에 발행 된 주요 GUI 실행 도로와 관련이없는 위젯을 파괴합니다.

records.context: Python code that does not release the global interpreter lock can delay the main GUI execution path. :func:`claim` temporarily lowers the interpreter independent execution path-switch interval to :data:`BUSY_INTERVAL`; :func:`release` restores the previous value after the last active worker finishes. Prefer the balanced :func:`responsive_gui` context manager for workflow work.
records.label: spacr.qt.gil_priority#1
records.source: Python code that does not release the global interpreter lock can delay the GUI thread. :func:`claim` temporarily lowers the interpreter thread-switch interval to :data:`BUSY_INTERVAL`; :func:`release` restores the previous value after the last active worker finishes. Prefer the balanced :func:`responsive_gui` context manager for pipeline work.
records.translation: 글로벌 번역기 잠금을 풀지 않는 Python 코드는 주요 GUI 실행 경로를 지연시킬 수 있습니다. :func:`claim`은 독립적 인 실행 경로 스위치 간격을 :data:`BUSY_INTERVAL`로 일시적으로 감소시킵니다. :func:`release`은 마지막 활성 워커가 끝난 후 이전 값을 복원합니다. 작업 흐름 작업을위한 균형 잡힌 :func:`responsive_gui` 컨텍스트 매니저를 선호합니다.

records.context: The setting is process-wide, so it is applied only while a Qt worker is active. Importing this module does not change the switch interval and headless runs incur no cost.
records.label: spacr.qt.gil_priority#2
records.source: The setting is process-wide, so it is applied only while a Qt worker is active. Importing this module does not change the switch interval and headless runs incur no cost.
records.translation: 설정은 프로세스 전반, 그래서 그것은 Qt 워커가 활동하는 동안만 적용됩니다.이 모듈을 가져 오는 것은 스위치 간격을 변경하지 않으며 헤드없는 실행은 비용이 없습니다.

records.context: A shorter interval creates more context switches and can make pure-Python workers marginally slower. NumPy and similar compiled operations generally release the interpreter lock and are less affected.

records.source: A shorter interval creates more context switches and can make pure-Python workers marginally slower. NumPy and similar compiled operations generally release the interpreter lock and are less affected.
records.translation: 짧은 간격은 더 많은 컨텍스트 스위치를 생성하고 순수한 Python 워커를 극도로 느리게 할 수 있습니다. NumPy 및 유사한 컴파일 작업은 일반적으로 번역기 잠금을 풀고 덜 영향을받습니다.

records.context: A combo box whose entries a handler reads back with ``currentText()`` cannot be translated: the caption moves and every comparison misses. That is why the live preview's dropdowns were marked untranslatable outright, and why the ones that were not marked went wrong quietly -- the segmentation object box handed ``cellen`` to a worker that only knows ``cell``, and the threshold method wrote ``medelvärde`` into a setting name that only accepts ``mean``.

records.source: A combo box whose entries a handler reads back with ``currentText()`` cannot be translated: the caption moves and every comparison misses. That is why the live preview's dropdowns were marked untranslatable outright, and why the ones that were not marked went wrong quietly -- the segmentation object box handed ``cellen`` to a worker that only knows ``cell``, and the threshold method wrote ``medelvärde`` into a settings key that only accepts ``mean``.
records.translation: 거래자가 ``currentText()``로 다시 읽는 입력의 컴보 상자는 번역할 수 없습니다 : 꼬리표가 움직이고 각 비교가 사라집니다.이것이 라이브 프리뷰의 떨어지는 상자가 번역 할 수없는 오른쪽으로 표시되었기 때문에 표시되지 않은 상자는 조용히 잘못되었습니다. - 분할 개체 상자는 ``cellen``을 ``cell``만 알고있는 워커에게 전달했으며, 경계 방법은 ``medelvärde``를 ``mean``만 받아들이는 설정 이름으로 작성했습니다.
