records.context: The split keeps the model testable. Five later features build on the layer model — ROI shapes read by Measure, a counting points layer, a label brush with timelapse track curation, orthogonal views with dimension sliders, and a synchronised comparison grid — and every one of them is a change to the model with a small widget on top. Putting the compositing rules in a ``paintEvent`` would make all five untestable without a running ``QApplication``.
records.label: spacr.qt.layer_viewer#2
records.source: The split keeps the model testable. Five later features build on the layer model — ROI shapes read by Measure, a counting points layer, a label brush with timelapse track curation, orthogonal views with dimension sliders, and a synchronised comparison grid — and every one of them is a change to the model with a small widget on top. Putting the compositing rules in a ``paintEvent`` would make all five untestable without a running ``QApplication``.
records.translation: 분할은 모델을 테스트 할 수 있습니다. 다섯 개의 후속 특징은 레이어 모델에 구축 - ROI 모양은 측정에 의해 읽혀, 점수 계산 레이어, 타임 랩스 트랙 치유를 가진 레이블 브러시, 차원 슬라이더를 가진 정형 전망, 그리고 동기화 된 비교 네트워크 - 그들 각각은 작은 위지트를 가진 모델에 대한 변화입니다. ``paintEvent``에 구성 규칙을 넣는 것은 ``QApplication``를 실행하지 않고 모든 다섯을 불안정하게 만듭니다.

Double-clicking asks for it to be opened.

records.context: Two features need a click to mean something other than "select the object under the cursor" — drawing a polygon vertex (:mod:`spacr.qt.roi_tool`) and dropping a counted marker (:mod:`spacr.qt.counting_tool`) — and both need it in *world* coordinates, not widget pixels, so that a point placed at 8× zoom lands where the same point placed at 1× does.

records.source: Two features need a click to mean something other than "select the object under the cursor" — drawing a polygon vertex (:mod:`spacr.qt.roi_tool`) and dropping a counted marker (:mod:`spacr.qt.counting_tool`) — and both need it in *world* coordinates, not widget pixels, so that a point placed at 8× zoom lands where the same point placed at 1× does.
records.translation: 두 가지 특징은 "구조 아래의 개체를 선택"을 의미하는 것 외에 다른 무언가를 의미하는 클릭이 필요합니다 - 폴리곤 베르텍스 (:mod:`spacr.qt.roi_tool`)를 그리며 계산 된 마커 (:mod:`spacr.qt.counting_tool`)을 떨어 뜨리며, 둘 다 *world* 코디네이트에서 필요합니다, 비게이트 픽셀이 아닙니다, 그래서 8×에 위치한 포인트가 1×에 배치 된 동일한 점이있는 지점이있는 곳에서 땅을 니다.

records.context: With ``fn`` given, removes it only if that is the opener currently registered. records.source: With ``fn`` given, removes it only if that is the opener currently registered. A closing screen should always pass its own opener: two Annotate screens opened in a session means the first one's ``closeEvent`` runs *after* the second has registered, and an unconditional withdrawal would leave the live screen unreachable.
records.translation: 와 함께 ``fn`` 예를 들어, 그것은 오픈이 현재 등록 된 경우에만 제거됩니다. 폐쇄 응용 프로그램 전망은 항상 자신의 오픈을 통과해야합니다 : 두 개의 어노테이션 응용 분야 전망이 한 세션에서 열리는 것은 첫 번째를 의미합니다. ``closeEvent`` 실행 *후에* 두 번째는 등록되어 있으며, 무조건 철회는 라이브 응용 프로그램 보기를 접근 할 수 없게합니다.

records.context: The old behaviour here was ``label(mask > 0)``, which renumbers the connected components 1..N on every save. That throws away the identity of every object: erase object 7 of 20 and objects 8..20 each slide down by one, so the saved mask no longer structured-data names against the measurements, the extracted image regions or the tracks derived from the segmentation it was edited from.
records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.canonical_labels#1
records.source: The old behaviour here was ``label(mask > 0)``, which renumbers the connected components 1..N on every save. That throws away the identity of every object: erase object 7 of 20 and objects 8..20 each slide down by one, so the saved mask no longer keys against the measurements, the crops or the tracks derived from the segmentation it was edited from.
records.translation: 여기서 오래된 행동은 ``label(mask > 0)``이었고, 각 저장소에 연결된 구성 요소 1..N을 다시 이름을 지정합니다.이것은 각 개체의 정체성을 제거합니다 : 20 개의 개체 7를 제거하고 8..20 개체는 각각 하나로 내려가므로 저장된 마스크는 더 이상 측정, 추출 된 이미지 영역 또는 그것이 편집 된 분할에서 발생하는 트랙에 대하여 구조화되지 않습니다.

records.context: An absolute tolerance is not a portable setting. The value that grabs one nucleus in an 8-bit microscope field of view (range 0..255) selects nothing at all in a 16-bit one (range 0..65535), and the one tuned for 16-bit floods the entire 8-bit frame. A percentage of *this* image's own range means one number behaves the same on both.
records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.relative_tolerance#1
records.source: An absolute tolerance is not a portable setting. The value that grabs one nucleus in an 8-bit field (range 0..255) selects nothing at all in a 16-bit one (range 0..65535), and the one tuned for 16-bit floods the entire 8-bit frame. A percentage of *this* image's own range means one number behaves the same on both.
records.translation: 절대적 관용은 휴대용 설정이 아닙니다. 8 비트 현미경 시야(0..255 범위)에서 하나의 핵을 캡처하는 값은 16 비트 (0..65535 범위), 그리고 16비트를 위해 톤 한 값이 전체 8비트 프레임을 홍수하지 않습니다. *이* 이미지 자체 범위의 비율은 하나의 숫자가 둘 다 동일하게 행동한다는 것을 의미합니다.

records.context: The floor of 1.0 keeps the wand usable on a flat field: a range of zero would otherwise give a tolerance of zero, and a tolerance of zero fills only pixels exactly equal to the seed.

Measure then spends hours cropping and measuring those masks without anyone having read it. records.context: **The diameter.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` measures characteristic object size from a handful of the user's own fields, without loading Cellpose or torch. ``diameter`` is the single most consequential Cellpose 4 setting spaCR exposes — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` rescales every image by ``30/diameter`` so objects land near the size ``cpsam`` works at — and it is the one users guess at.  The panel this module builds replaces the guess with a measurement, per object type, and shows how many objects it measured so the estimate can be judged.  It opens in a popup of its own from the *Measure diameters…* button in Mask generation's Model zoo popup, next to the choice of model it is the other half of, rather than on the main application view.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun#3
records.source: **The diameter.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` measures characteristic object size from a handful of the user's own fields, without loading Cellpose or torch. ``diameter`` is the single most consequential Cellpose 4 setting spaCR exposes — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` rescales every image by ``30/diameter`` so objects land near the size ``cpsam`` works at — and it is the one users guess at.  The panel this module builds replaces the guess with a measurement, per object type, and shows how many objects it measured so the estimate can be judged.  It opens in a popup of its own from the *Measure diameters…* button in Mask generation's Model zoo popup, next to the choice of model it is the other half of, rather than on the main screen.
records.translation: **의 직경.** :mod:`spacr.diameter`는 사용자의 자신의 필드의 몇 개에서 특징적인 개체 크기를 측정하고, 충전하지 않고 Cellpose 또는 torch. ``diameter``는 단일 가장 결과적인 Cellpose 4 설정 spaCR 노출입니다. — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)``은 각 이미지를 ``30/diameter``로 해독하여 ``cpsam`` 크기에 가까운 물체가 작동합니다. — 이 모듈을 구축하는 패널은 개체 유형에 따라 측정으로 추측을 대체합니다., 그것은 *측정 직경에서 자신의 팝업에서 열립니다...* 버튼은 마스크 세대의 모델 동물원 폴업, 모델의 선택 옆에 그것은 다른 절반입니다, 대신 주요 응용 프로그램의 관점에서.

records.context: A suggestion is judged, not relabelled. An extracted image region Suggest proposed a class for wears an amber ``?`` badge beside its dashed ring. A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Scanning a plate's worth of ND2 headers takes seconds; converting takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.

records.context: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#3
records.source: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.translation: **그것은 무엇입니까.**모든 개체에 레이블이 들어오지 않은 벡터를 제공합니다. 측정 패널은 셀이 얼마나 크고 각 염색이 얼마나 밝았는지 알려줍니다. 임베딩은 세포가 어떻게 보이는지, 수백 개의 숫자에서 훈련 된 척추가 무엇을 찾고 있는지 알려지지 않고 생산합니다. 그것은 그것을 대체하는 대신 패널을 보완합니다.

records.context: spaCR measures hundreds of features per object, so instead of plotting one column such as ``cell_area`` by condition, this application view shows which features differ between classes and by how much: every continuous column is scored against a class column and sorted by separation, with the distributions of the top few drawn underneath.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.feature_explorer#1

records.translation: spaCR은 개체 당 수백 개의 특징을 측정하므로 ``cell_area``과 같은 한 열을 조건에 따라 삽입하는 대신이 응용 프로그램 보기에서는 클래스 사이의 특징이 얼마나 다르는지를 보여줍니다 : 각 연속 열은 클래식 열에 맞서 점수되고 분리하여 분류되며, 상단 숫자의 분포가 아래로 끌려 있습니다.

records.context: Assembles the ranking panel with the Local Data Filter (so a ranking can be restricted to one plate without leaving the application view) and the formula panel (so a derived feature is ranked alongside the measured ones). records.source: Assembles the ranking panel with the Local Data Filter (so a ranking can be restricted to one plate without leaving the screen) and the formula panel (so a derived feature is ranked alongside the measured ones). records.translation: 순위 패널을 로컬 데이터 필터 (그래서 순위는 응용 프로그램 전망을 떠나지 않고 하나의 플레이트로 제한 될 수 있음) 및 공식 패널 (그래서는 추출 된 특징이 측정 된 것 옆에 순위됩니다). 순위가 :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`을 통해 배경 실행 단위에서 실행됩니다 : 200 개 이상의 개체의 400 개의 특징은 각 특징의 종류이며, 주요 GUI 실행 경로를 실행하면 창을 냉동 할 것입니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.lineage#1
records.source: In ``measurements.db``, ``nucleus`` and ``pathogen`` rows carry a ``cell_id`` naming the cell they sit inside (:data:`spacr.schema.CHILD_OBJECT_TABLES`). records.translation: 안에서 ``measurements.db``, ``nucleus`` 그리고 ``pathogen`` 라인은 A를 가져옵니다. ``cell_id`` 내부에 앉아있는 셀의 이름 (:data:`spacr.schema.CHILD_OBJECT_TABLES`이 애플리케이션 뷰는 나무와 같은 링크를 보여줍니다, 그래서 어떤 세포가 감염되지 않은, 어떤 병원체가 그것 주위의 세포에 대 한 무의미하게 큰, 어떤 핵은 어떤 셀에 속하지 전혀 검사에 의해 대답 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: A child whose ``cell_id`` names no cell is dropped by every join in the codebase. records.label: spacr.qt.screens.lineage.LineageScreen.collision_note#1
records.source: **Normally empty.** The object key carries the object type, so a cell's nucleus 1 and its pathogen 1 are two keys. The check is kept to report a regression in which keys collide again; without it, "opening four objects showed three crops" would have no explanation on screen.
records.translation: **정상적으로 빈.** 개체 키는 개체 유형을 가지고 있으므로 세포의 핵 1과 병원체 1은 두 개의 열쇠입니다. 체크는 열쇠가 다시 충돌하는 회복을보고하기 위해 유지됩니다; 그렇지 않으면, "4 개의 개체를 열면 3 개의 추출 된 이미지 영역을 보여줍니다" 화면에 설명이 없을 것입니다.

records.context: De-duplicated while keeping order: selecting a cell and one of its pathogens must not open that pathogen twice.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.lineage.LineageScreen.family_keys#1
records.source: De-duplicated while keeping order: selecting a cell and one of its pathogens must not open that pathogen twice.
records.translation: 주문을 유지하는 동안 복제 : 세포와 그 병원체 중 하나를 선택하면 병원체를 두 번 열지 않아야합니다.

records.context: The de-duplication is on the shared key, which is what the routing contract takes. That key carries the object type, so a cell's nucleus 1 and pathogen 1 stay two keys; if keys ever collide, fewer keys than objects are returned and :meth:`collision_note` reports it on application view.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.lineage.LineageScreen.family_keys#2
records.source: The de-duplication is on the shared key, which is what the routing contract takes. That key carries the object type, so a cell's nucleus 1 and pathogen 1 stay two keys; if keys ever collide, fewer keys than objects are returned and :meth:`collision_note` reports it on screen.
records.translation: 이 키는 개체 유형을 가지고 있으므로 세포의 핵 1과 병원체 1은 두 개의 키가 남아있다; 키가 결코 충돌하면 개체보다 더 적은 키가 반환되고 :meth:`collision_note` 응용 프로그램 보기에서 보고됩니다.

records.context: Make Masks is filed under **Tools** on the home application view and is the manual half of segmentation: it corrects masks a model got wrong, one microscope field of view at a time, and its masthead opens the Cellpose workflows that produced them. :class:`MakeMasksScreen` loads images and labelled masks from ``<folder>/masks`` and saves edited labels as ``uint16`` TIFF files.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#1
records.source: Make Masks is filed under **Tools** on the home screen and is the manual half of segmentation: it corrects masks a model got wrong, one field at a time, and its masthead opens the Cellpose workflows that produced them. :class:`MakeMasksScreen` loads images and labelled masks from ``<folder>/masks`` and saves edited labels as ``uint16`` TIFF files.
records.translation: Make Masks은 홈 애플리케이션 보기에서 **도구** 아래에 삽입되며 수동 절반의 분할입니다 : 그것은 잘못된 모델의 마스크를 수정하고, 한 마이크로스코프 필드를 동시에 볼 수 있으며, 그것의 마스트 헤드는 그들을 생성하는 Cellpose 작업 흐름을 열어줍니다. :class:`MakeMasksScreen` ``<folder>/masks``에서 이미지와 표시 된 마스크와 편집 된 라벨을 ``uint16`` TIFF 파일로 저장합니다.

records.context: A fold that reimplemented the module it replaced would keep whatever the person doing the folding happened to think of and quietly drop the rest. So the button opens the module's OWN widget: every control, every worker, every drop target it had as a tile is what arrives, and the only thing that changed is where it is opened from.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.FoldedModulePanel#1
records.source: A fold that reimplemented the module it replaced would keep whatever the person doing the folding happened to think of and quietly drop the rest. So the button opens the module's OWN widget: every control, every worker, every drop target it had as a tile is what arrives, and the only thing that changed is where it is opened from.
records.translation: 그가 대체 한 모듈을 다시 구현 한 플레드는 플레드를 만드는 사람이 무엇이든 생각하고 조용히 나머지를 떨어 뜨리는 것을 유지할 것입니다. 그래서 버튼은 모듈의 OWN 위젯을 열어줍니다 : 각 컨트롤, 각 워커, 각 방울 목표는 플레드로 가지고있다 그것이 도착하는 것입니다, 그리고 변경 된 유일한 것은 그것이 열려있는 곳입니다.

records.context: Closing the panel is not enough. A module polls the machine's RAM and GPU on a background execution unit, and Qt answers an executing QThread being destroyed by aborting the process — so the module's own close handler, which drains that worker, has to execute. A page nested inside another module's tabs never gets one from Qt, which is why they are closed by hand here.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScreen.close_folded#1
records.source: Closing the panel is not enough. A module polls the machine's RAM and GPU on a worker thread, and Qt answers a running QThread being destroyed by aborting the process — so the module's own close handler, which drains that worker, has to run. A page nested inside another module's tabs never gets one from Qt, which is why they are closed by hand here.
records.translation: 패널을 닫는 것만으로는 충분하지 않습니다.모듈은 기계의 RAM을 조사하고 GPU 배경 실행 단위에, 그리고 Qt 실행에 대한 응답 QThread 과정을 파괴함으로써 파괴된다 - 그래서 모듈의 자신의 가까운 매니저, 그 워커를 추출, 실행해야합니다. Qt 그래서 여기서 손으로 닫혀 있습니다.

records.context: The two panes are filled BEFORE the mask is touched, and they are filled even when the run found nothing at all. A run that returns an empty mask is exactly the run whose probability map you need to see: it says whether the network found nothing, or found plenty and the threshold threw it away.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScreen.run_cellpose#1
records.source: The two panes are filled BEFORE the mask is touched, and they are filled even when the run found nothing at all. A run that returns an empty mask is exactly the run whose probability map you need to see: it says whether the network found nothing, or found plenty and the threshold threw it away.
records.translation: 두 개의 패널은 마스크가 접촉되기 전에 채워지고, 그들은 실행이 전혀 아무것도 찾지 못했을 때조차도 채워집니다. 빈 마스크를 반환하는 실행은 확률지도를 볼 필요가있는 실행입니다 : 그것은 네트워크가 아무것도를 찾지 않았는지, 또는 많은 것을 발견하고 임계값이 그것을 던졌는지 여부를 말합니다.

records.context: one of :data:`FOLD_ORDER`. Note that this is the button's key, not its host's: the two Cellpose halves share a screen and seed different halves of it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScreen.seed_folded#2
records.source: one of :data:`FOLD_ORDER`. Note that this is the button's key, not its host's: the two Cellpose halves share a screen and seed different halves of it.
records.translation: :data:`FOLD_ORDER`에 해당되는 글 1건 이것이 호스트가 아닌 버튼의 열쇠라는 점을 명심하십시오 : 2 개의 Cellpose 절반은 화면을 공유하고 다른 절반을 시드합니다.

records.context: Segment one field with ``model``; return labels and both intermediates.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.cellpose_detect#0
records.source: Segment one field with ``model``; return labels and both intermediates.
records.translation: ``model``로 한 필드를 분할; 반환 라벨과 두 개의 중간.

records.context: The image goes in as a **batch of one**, which is what :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.parse_cellpose4_output` — the repository's own reader of this return value — is written for. Handed a bare 2-D array instead, ``eval`` returns a flat three-member flows list and that function reads ``len(masks)`` as the number of images and finds the image height, so the parse fails on an image that segmented perfectly well.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.cellpose_detect#1
records.source: The image goes in as a **batch of one**, which is what :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.parse_cellpose4_output` — the repository's own reader of this return value — is written for. Handed a bare 2-D array instead, ``eval`` returns a flat three-member flows list and that function reads ``len(masks)`` as the number of images and finds the image height, so the parse fails on an image that segmented perfectly well.
records.translation: 그림은 **batch의 하나**로 들어가며, 이는 :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.parse_cellpose4_output` -이 반환 값의 저장소 자체 리더 -에 대해 쓰여집니다. 대신 2D 라인을 사용하면 ``eval``는 평평한 3 구성원 흐름 목록을 반환하고 그 기능은 이미지의 숫자로 ``len(masks)``를 읽고 이미지 높이를 찾으므로 퍼스가 완벽하게 잘 분할 된 이미지에 실패합니다.

records.context: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the workflow itself calls: it maps every pre-SAM name onto ``cpsam``, keeps a fine-tuned checkpoint path as itself, and raises rather than quietly substituting stock weights for a checkpoint that is not there. Going around it with a second, simpler call would give this screen a different answer from the processing session it is meant to be correcting.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.load_cellpose_model#1
records.source: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the pipeline itself calls: it maps every pre-SAM name onto ``cpsam``, keeps a fine-tuned checkpoint path as itself, and raises rather than quietly substituting stock weights for a checkpoint that is not there. Going around it with a second, simpler call would give this screen a different answer from the run it is meant to be correcting.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained`은 작업 흐름 자체가 호출하는 것입니다 : 그것은 ``cpsam``에 모든 pre-SAM 이름을 지도하고, 깔끔하게 조정된 체크 포인트 경로를 유지하고, 거기에 있지 않은 체크포인트에 대한 주식 가중치를 조용히 대체하는 대신 상승합니다.

records.context: The Barcode QC page assesses reads per microplate sample position, low-depth microplate sample positions, unmapped reads, barcode collisions, positional effects, library coverage and the resulting abundance threshold. It opens beside the Map Barcodes settings with its full settings form, run controls, console and figures.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.map_barcodes#1
records.source: The Barcode QC page assesses reads per well, low-depth wells, unmapped reads, barcode collisions, positional effects, library coverage and the resulting abundance threshold. It opens beside the Map Barcodes settings with its full settings form, run controls, console and figures.
records.translation: 바코드 QC 페이지는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치, 낮은 깊이 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치, 맵화되지 않은 읽기, 바 코드 충돌, 위치 효과, 도서관 커버 및 결과 풍부한 범위에 따라 읽기를 평가합니다. 그것은 Map Barcodes 설정 외에 완전한 설정 형식, 실행 컨트롤, 콘솔 및 숫자와 함께 열립니다.

records.context: The integrated tracking preview evaluates object linkage across frames, whereas the standard Mask preview evaluates segmentation of an individual microscope field of view. Motility analysis remains under Measure because it quantifies existing masks and writes measurements rather than generating masks.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask#4
records.source: The integrated tracking preview evaluates object linkage across frames, whereas the standard Mask preview evaluates segmentation of an individual field. Motility analysis remains under Measure because it quantifies existing masks and writes measurements rather than generating masks.
records.translation: 통합 추적 예보는 프레임을 통해 개체 연결을 평가하고, 표준 마스크 예보에서는 개별 현미경 시야의 분열을 평가합니다.모틸리티 분석은 기존 마스크를 양화하고 마스크 생성하는 대신 측정을 작성하기 때문에 측정 아래에 남아 있습니다.

records.context: Generate an example plate and apply its settings to Mask Generation.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask.load_the_example_images#0
records.source: Generate an example plate and apply its settings to Mask Generation.
records.translation: 예제 플레이트를 생성하고 마스크 세대에 설정을 적용합니다.

records.context: The folder is not read here. This executes in the Make Masks button handler, on the main GUI execution path, and ``folder`` is a path the user chose, which can be on a network share or a sleeping automount where a stat blocks. The walk is :meth:`MeasureInputTable.add_dropped`'s, on a worker, and the table fills in a moment later.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.measure_inputs.open_measure_inputs#5
records.source: The folder is not read here. This runs in the Make Masks button handler, on the GUI thread, and ``folder`` is a path the user chose, which can be on a network share or a sleeping automount where a stat blocks. The walk is :meth:`MeasureInputTable.add_dropped`'s, on a worker, and the table fills in a moment later.
records.translation: 폴더는 여기서 읽을 수 없습니다. 이것은 주요 GUI 실행 경로에 있는 Make Masks 버튼 매니저에서 실행되며, ``folder``는 사용자가 선택한 경로이며, 이는 네트워크 주식이나 잠자는 자동차에 있는 상태 블록이 있는 곳에 있을 수 있습니다. 산책은 워커에 :meth:`MeasureInputTable.add_dropped`이며, 테이블은 잠시 후에 채워집니다.

records.context: **The caveats are not optional.** Which QC flags fired, whether illumination correction ran, the seed, the ``on_error`` policy and what it dropped, the machine-learning classification model's held-out metrics — the digest collects them and the Methods section has to state every one. A draft that drops one is refused for that alone.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.methods_export#5
records.source: **The caveats are not optional.** Which QC flags fired, whether illumination correction ran, the seed, the ``on_error`` policy and what it dropped, the classifier's held-out metrics — the digest collects them and the Methods section has to state every one. A draft that drops one is refused for that alone.
records.translation: **카베이트는 선택적이지 않습니다.** QC 깃발이 던져졌는지, 조명 수정이 진행되었는지 여부, 시드, ``on_error`` 정책과 그것이 떨어지는 것, 기계 학습 분류 모델의 유지-out 메트릭 - 소화가 그들을 수집하고 방법 섹션은 각각 언급해야합니다.

records.context: The constructor for a caller that has no run to point it at. Regression seeds one instead — see :func:`spacr.qt.screens.regression.build_methods_export`, which fills in the project and the results folder that screen is already reading.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.methods_export.make_methods_export_screen#1
records.source: The constructor for a caller that has no run to point it at. Regression seeds one instead — see :func:`spacr.qt.screens.regression.build_methods_export`, which fills in the project and the results folder that screen is already reading.
records.translation: 그것을 지적 할 수없는 호출자를위한 건축가. Regression 시드 하나 대신 - 프로젝트에 채우는 :func:`spacr.qt.screens.regression.build_methods_export`을 참조하고 이미 스크린이 읽고있는 결과 폴더를 참조하십시오.

records.context: Multi-image data channel microscope fields of view are collapsed to their max projection rather than a mean: a nucleus image data channel averaged with an empty image data channel is a dim nucleus. Contrast is a 1-99.9 percentile stretch, the same window :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.normalize_uint16` uses. A missing or wrong-shaped image comes back black rather than throwing, because the backdrop is only context for the masks.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_compare.to_display_gray#1
records.source: Multi-channel fields are collapsed to their max projection rather than a mean: a nucleus channel averaged with an empty channel is a dim nucleus. Contrast is a 1-99.9 percentile stretch, the same window :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.normalize_uint16` uses. A missing or wrong-shaped image comes back black rather than raising, because the backdrop is only context for the masks.
records.translation: 다중 이미지 데이터 채널 마이크로스코프 시야 필드는 중간 대신 그들의 최대 프로젝션에 붕괴됩니다 : 비어있는 이미지 데이터채널과 중간의 핵 이미지 데이터 센터는 더러운 핵입니다. 대조는 1-99.9 센티일 스트레치, 동일한 창 :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.normalize_uint16`를 사용합니다. 실종되거나 잘못 형성 된 이미지는 던지기보다는 검은 색으로 돌아옵니다, 왜냐하면 배경은 마스크에 대한 단지 맥락이기 때문입니다.

records.context: ``SECTION_EXPLORE`` rather than ``SECTION_RESULTS``. Results & QC holds screens that return a verdict; this one returns flags, and :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.OutlierResult.filtered` is the only place a row is dropped, and only when it is called explicitly.
records.translation: ``SECTION_EXPLORE`` 대신 ``SECTION_RESULTS``. 응용 프로그램 보기는 처리 세션의 출력을 신뢰하는지 여부에 대해 걱정하지만, 데이터 선택 제한 편집기와 그 옆의 특징 탐색기와 같이 작동합니다 : 사용자는 특징과 제한을 고치고, 출력은 **열**를 필터링하거나 데이터 선택의 제한입니다. 결과 & QC는 판결을 반환하는 응용량 보기를 보유하고 있습니다.이 하나는 깃발을 반복하고, :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.OutlierResult.filtered`는 유일한 장소 일련이 떨어지고, 그것이 명시적으로 호출되는 경우에만.

records.context: A spaCR project holds masks, a measurements database, extracted image regions, model weights, predictions, regression tables and figures. Some of those were made from each other. An outdated value cannot be recognised from the value itself.

records.source: A spaCR project holds masks, a measurements database, crops, model weights, predictions, regression tables and figures. Some of those were made from each other. Some were made from a *previous* version of another, for example when the mask step was re-run with a different diameter and nothing downstream was. An outdated value cannot be recognised from the value itself.
records.translation: spaCR 프로젝트는 마스크, 측정 데이터베이스, 추출 된 이미지 영역, 모델 가중치, 예측, 회전 테이블 및 숫자를 보유하고 있습니다. 그 중 일부는 서로 만들어졌습니다. 일부는 다른 *전* 버전에서 만들어졌으며, 예를 들어 마스크 단계가 다른 직경으로 다시 실행되었을 때 아무것도 아래로 흐르지 않았습니다. 오래된 값은 값 자체에서 인식 할 수 없습니다.

records.context: **An empty microplate sample position is drawn as empty.** Microplate sample positions with no objects, or fewer than ``min_count``, are hatched — never coloured as if they measured zero. records.source: **An empty well is drawn as empty.** Wells with no objects, or fewer than ``min_count``, are hatched — never coloured as if they measured zero. The count of dropped wells is on screen, because a heatmap quietly missing a third of its wells looks exactly like data.
records.translation: **빈 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치는 빈 것으로 추출됩니다.** ``min_count``보다 적은 개체가없는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치는 헤치됩니다 - 그들이 0을 측정하는 것처럼 결코 색칠되지 않습니다.

records.context: ``threaded=False`` (which every test in ``test_plate_view.py`` and ``test_plate_view_linked_filter.py`` constructs the screen with) runs the job inline through :meth:`_run_job`, so those callers still get the old meaning exactly. A caller that needs to know the grid is up waits on :meth:`active_jobs`, as ``render_plate``'s callers already do -- ``render_plate`` has returned "started, not finished" since the database read was with worker execution, and this is the same promise.

records.source: ``threaded=False`` (which every test in ``test_plate_view.py`` and ``test_plate_view_linked_filter.py`` constructs the screen with) runs the job inline through :meth:`_run_job`, so those callers still get the old meaning exactly. A caller that needs to know the grid is up waits on :meth:`active_jobs`, as ``render_plate``'s callers already do -- ``render_plate`` has returned "started, not finished" since the database read was threaded, and this is the same promise.
records.translation: ``threaded=False``(``test_plate_view.py``와 ``test_plate_view_linked_filter.py``의 모든 테스트가 화면을 이 값으로 생성합니다)는 :meth:`_run_job`을 통해 작업을 인라인으로 실행하므로, 이 호출자들은 기존 의미를 그대로 얻습니다. 그리드가 준비되었는지 알아야 하는 호출자는 :meth:`active_jobs`를 기다리며, ``render_plate``의 호출자들이 이미 그렇게 하고 있습니다 -- 데이터베이스 읽기가 스레드로 옮겨진 이후 ``render_plate``는 "started, not finished"(시작됨, 완료되지 않음)를 반환해 왔으며, 이것도 같은 약속입니다.

records.context: The ones flagged ``changes_the_number`` are always visible; the rest are behind a "show all" toggle, so a caveat that changes the result, such as "the R version overstates statistical detection sensitivity", is not listed at the same weight as a minor one such as the COM-Poisson third moment.

records.translation: 깃발 ``changes_the_number``은 항상 눈에 띄는; 나머지는 "show all" 타그글 뒤에 있으므로 결과를 변경하는 카베이트, 예를 들어 "R 버전은 통계 감지 민감성을 초과합니다"는 COM-Poisson의 세 번째 순간과 같은 작은 하나와 동일한 가중치로 나열되지 않습니다.

records.context: run sweeps on a :func:`~spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` worker (the shipped behaviour). ``False`` runs the identical code inline and emits the identical signals, which is what the tests use to get a deterministic result without pumping an event loop.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.power.PowerScreen#1
records.source: run sweeps on a :func:`~spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` worker (the shipped behaviour). ``False`` runs the identical code inline and emits the identical signals, which is what the tests use to get a deterministic result without pumping an event loop.
records.translation: 실행은 :func:`~spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 워커 (배송 된 행동)에 맹세합니다. ``False``은 동일한 코드를 인라인으로 실행하고 동일 한 신호를 발행합니다.이것은 테스트가 이벤트 루프를 펌프하지 않고 결정적인 결과를 얻기 위해 사용하는 것입니다.

records.context: The fit itself is atomic — there is no safe point inside an ADVI optimisation to abandon — so this sets the event the sweep's ``on_point`` hook checks between grid points, and asks the worker to cancel as well so the processing session registry and Home see it too.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.power.PowerScreen.cancel#1
records.source: The fit itself is atomic — there is no safe point inside an ADVI optimisation to abandon — so this sets the event the sweep's ``on_point`` hook checks between grid points, and asks the worker to cancel as well so the run registry and Home see it too.
records.translation: 적합 자체는 원자입니다 - ADVI 최적화 안에 포기할 안전점이 없습니다 - 그래서 이것은 스위프의 ``on_point`` 호크가 네트워크 포인트 사이를 확인하는 이벤트를 설정하고 워커에게 또한 취소하도록 요청하여 처리 세션 레지스트리와 홈도 볼 수 있습니다.

records.context: **And neither does opening the application view, nor opening its folder chooser.** Two things here take a path the user typed on some *other* application view: the search folders :func:`make_project_browser_screen` seeds from the recent-source list, and the folder the "Add folder…" dialog starts in. Neither is checked with ``os.path.isdir`` on the main GUI execution path: measured on one workstation, one such folder was under an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep, and a single ``isdir`` on it had not returned after twenty seconds, freezing the whole application with no traceback. Both ask :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, which answers from a cache and stats in the background. Those two are the whole inventory: the walk executes on a worker, and every column, note and detail line the application view draws is rendered from the frozen :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` that walk already returned, so filling the table and the detail pane reads nothing.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.project_browser#6
records.source: **And neither does opening the screen, nor opening its folder chooser.** Two things here take a path the user typed on some *other* screen: the search folders :func:`make_project_browser_screen` seeds from the recent-source list, and the folder the "Add folder…" dialog starts in. Neither is checked with ``os.path.isdir`` on the GUI thread: measured on one workstation, one such folder was under an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep, and a single ``isdir`` on it had not returned after twenty seconds, freezing the whole application with no traceback. Both ask :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, which answers from a cache and stats in the background. Those two are the whole inventory: the walk runs on a worker, and every column, note and detail line the screen draws is rendered from the frozen :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` that walk already returned, so filling the table and the detail pane reads nothing.
records.translation: **그리고 응용 프로그램 보기를 열지도 않고, 그것의 폴더 선택기를 열지도 않습니다.** 여기에 두 가지가 *other* 앱 보기에 사용자가 인쇄 한 경로를 가져옵니다: 검색 파일은 최근 출처 목록에서 :func:`make_project_browser_screen` 시드를 맺고, 폴드에서는 "Add folder…" 대화가 시작됩니다. 또한 주요 GUI 실행 경로에서 ``os.path.isdir``을 검사하지 않습니다 : 하나의 작업 스테이션에서 측정, 하나의 그러한 폴더는 ``autofs`` 마운트 아래에 있었고, 그 부분은 잠들었고, 단 하나의 ``isdir``는 20 초 후에 돌아 오지 않았으며, 전체 응용 프로그램을 냉동하지 않았다. 둘 다 :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`을 묻고, 카시에서 응답하고 배경에있는 통계를 제공합니다. 이 두 개는 전체 인벤토리입니다 : 걸음은 워커에 실행되며, 각 열, 노트 및 애플리케이션 전망 라인은 얼어 붙은 :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary`에서 추출되므로 걸음이 이미 돌아 왔으므로 테이블과 세부 사항 패널을 채우면 아무것도 읽지 않습니다.

records.context: `path_probe` is not used for the folder guard. It answers optimistically, so it could only ever say "go on and read", which the worker then checks anyway; a second guard on the main GUI execution path would only allow the two answers to disagree. The application view's messages are unchanged; they appear when the worker finishes.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.qc_dashboard.QCDashboardScreen.refresh#3
records.source: `path_probe` is not used for the folder guard. It answers optimistically, so it could only ever say "go on and read", which the worker then checks anyway; a second guard on the GUI thread would only allow the two answers to disagree. The screen's messages are unchanged; they appear when the worker finishes.
records.translation: `path_probe`은 폴더 경비원에 사용되지 않습니다.이 응답은 낙관적으로, 그래서 그것은 단지 "go on and read"을 말할 수있다, 그 후에 워커가 어쨌든 확인; 주요 GUI 실행 경로에 두 번째 경비원은 단지 두 개의 응답이 동의하지 않을 수 있습니다.

records.context: whether a read of the disk was started. Reading inline (``threaded=False``) that is exact, because the worker half has already run and reported by the time this returns. With worker execution, it means the job was started: the fingerprint is not taken yet, so "nothing changed" arrives later, on the status line.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.qc_dashboard.QCDashboardScreen.refresh#5
records.source: whether a read of the disk was started. Reading inline (``threaded=False``) that is exact, because the worker half has already run and reported by the time this returns. Threaded, it means the job was started: the fingerprint is not taken yet, so "nothing changed" arrives later, on the status line.
records.translation: 디스크의 읽기가 시작되었는지 여부. 읽기 인 라인 (``threaded=False``) 그것은 정확하기 때문에 워커의 절반은 이미 실행되었고이 시간에 보고됩니다. 워커의 실행으로, 그것은 작업이 시작되었다는 것을 의미합니다 : 지문은 아직 취하지 않습니다, 그래서 "nothing changed" 나중에, 상태 라인에 도착합니다.

records.context: **Methods & Results** builds the processing-session digest -- package versions, timings, seed and error policy, per-module parameters parsed out of the emitted macro, the segmentation verdict, artifact counts, held-out metrics -- drafts the two sections from it and then mechanically checks every number in the draft back against the digest. It opens seeded with the project the regression screen is already pointed at, so the path it otherwise asks the user to type is filled in.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#4
records.source: **Methods & Results** builds the run digest -- package versions, timings, seed and error policy, per-module parameters parsed out of the emitted macro, the segmentation verdict, artifact counts, held-out metrics -- drafts the two sections from it and then mechanically checks every number in the draft back against the digest. It opens seeded with the project the regression screen is already pointed at, so the path it otherwise asks the user to type is filled in.
records.translation: **Methods & Results**는 프로세서 세션 디저트를 구축합니다 - 패키지 버전, 타이밍, 시드 및 오류 정책, 매 모듈 매개 변수는 발행 된 매크로, 분할 판결, 아티팩트 계산, -out 메트릭 - 그것의 두 섹션을 설계하고 그 후에 기계적으로 각 숫자를 검사합니다.

When two runs match, the table says "no differences" in words rather than going blank.
records.translation: **The diff는 뷔페되며, 결코 깔끔하지 않습니다.** 그것은 :func:`spacr.train_compare.diff_settings`을 회전합니다. :mod:`spacr.run_journal`에서 출처 버켓링을 다시 사용 : 환경 드리프트 (도로, 호스트는 워커 계산)은 사용자가 변경한 것으로 계산되는 대신 자신의 뷔페에 표시됩니다. 그리고 스케줄 드라이브는 요약됩니다. 두 개의 처리 세션이 일치하면 테이블은 흰색이 아닌 단어로 "no differences"을 말합니다.

records.context: Images are 16-bit uint16. Every image data channel of a microscope field of view is drawn from *one shared cell layout*, so the nucleus really is inside the cell and the pathogen really is inside the same cell — the relationships measure_crop goes looking for when it links objects.

records.source: Images are 16-bit uint16. Every channel of a field is drawn from *one shared cell layout*, so the nucleus really is inside the cell and the pathogen really is inside the same cell — the relationships measure_crop goes looking for when it links objects.
records.translation: 이미지는 16비트 uint16입니다.모든 이미지 데이터 채널은 마이크로스코프 시야에서 추출됩니다. *하나의 공유 셀 레이아웃*그래서 핵은 실제로 세포 안에 있고 병원체는 실제로는 같은 세포 내에 있습니다. measure_crop 그것은 물건을 연결할 때 찾는 것입니다.

records.context: Every generator is *reproducible*: identical inputs give byte-identical output on any machine, so two people comparing "the demo fails here" look at the same pixels. Seeds are not taken from ``hash((well, field, time, chan))``, which PYTHONHASHSEED salts differently at every interpreter start.
records.label: spacr.qt.synthetic#8
records.source: Every generator is *reproducible*: identical inputs give byte-identical output on any machine, so two people comparing "the demo fails here" look at the same pixels. Seeds are not taken from ``hash((well, field, time, chan))``, which PYTHONHASHSEED salts differently at every interpreter start.
records.translation: 각 발전기는 *reproducible*입니다: 동일한 입력은 모든 기계에서 비트-동일한 출력을 제공합니다, 그래서 "the demo fails here"를 비교하는 두 사람은 같은 픽셀을보고 있습니다. 시드는 ``hash((well, field, time, chan))``에서 빼앗기지 않으며, PYTHONHASHSEED는 각 번역가의 시작 부분에서 다른 방식으로 소금을 섭취합니다.

This function writes that format, and ``spacr.utils._map_wells_png`` reads back its four parts: plate, row, column, and field.

records.source: **Crop names match.** A real crop is ``<file_name>_<cell_id>.png`` where ``file_name`` is the merged stack's ``<plate>_<well>_<field>_<time>`` (:func:`spacr.utils._generate_names`) — e.g. ``plate1_A01_1_1_1.png``. That is exactly what this writes, and exactly what ``spacr.utils._map_wells_png`` parses plate/row/column/field back out of.
records.translation: **이미지 크롭 이름은 생산 형식을 사용합니다.** 각 크롭은 ``<file_name>_<cell_id>.png``입니다. ``file_name``는 ``<plate>_<well>_<field>_<time>`` (:func:`spacr.utils._generate_names`), 예를 들어 ``plate1_A01_1_1_1.png``를 포함합니다.이 기능은 그 형식을 작성하고 ``spacr.utils._map_wells_png``는 그것의 네 부분을 다시 읽습니다 : 플레이트, 라인, 열 및 필드.

records.source: Every read is one (column, gRNA, row) triplet in the frame the shipped barcode-mapping defaults parse, so ``unique_combinations.csv`` comes back with the planted wells and guides in it. Reads are spread evenly over the ``rows x columns`` wells, and within a well over the gRNAs with a skew, because a real screen has a handful of abundant guides and a long tail.
records.translation: 각 리스트는 하나 (콜럼, gRNA, 라인) 프레임에 배송 된 바코드-지도 기본 패스, 그래서 ``unique_combinations.csv`` 그것에 삽입 된 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치와 가이드와 함께 돌아옵니다. 리스트가 균일하게 ``rows x columns`` 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 퍼져, 그리고 gRNAs 위에 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 내에서 스케이와 함께, 왜냐하면 실제 스크린 실험은 풍부한 가이드의 손잡이와 긴 꼬리를 가지고 있기 때문에.

records.source: The single accessor every container should use, including the ones styled inline rather than through :func:`stylesheet`. Those were the gap: Home's aside panels, the dock and the tile boxes all read :func:`active_palette` directly, which returns **raw hex**, so they stayed fully opaque no matter what the preference said and the setting looked broken from the page the user lands on.
records.translation: 각 컨테이너는 단일 액세서리를 사용해야합니다, 그 중 하나는 :func:`stylesheet` 대신 인라인으로 스타일링 된 것들을 포함합니다.이것은 격차였습니다 : 홈의 측면 패널, 도크 및 타일 상자는 모두 :func:`active_palette`를 직접 읽고, **raw hex**를 반환하여 사용자가 땅에있는 페이지에서 찢어 보였습니다.

records.context: Makes the same test Qt makes: is the object's own independent execution path the calling independent execution path? Qt refuses whenever they differ, which happens both ways round -- a worker touching a GUI object, and the main GUI execution path touching a worker-affine object; the second is easier to write by accident because the code reads as ordinary main GUI execution path code.
records.label: spacr.qt.thread_guard.install._wrong_thread#1
records.source: Makes the same test Qt makes: is the object's own thread the calling thread? Qt refuses whenever they differ, which happens both ways round -- a worker touching a GUI object, and the GUI thread touching a worker-affine object; the second is easier to write by accident because the code reads as ordinary GUI-thread code.
records.translation: 같은 테스트 Qt를 수행 : 개체의 독립적 인 실행 경로가 독립적인 실행 길이라고 부르는가? Qt는 그들이 다를 때마다 거부합니다, 이는 두 가지 길을 둘러싸고 일어납니다 - GUI 개체를 만지는 워커, 그리고 워커와 관련된 개체에 만지는 주요 GUI 실행 도로; 두 번째는 코드가 일반적인 주요 실행 방법 코드 GUI로 읽기 때문에 우연히 쓰기 쉽습니다.

records.context: 1. **Directional runaway detection and trimming** — :func:`trim_directional_runaway` measures flood width along scanlines extending from the seed. A sustained abrupt expansion marks a leak, and pixels beyond that position are removed. Detection at this stage enables the following two refinements. 2. **Intensity-constrained reflooding** — :func:`wand_region` performs a binary search for the highest tested tolerance that does not trigger runaway detection. The resulting connected region replaces the straight-line directional cut. 3. **Gradient-based boundary refinement** — :func:`taper_region_to_intensity` applies a watershed to a smoothed intensity gradient within a configurable band, moving the provisional boundary toward a nearby image edge.
records.label: spacr.qt.wand_rescue#3
records.source: 1. **Directional runaway detection and trimming** — :func:`trim_directional_runaway` measures flood width along scanlines extending from the seed. Detection at this stage enables the following two refinements. 2. **Intensity-constrained reflooding** — :func:`wand_region` performs a binary search for the highest tested tolerance that does not trigger runaway detection. The resulting connected region replaces the straight-line directional cut. 3. **Gradient-based boundary refinement** — :func:`taper_region_to_intensity` applies a watershed to a smoothed intensity gradient within a configurable band, moving the provisional boundary toward a nearby image edge.
records.translation: **방향 경로 탐지 및 트리밍** — :func:`trim_directional_runaway`은 시드에서 확장되는 스캔 라인에 따라 홍수 폭을 측정합니다., 그리고 그 위치를 넘어 픽셀이 제거됩니다.이 단계에서 발견은 다음과 같은 두 개의 개선을 가능하게합니다. 2. **강도 제한 반수** — :func:`wand_region`은 가장 높은 테스트 된 관용을위한 바이너리 검색을 수행합니다.이 결과 연결된 지역은 직선 방향 절단을 대체합니다.3.**그라디언트 기반 국경 개선** — :func:`taper_region_to_intensity`은 조정 가능한 밴드 내에서 부드러운 강도 그라디언트에 물을 적용하여 임시 경계를 가까운 이미지 경계로 이동합니다.

records.context: A pixel joins when its distance from the seed's value is at most ``tolerance`` -- absolute difference on a grey image, Euclidean distance across image data channels on a colour one -- and it is reachable from the seed through four-connected steps. records.translation: 픽셀은 시드의 값으로부터의 거리가 최대 ``tolerance``인 경우에 합류합니다 - 회색 이미지의 절대 차이, 색상 하나의 이미지 데이터 채널을 통한 유클리드 거리 - 그리고 시드에서 4단계로 접근할 수 있습니다. 두 가지 규칙은 :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.magic_wand`입니다, 그래서이 반환 지역은 밴드가 픽셀 예산을 제공하지 않으면 채우는 지역입니다.

records.context: In that historical ``blobs`` benchmark, the rate goes from 17.3 fps to 24.7 on the same worker. What this does **not** address is a genuinely chatty run: at 200 lines a second both land at about 4 fps, because by then the main GUI execution path is inside ``ConsolePanel`` and not in here at all. Two levers finish the job and neither is in this file — ``sys.setswitchinterval(0.001)`` in the Qt bootstrap (measured independently: 32 % of the frame rate to 99 %, for about 6 % of the worker's throughput) and coalescing ``PipelineWorker.line_ready``.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#55
records.source: In that historical ``blobs`` benchmark, the rate goes from 17.3 fps to 24.7 on the same worker. What this does **not** address is a genuinely chatty run: at 200 lines a second both land at about 4 fps, because by then the GUI thread is inside ``ConsolePanel`` and not in here at all. Two levers finish the job and neither is in this file — ``sys.setswitchinterval(0.001)`` in the Qt bootstrap (measured independently: 32 % of the frame rate to 99 %, for about 6 % of the worker's throughput) and coalescing ``PipelineWorker.line_ready``.
records.translation: 이 역사적인 ``blobs`` 참조에서 속도는 동일한 워커에서 17.3 fps에서 24.7로 이동합니다.이 **not** 주소는 진정으로 흥미로운 실행입니다.: 200 라인에서 두 땅은 약 4 fps, 왜냐하면 그때부터 주요 GUI 실행 경로는 ``ConsolePanel`` 안에 있고 여기서 전혀 들어 있지 않기 때문입니다. — Qt 부트 스트랩에서 ``sys.setswitchinterval(0.001)`` (독립적으로 측정): 프레임 비율의 32 %에서 99 %까지, 워커의 통과량의 약 6 %에 대 한) 및 콜레스팅 ``PipelineWorker.line_ready``.

records.context: An engine owns no widget and no timer. It holds the constants rolled once from its seed, a clock (:attr:`time`), and whatever reusable buffer it paints through. Everything it draws is a pure function of ``(seed, time, width, height, colours, background)`` — which is what lets a test render the same frame twice and compare it byte for byte, and what lets :meth:`AmbientWidget.set_theme` swap engines without the animation jumping.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientEngine#1
records.source: An engine owns no widget and no timer. It holds the constants rolled once from its seed, a clock (:attr:`time`), and whatever reusable buffer it paints through. Everything it draws is a pure function of ``(seed, time, width, height, colours, background)`` — which is what lets a test render the same frame twice and compare it byte for byte, and what lets :meth:`AmbientWidget.set_theme` swap engines without the animation jumping.
records.translation: 엔진은 비지트와 타이머를 소유하지 않습니다.그것은 그것의 시드에서 한 번 롤 된 일정을 유지, 시계 (:attr:`time`), 그리고 그것을 통해 그것을 재사용 할 수있는 버퍼는 무엇이든 그림.모든 그것은 ``(seed, time, width, height, colours, background)``의 순수한 기능입니다 - 그것은 테스트가 동일한 프레임을 두 번 만들고 바이트에 비트를 비교 할 수있게하고, :meth:`AmbientWidget.set_theme` 애니메이션 점프없이 엔진을 교환 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: Rays rise from an irregular folded lower edge, fan gently toward the sky, and breathe at different rates. A diffuse sheet joins the rays without a flat rectangular top or repeated texture tiles. The frame raster is native at ordinary Detail, within the physical screen-pixel budget, and is returned with independent ownership. :data:`AURORA_BUFFER_EDGE` remains the legacy comparison edge; it no longer caps the active buffer.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AuroraEngine#1
records.source: Rays rise from an irregular folded lower edge, fan gently toward the sky, and breathe at different rates. A diffuse sheet joins the rays without a flat rectangular top or repeated texture tiles. The frame raster is native at ordinary Detail, within the physical screen-pixel budget, and is returned with independent ownership. :data:`AURORA_BUFFER_EDGE` remains the legacy comparison edge; it no longer caps the active buffer.
records.translation: 빛은 불규칙하게 덮여있는 낮은 가장자리에서 상승하고, 천천히 하늘을 향해 팬, 그리고 다른 속도로 호흡합니다. 분산 된 잎은 평평한 직경 꼭대기 또는 반복 된 텍스트 타일이없는 빛에 합류합니다. 프레임 라스터는 일반적인 세부 사항, 물리적 스크린 픽셀 예산 내에서 원주민이며, 독립적 인 소유권으로 반환됩니다. :data:`AURORA_BUFFER_EDGE`는 유산 비교 가장자리에 남아있다; 그것은 더 이상 활성 버퍼를 캡처하지 않습니다.

records.context: :meth:`geometry` yields ``(x, y_bottom, visible_height, brightness)`` per sampled column of every curtain, in pixels, ``AURORA_COLUMNS + 1`` of them per curtain in curtain order. The painter builds its paths from exactly those numbers, so a test that tracks a fold crest through ``geometry`` is tracking the crest that is on application view. ``brightness`` is the travelling surge. Seeded irregular ray positions and independent continuous length and brightness cycles modulate the sampled sheet, with tapered tops. Roll the aurora's bands and their drift.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AuroraEngine#2
records.source: :meth:`geometry` yields ``(x, y_bottom, visible_height, brightness)`` per sampled column of every curtain, in pixels, ``AURORA_COLUMNS + 1`` of them per curtain in curtain order. The painter builds its paths from exactly those numbers, so a test that tracks a fold crest through ``geometry`` is tracking the crest that is on screen. ``brightness`` is the travelling surge. Seeded irregular ray positions and independent continuous length and brightness cycles modulate the sampled sheet, with tapered tops. Roll the aurora's bands and their drift.
records.translation: :meth:`geometry`은 각 커튼의 샘플링 콜론에 ``(x, y_bottom, visible_height, brightness)``, 픽셀, ``AURORA_COLUMNS + 1`` 그들의 커튼에 커튼 순서로. 그림자는 정확히 그 숫자에서 자신의 경로를 구축, 그래서 ``geometry``을 통해 폴드 크리스를 추적하는 테스트는 응용 프로그램 시선에있는 크리스스를 추적합니다. ``brightness``는 여행 상승입니다. 시드가 불규칙한 라인 위치와 독립적 인 지속적인 길이와 밝기 사이클은 템플링 된 잎을 조정합니다.

records.context: One value per entry in :data:`AURORA_TILE_RAYS`, quantised into :data:`AURORA_LENGTH_STEPS` so the tile stays cacheable -- a length that followed the clock exactly would rebuild every tile every frame, which is the cost the tile cache exists to avoid.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AuroraEngine.ray_lengths#1
records.source: One value per entry in :data:`AURORA_TILE_RAYS`, quantised into :data:`AURORA_LENGTH_STEPS` so the tile stays cacheable -- a length that followed the clock exactly would rebuild every tile every frame, which is the cost the tile cache exists to avoid.
records.translation: :data:`AURORA_TILE_RAYS`의 입력당 1개의 값, :data:`AURORA_LENGTH_STEPS`로 양화되어 타일이 숨겨져있어 시계를 따르는 길이는 각 타일 각 프레임을 재건할 것입니다.

records.context: Three directions, one expression each, and all three are pure functions of the clock — no accumulated state, so ``set_time`` still jumps anywhere and two engines on the same seed still agree.

records.source: Three directions, one expression each, and all three are pure functions of the clock — no accumulated state, so ``set_time`` still jumps anywhere and two engines on the same seed still agree.
records.translation: 세 방향, 하나의 표현 각각, 그리고 세 가지 모두 시계의 순수한 기능입니다 - 축적 된 상태가 없으므로 ``set_time``은 여전히 어디서나 점프하고 동일한 시드에있는 두 엔진은 여전히 동의합니다.

records.context: The engine evaluates ``z <- z**2 + c`` for a primary form and optional derived buds. records.source: The engine evaluates ``z <- z**2 + c`` for a primary form and optional derived buds. records.translation: 엔진은 ``z <- z**2 + c``을 기본 형태와 선택적 인 추출 덩어리로 평가합니다. Hashed 지속적인 상태는 깊이, 밀도, 움직임 및 인구를 시드와 애니메이션 시간의 순수한 기능으로 제어합니다. 렌더 비용은 프레임 사이에 측정되며 필요한 경우 버퍼 해상도와 부드 계산을 줄이기 위해 사용됩니다. :meth:`geometry` 첫 번째 :class:`Form`를 반환합니다.

records.context: :data:`ESTIMATOR_MOVING_RANGE` Individuals / moving range (I-MR). One control value per laboratory microplate is the normal case in a screen, so this is what :data:`ESTIMATOR_AUTO` picks when every laboratory microplate contributes a single control microplate sample position. Sigma is ``mean(|x_i - x_{i-1}|) / 1.128``; 1.128 is d2 for a subgroup of two, which is what a moving range of consecutive points is.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart#10
records.source: :data:`ESTIMATOR_MOVING_RANGE` Individuals / moving range (I-MR). One control value per plate is the normal case in a screen, so this is what :data:`ESTIMATOR_AUTO` picks when every plate contributes a single control well. Sigma is ``mean(|x_i - x_{i-1}|) / 1.128``; 1.128 is d2 for a subgroup of two, which is what a moving range of consecutive points is.
records.translation: :data:`ESTIMATOR_MOVING_RANGE` 개별 / 움직이는 범위 (I-MR). 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 당 하나의 컨트롤 값은 스크린에서 정상적인 경우입니다, 그래서 이것이 :data:`ESTIMATOR_AUTO` 픽업을 할 때 각 실험소 마이크로는 단일 제어 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 기여합니다. 시그마는 ``mean(|x_i - x_{i-1}|) / 1.128``; 1.128은 2의 하위 그룹에 대한 d2입니다, 즉 연속 포인트의 이동 범위가 무엇입니까.

records.context: :data:`ESTIMATOR_SUBGROUP_S` X-bar / S, for a laboratory microplate with several control microplate sample positions (subgroup ``n > 1``). The plotted point is the laboratory microplate's mean and sigma is ``S-bar / c4(n)``, where :func:`c4` is computed from the gamma function rather than looked up in a table. The published table stops at n = 25, does not interpolate, and is prone to transcription errors. ``c4(n) = sqrt(2/(n-1)) · Γ(n/2) / Γ((n-1)/2)`` is three lines, is exact for every n, and can be checked against the published constant — ``c4(5) = 0.9400`` — which is what the test does.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart#11
records.source: :data:`ESTIMATOR_SUBGROUP_S` X-bar / S, for a plate with several control wells (subgroup ``n > 1``). The plotted point is the plate's mean and sigma is ``S-bar / c4(n)``, where :func:`c4` is computed from the gamma function rather than looked up in a table. The published table stops at n = 25, does not interpolate, and is prone to transcription errors. ``c4(n) = sqrt(2/(n-1)) · Γ(n/2) / Γ((n-1)/2)`` is three lines, is exact for every n, and can be checked against the published constant — ``c4(5) = 0.9400`` — which is what the test does.
records.translation: :data:`ESTIMATOR_SUBGROUP_S` X-bar / S, 여러 컨트롤 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 (subgroup ``n > 1``)를 가진 실험실 마이크로플레이트에 대 한. 삽입 된 포인트는 실험실 마이크로플레이트를 중간 및 시그마는 ``S-bar / c4(n)``, :func:`c4`는 테이블에서 보이는 대신 가마 기능에서 계산됩니다. 게시 된 표는 n = 25에서 멈추지 않습니다, 그것은 인터폴, 그리고 트랜스크립트 오류에 취약합니다. ``c4(n) = sqrt(2/(n-1)) · Γ(n/2) / Γ((n-1)/2)``는 세 라인, 각 n에 정확하고, 게시 된 일정 - ``c4(5) = 0.9400``에 대하여 검사 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: :func:`zprime_frame` computes the per-laboratory microplate Z-factor when both a positive and a negative control are named, and :func:`zprime_chart` charts it with everything above — same estimator, same rules, same baseline. A Z' that slides from 0.7 to 0.3 over a campaign is a drift in assay quality and is detected the same way.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart#28
records.source: :func:`zprime_frame` computes the per-plate Z-factor when both a positive and a negative control are named, and :func:`zprime_chart` charts it with everything above — same estimator, same rules, same baseline. A Z' that slides from 0.7 to 0.3 over a campaign is a drift in assay quality and is detected the same way.
records.translation: :func:`zprime_frame`은 긍정적이고 부정적인 컨트롤이 모두 이름을 붙인 경우 실험실 마이크로플레이트 Z 요소를 계산하고, :func:`zprime_chart`은 위의 모든 것과 함께 그것을 차트합니다 - 동일한 추정기, 동일하는 규칙, 같은 기본 라인.

records.translation: 실험실 마이크로 플레이트에 대한 정렬 통계 - 컨트롤 값, 또는 실험소 마이크로는 한 개 이상의 컨트리 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치가 있는 경우의 평균 제어 값.

records.context: Both controls need at least two microplate sample positions on a laboratory microplate for the SD to exist, so a laboratory microplate with a single positive microplate sample position produces no Z' and is left out rather than given a zero.

records.source: Both controls need at least two wells on a plate for the SD to exist, so a plate with a single positive well produces no Z' and is left out rather than given a zero.
records.translation: 두 컨트롤은 SD가 존재하기 위해 실험실 마이크로 플레이트에 적어도 두 개의 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치가 필요하므로 단 하나의 긍정적 인 미생물을 가진 실험물 마이크로는 Z를 생성하지 않으며 0을 주는 대신 밖으로 남겨집니다.

records.context: Per-column hues come from a **second** RNG rather than the main one. Drawing them from the main stream would have shifted every length, speed and start row by one draw, so a seeded rain would have fallen differently depending on a purely cosmetic setting. Two streams keep ``snapshot()`` byte-identical whether random colour is on or off.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dna_rain.DnaRainEngine#2
records.source: Per-column hues come from a **second** RNG rather than the main one. Drawing them from the main stream would have shifted every length, speed and start row by one draw, so a seeded rain would have fallen differently depending on a purely cosmetic setting. Two streams keep ``snapshot()`` byte-identical whether random colour is on or off.
records.translation: 각 열 흐름은 **초** RNG 대신 주요에서 온다.그들을 그리면 주요 스트림에서 각 길이, 속도 및 시작 라인을 하나의 스트림으로 전환 할 것입니다, 그래서 시드 비는 순전히 화장품 조건에 따라 다르게 떨어질 것입니다.두 스트림은 ``snapshot()`` 바이트 동일 하 여 우연한 색상이 켜져 있거나 꺼져 있는지 여부를 유지 합니다.

records.context: Random colour is *per column*, and a column is one falling string among a hundred. Rolling all three HSL components would have given the field a scatter of near-blacks, near-whites and greys — most of which do not read as glyphs at 20 % opacity behind a settings form. Only the hue is random; saturation and lightness are taken from the colour in the picker, floored and clamped so the result is always a colour and always visible.

records.translation: 우연한 색상은 *열*이며, 열은 100개 중 하나가 떨어지는 줄입니다. HSL의 세 가지 구성 요소 모두를 롤하면 필드에 가까운 블랙, 가까운 흰색과 회색의 분산이있을 것입니다. 대부분은 설정 형태 뒤에 20 %의 무시성으로 글리프로 읽지 않습니다. 단지 흐름은 우연합니다. 만족과 가벼움은 피커의 색상에서 가져옵니다. 꽃과 빛이 흐르므로 결과는 항상 색상이며 항상 눈에 띄는 것입니다.

records.context: A residual bootstrap was the other candidate and was rejected. It shares the profile's homoscedastic-normal assumption so it buys no robustness; it needs a seed and gives a slightly different published number per seed; and — the deciding objection — percentiles of a bootstrap distribution are *always* finite, so it reports a confident-looking interval for an unidentified parameter in precisely the situation that matters. Nothing here resamples and nothing here is random: the same data gives the same interval, every time.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#20
records.source: A residual bootstrap was the other candidate and was rejected. It shares the profile's homoscedastic-normal assumption so it buys no robustness; it needs a seed and gives a slightly different published number per seed; and — the deciding objection — percentiles of a bootstrap distribution are *always* finite, so it reports a confident-looking interval for an unidentified parameter in precisely the situation that matters. Nothing here resamples and nothing here is random: the same data gives the same interval, every time.
records.translation: 남은 bootstrap는 다른 후보였고 거절되었다. 그것은 프로필의 동성애-정상적인 가정을 공유하여 안정성을 구입하지 않습니다; 그것은 시드를 필요로하고 시드 당 약간 다른 출판 번호를 제공합니다; 그리고 - 결정적 인 반대 - bootstrap 분배의 퍼센티일은 *항상* 끝, 그래서 그것은 정확히 중요한 상황에서 식별되지 않은 매개 변수에 대한 자신감 보이는 간격을보고합니다.

records.context: the pooled estimate on the log10 scale, which is where the pooling is actually done -- EC50s are log-normal, so averaging them in linear units weights the high plates more than the data warrants.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.PooledFit#12
records.source: the pooled estimate on the log10 scale, which is where the pooling is actually done -- EC50s are log-normal, so averaging them in linear units weights the high plates more than the data warrants.
records.translation: 합성 계산은 log10 스케일, 즉 합성이 실제로 이루어지는 곳입니다 - EC50s 그들은 로그-정상, 그래서 그들을 중간으로 선형 단위는 데이터 보증보다 높은 플레이트를 가중치.

records.context: Pooling is two-stage. Each plate is fitted on its own -- by the same :func:`fit_dose_response` that fits everything else, with the same refusals -- and the per-plate log10 EC50s are then combined with a random-effects weight. One joint nonlinear mixed model would be the other way to do it; it would also mean a second fitting path with a second set of failure modes, and a plate that :func:`fit_dose_response` refuses would have to be refused again, differently, inside it. This way a refusal on one plate is the same refusal :func:`fit_dose_response` reports.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.PooledFit#2
records.source: Pooling is two-stage. Each plate is fitted on its own -- by the same :func:`fit_dose_response` that fits everything else, with the same refusals -- and the per-plate log10 EC50s are then combined with a random-effects weight. One joint nonlinear mixed model would be the other way to do it; it would also mean a second fitting path with a second set of failure modes, and a plate that :func:`fit_dose_response` refuses would have to be refused again, differently, inside it. This way a refusal on one plate is the same refusal :func:`fit_dose_response` reports.
records.translation: 수영은 두 단계입니다. 각 플레이트는 다른 모든 것과 일치하는 동일한 :func:`fit_dose_response`에 의해, 같은 거부와 함께, 그 자체로 장착되며, EC50s은 우연한 효과 가중치와 결합됩니다. 하나의 공동 비선형 혼합 모델은 그것을 할 수있는 다른 방법이 될 것입니다; 그것은 또한 실패 모드의 두 번째 세트와 함께 두 번째 적합 경로를 의미하고, :func:`fit_dose_response` 거부하는 플레이트는 다시 거부해야합니다, 다르게, 그 안에. 따라서 하나의 플레이트에 대한 거부는 거부 :func:`fit_dose_response` 보고서와 동일합니다.

records.context: The pooling uses random rather than fixed effects. Fixed-effect pooling assumes every plate measures the same value and differs only by noise. Three tight plates that disagree then give a narrow interval around a value none of them support. The DerSimonian-Laird estimate of the between-plate variance is added to each plate's own, so real variation between plates widens the answer instead of being weighted away.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.PooledFit#3
records.source: The pooling uses random rather than fixed effects. Fixed-effect pooling assumes every plate measures the same value and differs only by noise. Three tight plates that disagree then give a narrow interval around a value none of them support. The DerSimonian-Laird estimate of the between-plate variance is added to each plate's own, so real variation between plates widens the answer instead of being weighted away.
records.translation: 융합은 고정 효과가 아닌 우연한 효과를 사용합니다. 고정-효과 결합은 각 플레이트가 동일한 값을 측정하고 소음에 의해만 다릅니다. 3 개의 단단한 플레이가 동의하지 않는 다음 그들 중 하나가 지원하지 않는 값 주위에 좁은 간격을 제공합니다. DerSimonian-Laird는 각 플레이의 자신의 차이를 추정합니다, 그래서 플레이 사이의 실제 변형은 가중치가 떨어지는 대신에 대답을 확장합니다.

records.context: The interactive twin of :func:`spacr.regression_qc._panel_influence`. It shows what the volcano cannot: whether a hit reflects the data as a whole or a single microplate sample position. A microplate sample position far to the right has an unusual combination of guides; a microplate sample position far up or down is poorly predicted; a microplate sample position that is both is one whose removal moves the coefficients, and Cook's distance is the product that says so.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.InfluencePlot#1
records.source: The interactive twin of :func:`spacr.regression_qc._panel_influence`. It shows what the volcano cannot: whether a hit reflects the data as a whole or a single well. A well far to the right has an unusual combination of guides; a well far up or down is poorly predicted; a well that is both is one whose removal moves the coefficients, and Cook's distance is the product that says so.
records.translation: 상호 작용 쌍의 :func:`spacr.regression_qc._panel_influence`. 그것은 화산이 할 수없는 것을 보여줍니다 : 히트가 전체 또는 단일 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치로 데이터를 반영하는지 여부. 오른쪽에있는 마이크로는 가이드의 특이한 조합을 가지고있다; 멀리 또는 아래로 마이크는 예측이 나쁘다; 둘 다 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치는 그것의 제거는 요소를 움직이고, 쿠크의 거리는 그것을 말하는 제품입니다.

records.context: The microplate sample positions past the 4/n screening rule are the only ones coloured, which is the house rule -- everything else is grey, because these are the microplate sample positions worth re-examining.

records.source: The wells past the 4/n screening rule are the only ones coloured, which is the house rule -- everything else is grey, because these are the wells worth re-examining.
records.translation: 4/n 스크린 규칙을 초과하는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치는 집 규칙 인 유일한 색상입니다 - 다른 모든 것이 회색이기 때문에 이것은 다시 검토 할 가치가있는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치입니다.

records.context: AUC represents the probability that a randomly selected object from one class has a higher value than a randomly selected object from the other class. It detects stochastic ordering but can miss distribution-shape differences. For example, classes with the same centre but different spread can have an AUC of 0.5 despite differing distributions. The Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistic is therefore computed for every feature. A high KS statistic combined with AUC near 0.5 sets :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank#2
records.source: AUC represents the probability that a randomly selected object from one class has a higher value than a randomly selected object from the other class. It detects stochastic ordering but can miss distribution-shape differences. For example, classes with the same centre but different spread can have an AUC of 0.5 despite differing distributions. The Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistic is therefore computed for every feature. A high KS statistic combined with AUC near 0.5 sets :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`.
records.translation: AUC는 하나의 클래스에서 우연히 선택된 개체가 다른 클래스로 우연하게 선택한 개체보다 더 높은 가치를 가지고 있다는 확률을 나타냅니다. 그것은 스토카스틱 주문을 감지하지만 배포 형태의 차이를 놓칠 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 같은 중심이지만 다른 배포를 가진 클래스는 다르게 배포에도 불구하고 0.5의 AUC를 가질 수 있습니다 . Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) 통계는 따라서 각 특징에 대해 계산됩니다. A 높은 KS 통계와 AUC 약 0.5 세트 :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`와 결합되어 있습니다.

records.context: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations` enables a family-wise permutation calibration. Class labels are permuted, the complete ranking is recomputed and the maximum score from each permutation is retained. The 95th percentile of these maxima is returned as :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold`. Calibration uses a seeded subsample of at most :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` rows and is disabled by default because computation scales with the number of permutations.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank#7
records.source: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations` enables a family-wise permutation calibration. Class labels are permuted, the complete ranking is recomputed and the maximum score from each permutation is retained. The 95th percentile of these maxima is returned as :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold`. Calibration uses a seeded subsample of at most :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` rows and is disabled by default because computation scales with the number of permutations.
records.translation: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations`은 가족 지식의 변형 캘리브레이션을 가능하게 합니다. 클래스 라벨은 변형되며, 전체 순위는 재구성되고 각 변형에서 최대 점수가 유지됩니다. 이 최대의 95 %는 :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold`로 반환됩니다. 캘리는 대부분의 :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` 라인에서 시드를 지정한 샘플을 사용하며 변형의 숫자로 계산 스케일이 있기 때문에 기본적으로 비활성화됩니다.

records.source: Categorical by :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.column_kinds`, with between two and :data:`MAX_CLASSES` levels, and **not floating point**. A class label is text, an integer code or a boolean; a float column with eleven distinct values is a measurement that happens to be coarse, and offering it as the class column would allow ranking every feature against a measurement such as ``cell_eccentricity``.
records.translation: :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.column_kinds`에 의해 분류, 2와 :data:`MAX_CLASSES` 사이의 수준과 **가 흐르지 않는 포인트**입니다. 클래스 라벨은 텍스트, 전체 코드 또는 볼레안입니다. 11 개의 분리 된 값을 가진 플로트 열은 단단한 것으로 나타나는 측정이며, 클래스 열이 ``cell_eccentricity``과 같은 측정에 대한 각 특징을 순위를 허용하는 것처럼 제공합니다.

records.context: :class:`FigureQueue` is a one-at-a-time gallery: it shows the figure you navigated to. That is the right shape for a workflow that produces a dozen plots over an hour, and the wrong one for a hyperparameter search, where the whole point is to compare fifty embeddings against each other and stop early when the range is obviously wrong.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.figure_grid#1
records.source: :class:`FigureQueue` is a one-at-a-time gallery: it shows the figure you navigated to. That is the right shape for a pipeline that produces a dozen plots over an hour, and the wrong one for a hyperparameter search, where the whole point is to compare fifty embeddings against each other and stop early when the range is obviously wrong.
records.translation: :class:`FigureQueue`는 한 시간에 하나의 갤러리입니다 : 그것은 당신이 탐색 한 숫자를 보여줍니다.이 작업 흐름에 대한 올바른 모양은 한 시간 내에 수십 개의 플로트를 생성하고, 하이퍼 파라미터 검색에 대한 잘못된 모양, 전체 포인트는 상대적으로 50 개의 임베딩을 비교하고 범위가 분명히 잘못되었을 때 일찍 멈추는 것입니다.

records.context: The grid prefers to fill the container in BOTH directions rather than to make one long row: with nine figures in a square panel the useful answer is 3x3, not 9x1, because comparing nine embeddings side by side is the entire reason the view exists.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.figure_grid.reflow_shape#1
records.source: The grid prefers to fill the container in BOTH directions rather than to make one long row: with nine figures in a square panel the useful answer is 3x3, not 9x1, because comparing nine embeddings side by side is the entire reason the view exists.
records.translation: 네트워크는 BOTH 방향으로 컨테이너를 채우는 것을 선호하는 대신 긴 라인을 만들기 : 평방 패널에있는 9 개의 숫자로 유용한 대답은 3x3이 아니라 9x1이기 때문에 9 개의 임베딩을 측면에서 비교하는 것은 전체 이유입니다.

records.context: The figures themselves are files in the processing session's own results folder, recorded by the sections that name that folder; copying seventeen PNGs in here would be a second copy of something the processing session already has. What dies with the process is the arrangement -- the tile size the user settled on and which sections they folded away -- and a sweep of sixty trials is unusable if that resets.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.figure_grid_view.FigureGridView.workspace_state#1
records.source: The figures themselves are files in the run's own results folder, recorded by the sections that name that folder; copying seventeen PNGs in here would be a second copy of something the run already has. What dies with the process is the arrangement -- the tile size the user settled on and which sections they folded away -- and a sweep of sixty trials is unusable if that resets.
records.translation: 숫자 자체는 처리 세션의 결과 폴더에 있는 파일이며, 그 폴드 이름을 지정하는 섹션에 의해 기록되며, 17개를 복사한다. PNGs 여기에서 처리 세션이 이미 가지고있는 무언가의 두 번째 복사본이 될 것입니다.이 프로세스와 함께 사라지는 것은 조정입니다 - 사용자가 설정한 타일 크기와 그들이 포장 한 섹션 - 그리고 60 개의 테스트가 재설정되면 쓸모가 없습니다.

records.context: In PDF mode, the PNG preview appears immediately and a worker rasterizes the vector page at 2,200 pixels before replacing it. records.context: The pointer arguments are not optional in practice. The worker passes all ten positionally to whichever engine the pattern chose, and this signature stopped at six -- so every frame raised TypeError, the failure signal fired, no image ever arrived, and the widget painted its fallback colour. That is why the CPU cascade was black while the GPU one was fine and the CPU orbit followed the mouse.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fractal_cascade.CascadeEngine.render#1
records.source: THE POINTER ARGUMENTS ARE NOT OPTIONAL IN PRACTICE. The worker passes all ten positionally to whichever engine the pattern chose, and this signature stopped at six -- so every frame raised TypeError, the failure signal fired, no image ever arrived, and the widget painted its fallback colour. That is why the CPU cascade was black while the GPU one was fine and the CPU orbit followed the mouse.
records.translation: 지표 논쟁은 실천에서 선택적이지 않습니다. 워커는 패턴이 선택한 엔진에 모든 10 개를 위치로 통과하고,이 서명은 6에서 중지되었습니다 - 그래서 각 프레임은 TypeError로 올라갔고, 실패 신호는 발사되지 않았으며, 이미지는 결코 도착하지 않았으며 위젯은 붕괴 색상을 그렸습니다. 그래서 CPU 카스카드는 검은 색이었고 GPU 하나는 괜찮았고 CPU 궤도는 마우스를 따랐습니다.

records.context: So :func:`warm_annotation` does all of it on a background execution unit, through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, which is the module that already gets the execution concurrency rules right: the worker's ``finished`` is relayed through a Signal whose receiver is a bound method of a main GUI execution path object, never a closure, so the handler executes on the main GUI execution path and the QThread is retired. Given the application view's own terms it warms every gene in one join -- 400 genes cost the same 21 ms as one -- after which a click is a key-value mapping lookup.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gene_panel#9
records.source: So :func:`warm_annotation` does all of it on a worker thread, through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, which is the module that already gets the threading rules right: the worker's ``finished`` is relayed through a Signal whose receiver is a bound method of a GUI-thread object, never a closure, so the handler runs on the GUI thread and the QThread is retired. Given the screen's own terms it warms every gene in one join -- 400 genes cost the same 21 ms as one -- after which a click is a dictionary lookup.
records.translation: 그래서 :func:`warm_annotation`은 모두 배경 실행 단위를 통해 :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, 그것은 이미 실행 경쟁 규칙을 얻는 모듈입니다 : 워커의 ``finished``는 수신자가 주요 GUI 실행 경로 개체의 묶여있는 방법으로 전송됩니다, 결코 닫기, 그래서 거래자는 주 GUI 실현 경로를 실행하고 QThread 은퇴합니다.

records.context: The annotation lookup is warmed on a worker, and only once the panel has actually been shown: a panel re-set with the same table on every filter move would otherwise start an independent execution path per redraw for no new genes at all. The independent execution path's lifetime is guarded twice, because Qt aborts the process if an executing ``QThread`` is destroyed and a panel can be dropped without ever being closed -- a tab rebuilt, an application view replaced, an interpreter shutting down.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gene_panel.GenePanel#5

records.context: The walk over dropped paths executes on its own worker. A drop is a path the user chose, and a laboratory microplate lives on the microscope's share: one ``os.path.exists`` under a sleeping autofs mount had not returned after twenty seconds, and a walk is thousands of those. Run inline, the walk would freeze the application without a traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash. The runner is marked not user-visible because dropping a folder is not starting a processing session, and it is safe to do so because that runner carries nothing but the walk.

Run inline, the walk would freeze the application without a traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash. The runner is marked not user-visible because dropping a folder is not starting a run, and it is safe to do so because that runner carries nothing but the walk.

records.context: **The model the processing session will use, named on application view.** The panel reads the same setting the workflow reads -- ``pathogen_model`` over ``pathogen_model_name`` for pathogens, ``<object>_model_name`` otherwise (:func:`_model_keys_for`) -- offers the model zoo beside the combo, and names the model that produced the masks on the status line. records.translation: **처리 세션이 사용하는 모델은 응용 프로그램 보기에서 이름을 지정합니다.** 패널은 작업 흐름을 읽는 동일한 설정 - ``pathogen_model`` ``pathogen_model_name`` 병원체, ``<object>_model_name`` 다른 방법 (:func:`_model_keys_for`) - 모델 동물원 옆에 제공하고 상태 라인에 마스크를 생산 한 모델을 이름합니다.

records.context: **Pre / Post filters.** When the object type is ``cell`` (or the combined mode) the panel routes pre / post-processing settings from the Mask app (``cell_min_size``, ``cell_max_size``, ``remove_background_cell``, background intensity, ...) through the segmentation. records.translation: **프리 / 포스트 필터.** 객체 유형이 ``cell`` (또는 조합 모드)이면 패널은 마스크 앱 (``cell_min_size``, ``cell_max_size`` , ``remove_background_cell``, 배경 강도, ...)에서 미리 / 후 처리 설정을 분할합니다.사용자는 LP / AI와 동일한 시각적 스타일로 "Run preview" 옆에 앉아있는 전용 "Pre" / "Post" 클릭 가능한 라벨을 사용하여 이러한 분할을 포장합니다.

records.context: A spin box silently clamps a value outside its range. The flow threshold runs -1 to 3 here while Mask ships 100 -- "accept everything Cellpose proposes" -- so seeding wrote 3, and propagating then handed 3 back as if the user had chosen it. The value that did not fit is remembered so propagation can return it untouched; see :meth:`_unclamped`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.LivePreviewPanel.apply_settings._seed#1
records.source: A spin box silently clamps a value outside its range. The flow threshold runs -1 to 3 here while Mask ships 100 -- "accept everything Cellpose proposes" -- so seeding wrote 3, and propagating then handed 3 back as if the user had chosen it. The value that did not fit is remembered so propagation can return it untouched; see :meth:`_unclamped`.
records.translation: 스핀 상자는 조용히 그 범위 밖의 값을 붙잡습니다. 흐름 한도는 여기에서 -1에서 3로 진행되며, 마스크 선박은 100 - "accept everything Cellpose proposes" - 그래서 시드는 3을 쓰고 확산은 사용자가 그것을 선택한 것처럼 3을 반환합니다. 적합하지 않은 값은 기억되므로 확산이 만지지 않게 되돌릴 수 있습니다. :meth:`_unclamped`을 참조하십시오.

records.context: Nothing in the Segmentation group greys out for the model. Cellpose 4 ships one set of weights and all three knobs (diameter / flow / cell-prob) still reach it — see :data:`DIAMETER_TOOLTIP` for the measurement.
