records.context: Not for the main GUI execution path. Every path here is one the user chose, which on a microscope rig means a network share, and the ``isdir`` is what wakes the automount. :meth:`MeasureInputTable.add_dropped` is the only caller and it executes this on a worker. Looked up through the module global so a test can replace it and see which independent execution path it ran on.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measure_input_table.files_under#2
records.source: Not for the GUI thread. Every path here is one the user chose, which on a microscope rig means a network share, and the ``isdir`` is what wakes the automount. :meth:`MeasureInputTable.add_dropped` is the only caller and it runs this on a worker. Looked up through the module global so a test can replace it and see which thread it ran on.
records.translation: 주요 GUI 실행 경로가 아닙니다. 여기서 각 경로는 사용자가 선택한 하나이며, 마이크로스코프 리그에서 네트워크 공유를 의미하며, ``isdir``는 자동차를 깨우는 것입니다. :meth:`MeasureInputTable.add_dropped`는 유일한 호출자이며 그것은 워커에 이것을 실행합니다.

records.context: The inverse of :meth:`settings_for_propagation`, and tested as one. This panel had no ``apply_settings`` at all, so the extracted-image-region preview -- opened to decide whether an extracted image region size will cut the cell in half, or which stain lands in which colour -- always answered for its own defaults rather than for the run about to happen.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measure_preview.MeasurePreviewPanel.apply_settings#1
records.source: The inverse of :meth:`settings_for_propagation`, and tested as one. This panel had no ``apply_settings`` at all, so the crop preview -- opened to decide whether a crop size will cut the cell in half, or which stain lands in which colour -- always answered for its own defaults rather than for the run about to happen.
records.translation: :meth:`settings_for_propagation`의 반대, 그리고 하나로 테스트되었습니다. 이 패널은 전혀 ``apply_settings``이 없었으므로 추출된 이미지-구역 사전보기 - 추출 된 이미지 지역 크기가 세포를 절반으로 줄일 것인지, 또는 어떤 색깔의 염색이 있는지 결정하기 위해 열려 있었으므로, 실행이 일어나기보다는 항상 자신의 결함에 대답했습니다.

records.context: Dispatches: the extracted-image-region pass executes on a worker and the grid is rebuilt when it lands. Every knob in the extracted-image-region settings dialog is wired to this, so it used to freeze the window for 1441 ms per spinbox step on a 1024x1024x8 array. Extracting image regions again supersedes by token, so dragging a spinbox through ten values draws the last one rather than all ten.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measure_preview.MeasurePreviewPanel.refresh#1
records.source: Dispatches: the crop pass runs on a worker and the grid is rebuilt when it lands. Every knob in the Crop settings dialog is wired to this, so it used to freeze the window for 1441 ms per spinbox step on a 1024x1024x8 array. Re-cropping supersedes by token, so dragging a spinbox through ten values draws the last one rather than all ten.
records.translation: 배송: 추출 이미지-구역 통과는 워커에 실행되고 그가 땅에있을 때 네트워크가 재건됩니다. 추출 이미지-구국 설정 대화의 각 노브는 이것에 연결되어 있으므로 1024x1024x8 라인에 스핀 박스 단계 당 1441 ms의 창을 냉동하는 데 사용됩니다.

records.context: ``params`` is a snapshot of the widget values taken on the main GUI execution path -- see :meth:`MeasurePreviewPanel._category_params`. Passing a snapshot rather than reading the widgets is what makes this safe to call from a worker.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measure_preview.annotate_crops#1
records.source: ``params`` is a snapshot of the widget values taken on the GUI thread -- see :meth:`MeasurePreviewPanel._category_params`. Passing a snapshot rather than reading the widgets is what makes this safe to call from a worker.

records.source: a RUN FOLDER, which is what `src` holds. A Measure run is pointed at the plate directory and finds `merged/` itself, so the preview asking for a file meant hunting through a folder for one of fifty-two arrays whose names carry a well and a field and nothing about which is interesting;
records.translation: 프로세서 세션 폴더, 즉 `src`이 보유하고 있는 것입니다. 측정 실행은 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 디렉토리에서 표시되며 `merged/` 자체를 발견하므로 파일을 요청하는 사전 시청은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치와 마이크로 스크립트 시야를 가지고있는 52 개의 궤도 중 하나에 대한 폴더를 통해 사냥을 의미하며 흥미로운 것은 아무것도 없습니다.

records.context: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the microplate sample positions that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. The population box then starts on "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected microplate sample positions", the derived microplate sample positions are shown under the controls, and "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" change either. Nothing to select starts on "All datapoints", so a panel with no guides still draws what it drew before.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_compare_dialog.MeasurementComparePanel#1
records.source: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the wells that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. The population box then starts on "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells", the derived wells are shown under the controls, and "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" change either. Nothing to select starts on "All datapoints", so a panel with no guides still draws what it drew before.
records.translation: 패널은 선택한 상단 히트와 함께 열립니다 : 상단 중요한 가이드 또는 유전자 및 사용자가 변경할 수있는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치. 회복 결과 테이블은 히츠 (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`)를 제공합니다; 하나가 없으면 조립의 자신의 그룹의 가이드가 선택입니다. 인구 상자 다음 "gRNAs + 다른 데이터 포인트에서 선택한 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에서 시작합니다", 추출 된 마이크는 템플릿 아래에서 표시되며, "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…"도 변경됩니다. 선택할 것이 아무것도 "All datapoints"에서 시작되지 않으므로 지침이없는 패널이 여전히 이전에 끌어 들이는 것을 끌고 있습니다.

records.context: The microplate sample position selection is held as ``None`` for "all of them" rather than as the full list: a microplate sample position that appears after a re-run should be included, and a stored full list would silently exclude it.

records.source: The well selection is held as ``None`` for "all of them" rather than as the full list: a well that appears after a re-run should be included, and a stored full list would silently exclude it.
records.translation: 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 선택은 "all of them" 대신 전체 목록으로 ``None``로 유지됩니다 : 다시 실행 후에 나타나는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치가 포함되어야하며 저장된 전체 목록은 조용히 그것을 배제 할 것입니다.

records.context: Compare gene effect sizes across measured features and attached databases.

records.source: Compare gene effect sizes across measured features and attached databases.
records.translation: 측정된 특징과 연결된 데이터베이스를 통해 유전자 효과 크기를 비교합니다.

records.context: Asked of :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` rather than of ``os.path``. This property is read once per laboratory microplate row by `_fill_table`, and again by `paths`, `screens` and `describe` -- so a project with eight laboratory microplates on a sleeping `autofs` mount was eight twenty-second stats on the main GUI execution path before the tab had drawn anything. The probe answers from a cache, reports a path it has not seen as present, and stats it on its own bounded worker; `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` is the half that corrects the row when the real answer lands.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_scan_panel.AttachedDatabase.present#2
records.source: Asked of :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` rather than of ``os.path``. This property is read once per plate row by `_fill_table`, and again by `paths`, `screens` and `describe` -- so a project with eight plates on a sleeping `autofs` mount was eight twenty-second stats on the GUI thread before the tab had drawn anything. The probe answers from a cache, reports a path it has not seen as present, and stats it on its own bounded worker; `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` is the half that corrects the row when the real answer lands.
records.translation: 질문에 대하여 :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` 오히려 대신에 ``os.path``이 재산은 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 순서에 한 번 읽을 수 있습니다. `_fill_table`그리고 다시 한 번, `paths`, `screens` 그리고 `describe` - 그래서 잠자리에 8 개의 실험실 마이크로 플레이트가있는 프로젝트 `autofs` 마운트는 주인공에 20초의 통계로 8개가 있었다. GUI 탭이 무언가를 끌기 전에 실행 경로. 탐색은 캐시에서 응답하고, 현재로 보지 못한 경로를 보고하고, 그것을 자신의 묶여있는 워커에 기록합니다. `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` 반은 진정한 대답이 떨어질 때 순서를 수정하는 반입니다.

records.source: The download reuses existing code. The archive, the worker and the progress dialog are :func:`spacr.qt.hf_download.download_annotate_example`, the same call Classify's button makes, and a plate already unpacked by any of them is reused without touching the network.

records.context: When a dataset's laboratory microplate / microplate sample position / microscope field of view / channel assignment is *inferred* — from a container file's internal structure or from a folder layout — the guess is rarely perfect. This widget shows those inferred rows in an editable :class:`QTableWidget` so the user can correct microplate sample positions, split conditions, relabel channels, etc. before committing, then writes a ``filename_map.csv`` the workflow consumes.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.metadata_table#1
records.source: When a dataset's plate / well / field / channel assignment is *inferred* — from a container file's internal structure or from a folder layout — the guess is rarely perfect. This widget shows those inferred rows in an editable :class:`QTableWidget` so the user can correct wells, split conditions, relabel channels, etc. before committing, then writes a ``filename_map.csv`` the pipeline consumes.

records.context: Fit :class:`sklearn.covariance.MinCovDet` — the Minimum Covariance Determinant — to the selected features, take each object's squared Mahalanobis distance to the robust centre in the robust metric, and flag it against a chi-square quantile.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#17
records.source: Fit :class:`sklearn.covariance.MinCovDet` — the Minimum Covariance Determinant — to the selected features, take each object's squared Mahalanobis distance to the robust centre in the robust metric, and flag it against a chi-square quantile.
records.translation: 적합 :class:`sklearn.covariance.MinCovDet` - 최소 좌표 결정자 - 선택한 특징에, 각 개체의 평방 Mahalanobis 거리를 강력한 중심에, 강력한 측정에서, 그리고 그것을 지표에 대 한 chi-square 양자.

records.context: **The threshold is a stated false-positive rate, not a tuned fraction.** Under multivariate normality the squared robust Mahalanobis distance is distributed chi-square with ``p`` degrees of freedom, so the cut point is ``chi2.ppf(1 - alpha, p)`` for a chosen ``alpha`` — default :data:`DEFAULT_ALPHA` = 0.001, meaning *one clean object in a thousand is expected to be flagged*. Over 10^5 objects that is about 100 false flags, and over the 200,000 objects of a typical two-plate screen it is about 200. That number is knowable in advance and is printed in :meth:`OutlierResult.caveats`. An isolation forest's score has no such null distribution and therefore no calibrated cut point at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#19
records.source: **The threshold is a stated false-positive rate, not a tuned fraction.** Under multivariate normality the squared robust Mahalanobis distance is distributed chi-square with ``p`` degrees of freedom, so the cut point is ``chi2.ppf(1 - alpha, p)`` for a chosen ``alpha`` — default :data:`DEFAULT_ALPHA` = 0.001, meaning *one clean object in a thousand is expected to be flagged*. Over 10^5 objects that is about 100 false flags, and over the 200,000 objects of a typical two-plate screen it is about 200. That number is knowable in advance and is printed in :meth:`OutlierResult.caveats`. An isolation forest's score has no such null distribution and therefore no calibrated cut point at all.
records.translation: **임계값은 거짓 긍정적 인 속도, 튀긴 부분이 아닙니다.** 다중 변수의 정상성 아래, 평방 강력한 Mahalanobis 거리는 chi-square로 분배됩니다. ``p`` 자유의 정도, 그래서 절단점은 ``chi2.ppf(1 - alpha, p)`` 선택한 사람을 위한 ``alpha`` - 불필요한 :data:`DEFAULT_ALPHA` = 0.001 의미 *1천 개의 깨끗한 물체가 깃발이 될 것으로 예상됩니다.*10^5 개 이상의 개체는 약 100 개의 가짜 깃발이며, 전형적인 2 플레이트 스크린의 200,000 개 이상은 약 200 개입니다. :meth:`OutlierResult.caveats`격리 숲의 점수는 그러한 0 분배를 가지고 있지 않으며 따라서 칼리브로 된 절단 포인트는 전혀 없습니다.

records.context: **MCD is deterministic given a seed.** The subset search is randomised, so ``random_state`` is set from :attr:`OutlierSpec.seed` and the same table gives the same flags every time — a figure in a report matches the screen it came from. An isolation forest is a randomised ensemble whose per-object score wobbles between fits.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#23
records.source: **MCD is deterministic given a seed.** The subset search is randomised, so ``random_state`` is set from :attr:`OutlierSpec.seed` and the same table gives the same flags every time — a figure in a report matches the screen it came from. An isolation forest is a randomised ensemble whose per-object score wobbles between fits.
records.translation: **MCD는 시드에 의해 결정적입니다.** 하위 세트 검색은 우연히, 그래서 ``random_state``는 :attr:`OutlierSpec.seed`에서 설정하고 같은 테이블은 매번 동일한 깃발을 제공합니다 - 보고서의 숫자는 그것이 나온 화면과 일치합니다.

records.context: So the microplate sample position pass is **not** "the microplate sample position contains many flagged objects". That statistic exists — it is reported as ``flagged_share`` — and it answers a different question: it finds a microplate sample position containing a few *catastrophic* objects (a segmentation blow-up, a piece of dust measured as a cell) while being blind to a uniform shift. The microplate sample position-level robust score finds the uniform shift while being blind to the isolated catastrophe. Both are on the microplate sample position frame because neither subsumes the other.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#29
records.source: So the well pass is **not** "the well contains many flagged objects". That statistic exists — it is reported as ``flagged_share`` — and it answers a different question: it finds a well containing a few *catastrophic* objects (a segmentation blow-up, a piece of dust measured as a cell) while being blind to a uniform shift. The well-level robust score finds the uniform shift while being blind to the isolated catastrophe. Both are on the well frame because neither subsumes the other.
records.translation: 그러므로 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 패스는 **not** "마이크로플레이트 표본 위치에는 많은 표시된 개체가 포함되어 있습니다."이 통계는 존재합니다 - 그것은 ``flagged_share``로 알려져 있습니다 - 그리고 그것은 다른 질문에 대답합니다 : 그것은 몇 개의 *재앙* 개체 (분할 폭발, 세포로 측정 된 먼지 조각)를 포함하는 마이크로는 플레트 표본 모양 위치 수준의 강력한 점수는 고립 된 재앙에 눈이 띄는 동안 동일한 변화를 발견합니다.

records.context: The well pass reduces each well to a robust summary — the **median** of each feature over the well's objects, plus ``n`` — and then runs *the same* rule (:data:`METHOD_MAD`, :data:`METHOD_IQR` or :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`) across microplate sample positions. The median rather than the mean for the same reason as everywhere else here: a single blown-up object must not become a bad well.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#30
records.source: The well pass reduces each well to a robust summary — the **median** of each feature over the well's objects, plus ``n`` — and then runs *the same* rule (:data:`METHOD_MAD`, :data:`METHOD_IQR` or :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`) across wells. The median rather than the mean for the same reason as everywhere else here: a single blown-up object must not become a bad well.
records.translation: 웰 패스는 각 밸브를 견고한 요약으로 줄여줍니다 - **중간** 각 함수는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 개체, 플러스 ``n`` - 그리고 다음 *같은* 규칙 (:data:`METHOD_MAD`, :data:`METHOD_IQR` 또는 :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`) 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 통해 실행합니다.

records.context: Raised rather than returned as an empty result. Every one of these is a sentence the user can act on — "``cell_area`` has 412 non-positive values and log10 of them is not a number", "3 features and 4 complete objects is fewer than the 6 the MCD needs" — and a caller that swallowed it would show an empty table with nothing to explain it. Application views catch it and print the message.

records.source: Raised rather than returned as an empty result. Screens catch it and print the message.
records.translation: 이들 각각은 사용자가 행동 할 수있는 문장입니다 - "``cell_area``는 412 비 긍정적 인 값을 가지고 있으며, 그 중 log10은 숫자가 아닙니다", "3 개의 특징과 4 개의 완전한 개체는 MCD가 필요로하는 6 개보다 적습니다" - 그리고 그것을 흡수 한 호출자는 그것을 설명 할 수없는 빈 테이블을 보여줄 것입니다.

records.source: per feature, the robust centre used (the median, or the MCD centre's coordinate).
records.translation: 특징에 따라 사용되는 강력한 센터 (미디언 또는 MCD 센터의 조율)입니다.

records.context: Both, on purpose. ``flagged_share`` is the share of the microplate sample position's objects the per-object rule flagged — it finds a microplate sample position with a few catastrophic objects in it. ``well_outlier_score`` is the same robust rule applied *across* microplate sample positions to their medians — it finds a microplate sample position whose whole population is shifted, which the object rule is nearly blind to. See the module docstring for the arithmetic of why they differ.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.OutlierResult.well_frame#1
records.source: Both, on purpose. ``flagged_share`` is the share of the well's objects the per-object rule flagged — it finds a well with a few catastrophic objects in it. ``well_outlier_score`` is the same robust rule applied *across* wells to their medians — it finds a well whose whole population is shifted, which the object rule is nearly blind to. See the module docstring for the arithmetic of why they differ.
records.translation: 둘 다, 목적에 따라. ``flagged_share``는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치의 개체의 비율은 개체별 규칙을 표시합니다 - 그것은 그것에 몇 가지 재앙적인 개체와 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 찾습니다. ``well_outlier_score``는 그들의 중간에 적용 된 같은 강력한 규칙입니다 *cross* 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 - 그것의 전체 인구가 옮겨진 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 발견합니다.

records.translation: ``k`` for :data:`METHOD_MAD`, ``c`` for :data:`METHOD_IQR`, 그리고 chi-square 양질 ``chi2.ppf(1 - alpha, p)`` for :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS` - 그것은 null 분배가 있기 때문에 플레이에있는 특징이 얼마나 많은지에 따라 달라집니다.

records.context: The microplate sample position pass reduces each microplate sample position to the median of each feature and runs the same rule across microplate sample positions, because a microplate sample position shifted as a whole flags almost none of its individual objects and is nevertheless unmistakable as a point among microplate sample positions.

records.source: The well pass reduces each well to the median of each feature and runs the same rule across wells, because a well shifted as a whole flags almost none of its individual objects and is nevertheless unmistakable as a point among wells.
records.translation: 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 포지션 패스는 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 각 특징의 중간으로 줄이고 마이크 플레드 샘폴 위치를 통해 동일한 규칙을 실행합니다, 왜냐하면 전체로 옮겨진 마이그 플레드는 개별 개체의 거의 하나의 깃발이 아니며 그럼에도 불구하고 마이커 플레ット 샘블 위치 사이의 포인트로 혼동 할 수 없기 때문입니다.

records.context: A NaN in a spaCR measurement table is usually *structural*, not missing at random — the same reasoning :mod:`spacr.anndata_export` sets out at length. A ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it; that is a fact about the cell, not a gap in the record. Mean-imputing it invents a pathogen of average size and moves an uninfected cell into the middle of the infected distribution, invisibly.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#10

A ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it; that is a fact about the cell, not a gap in the record. Mean-imputing it invents a pathogen of average size and moves an uninfected cell into the middle of the infected distribution, invisibly.
records.translation: A NaN 에 A spaCR 일반적으로 측정 테이블은 *구조적*, 우연히 놓치지 않는 - 동일한 논리 :mod:`spacr.anndata_export` 길이를 다. a ``pathogen_*`` 컬러는 NaN 그것에있는 병원체가없는 세포에 대 한; 그것은 세포, 기록에있는 격차가 아닌 사실입니다.중간 인출 그것은 중간 크기의 병원을 발명하고 감염되지 않은 세포를 감염 된 분배의 중간으로 이동, 보이지 않게.

records.context: **Infinities are missing under every policy.** Ratio features produce ±inf from a zero denominator, an inf survives ``dropna``, and one of them destroys the scaling and therefore every component. They become NaN before the policy runs and are counted separately in :attr:`PCAResult.n_infinite`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#18
records.source: **Infinities are missing under every policy.** Ratio features produce ±inf from a zero denominator, an inf survives ``dropna``, and one of them destroys the scaling and therefore every component. They become NaN before the policy runs and are counted separately in :attr:`PCAResult.n_infinite`.
records.translation: **무한성은 모든 정책에서 잃어버린다.** 비율 특징은 ±inf를 0 명소에서 생성하고 inf는 생존합니다. ``dropna``그리고 그들 중 하나가 균열을 파괴하고 따라서 모든 구성 요소를 파괴합니다. NaN 정책이 실행되기 전에 그리고 개별적으로 계산됩니다. :attr:`PCAResult.n_infinite`.

records.context: **Perfectly collinear** columns are a different problem and get a different answer: they are *kept*, because the feature list is the user's statement of what they care about and picking which of ``area`` and ``area_um2`` to discard is not this module's call. What is refused is inventing components out of the redundancy. The numerical rank is computed from the singular values and no more than ``rank`` components are ever returned, so a table of 12 features spanning 9 real directions yields 9 components, not 12 — the last three would have ~0 explained variance and a direction chosen by floating-point noise. Groups of features that are perfectly correlated are also detected and reported, since a duplicated feature silently doubles its own weight in a correlation PCA.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#21
records.source: **Perfectly collinear** columns are a different problem and get a different answer: they are *kept*, because the feature list is the user's statement of what they care about and picking which of ``area`` and ``area_um2`` to discard is not this module's call. What is refused is inventing components out of the redundancy. The numerical rank is computed from the singular values and no more than ``rank`` components are ever returned, so a table of 12 features spanning 9 real directions yields 9 components, not 12 — the last three would have ~0 explained variance and a direction chosen by floating-point noise. Groups of features that are perfectly correlated are also detected and reported, since a duplicated feature silently doubles its own weight in a correlation PCA.
records.translation: **완벽한 콜린** 열은 다른 문제이며 다른 대답을 얻습니다 : 그들은 *유지*, 왜냐하면 특징 목록은 사용자가 관심이있는 것에 대한 사용자의 진술이며 어떤 특징을 선택하는지에 대한 설명이기 때문입니다. ``area`` 그리고 ``area_um2`` 포기하는 것은이 모듈의 호출이 아닙니다. 거부되는 것은 회수에서 구성 요소를 발명하는 것입니다. 숫자 순위는 단일 값에서 계산되며, 더 이상 ``rank`` 구성 요소는 언제든지 반환됩니다, 그래서 테이블 12 특징 9 진짜 방향을 뻗어 9 부품이 아닌 12 - 마지막 세 가지가 ~0 설명 변형과 지점 소음에 의해 선택된 방향이있을 것입니다. PCA.

records.context: :attr:`PCAResult.explained_variance_ratio` is over the **total variance of the analysed matrix**, so it sums to 1 across all ``rank`` components rather than across the ones that were kept. Alongside it, every result carries how much of the original table it is actually about (:attr:`PCAResult.n_rows_in` versus ``len(result)``, :attr:`PCAResult.n_features_in` versus its features): "PC1 explains 71%" means something different when the matrix is three features and 8% of the objects.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#23
records.source: :attr:`PCAResult.explained_variance_ratio` is over the **total variance of the analysed matrix**, so it sums to 1 across all ``rank`` components rather than across the ones that were kept. Alongside it, every result carries how much of the original table it is actually about (:attr:`PCAResult.n_rows_in` versus ``len(result)``, :attr:`PCAResult.n_features_in` versus its features): "PC1 explains 71%" means something different when the matrix is three features and 8% of the objects.
records.translation: :attr:`PCAResult.explained_variance_ratio` 그것은 그 위에 **분석된 매트릭스의 전체 변형**그래서 전체적으로 1에 해당한다. ``rank`` 그 외에, 각 결과는 원래 테이블의 얼마나 많은 그것은 실제로 주위에있다 (:attr:`PCAResult.n_rows_in` 대신 ``len(result)``, :attr:`PCAResult.n_features_in` 그것의 특징에 대하여 : "PC1은 71%를 설명한다"는 것은 매트릭스가 3 개의 특징과 개체의 8 %가 될 때 다른 것을 의미합니다.

records.context: The most common way a PCA of morphology features misleads is that **PC1 is just size**. When every feature loads with the same sign, PC1 is a general-magnitude axis — big objects at one end, small at the other — which is usually a fact about segmentation rather than biology. :meth:`PCAResult.is_size_like` detects it from the loading signs and :meth:`PCAResult.headline` says it in words, unprompted.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#24
records.source: The most common way a PCA of morphology features misleads is that **PC1 is just size**. When every feature loads with the same sign, PC1 is a general-magnitude axis — big objects at one end, small at the other — which is usually a fact about segmentation rather than biology. :meth:`PCAResult.is_size_like` detects it from the loading signs and :meth:`PCAResult.headline` says it in words, unprompted.
records.translation: 가장 일반적인 방법은 PCA의 morphology 특성 오류는 **PC1은 단지 크기**입니다.모든 특징이 동일한 신호로 충전 할 때, PC1은 일반 대규모 좌석 - 한 끝에 큰 개체, 다른 끝에 작은 - 일반적으로 생물학 대신 분할에 관한 사실입니다. :meth:`PCAResult.is_size_like`는 충전 신호에서 그것을 감지하고 :meth:`PCAResult.headline`는 단어로 말합니다.

records.context: Standardising each feature to mean 0 and sample SD 1 (a *correlation* PCA) makes the result invariant to any per-feature linear rescaling, which is the only defensible default when the columns have no common unit.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#6
records.source: Standardising each feature to mean 0 and sample SD 1 (a *correlation* PCA) makes the result invariant to any per-feature linear rescaling, which is the only defensible default when the columns have no common unit.
records.translation: 각 특징을 0을 의미하고 SD 1 ( *correlation* PCA) 샘플을 표준화하면 결과가 각 특징에 대한 모든 선형 리스칼링에 변함이 없으며, 이는 열이 공통 단위가 없을 때 유일한 방어 가능한 결함입니다.

records.context: It is not free, and the cost is stated rather than hidden: equal weight means forty near-duplicate Zernike moments outvote one carefully chosen intensity ratio, and a feature that is pure noise gets the same unit of variance as a feature that is pure signal. :data:`SCALE_NONE` is there for the case where the user has already put the features in a common unit and *wants* the big ones to dominate.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#7
records.source: It is not free, and the cost is stated rather than hidden: equal weight means forty near-duplicate Zernike moments outvote one carefully chosen intensity ratio, and a feature that is pure noise gets the same unit of variance as a feature that is pure signal. :data:`SCALE_NONE` is there for the case where the user has already put the features in a common unit and *wants* the big ones to dominate.
records.translation: 그것은 무료가 아니며, 비용은 숨겨진 것보다 말한다 : 동일한 가중치는 40 거의 두 배의 Zernike 순간을 의미하고, 신중하게 선택한 강도 비율을 투표하고, 순수한 소음이있는 특징은 순수 한 신호와 같은 변형 단위를 얻습니다. :data:`SCALE_NONE`는 사용자가 이미 특징을 일반 단위에 넣고 *원하는* 큰 하나를 지배하는 경우에있다.

records.context: ``(len(features), k)`` Pearson r between each feature and each component score. This is what the biplot arrows are: unlike a unit-norm loading, an r is a number with a meaning on its own, and for a standardised PCA the squared row sums are each feature's communality.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult#5
records.source: ``(len(features), k)`` Pearson r between each feature and each component score. This is what the biplot arrows are: unlike a unit-norm loading, an r is a number with a meaning on its own, and for a standardised PCA the squared row sums are each feature's communality.
records.translation: ``(len(features), k)`` Pearson r 각 특징과 각 구성 요소 사이의 점수입니다.이것은 biplot 라우드가 무엇인지입니다 : 단위 표준 충전과는 달리, r는 자신의 의미와 표준화 된 숫자입니다. PCA 쿼드 라인 금액은 각 특징의 공동체입니다.

records.context: ``(feature, share)`` — the feature with the largest ``|loading|`` on component ``k``, and how much of the component's squared loading it carries.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.dominant#0
records.source: ``(feature, share)`` — the feature with the largest ``|loading|`` on component ``k``, and how much of the component's squared loading it carries.
records.translation: ``(feature, share)`` - 가장 큰 특징을 가진 특징 ``|loading|`` 컴포넌트에 대하여 ``k``, 그리고 그것이 운반하는 구성 요소의 평방 부하의 양.

records.context: Near-collinear features leave a numerically full-rank matrix whose last directions are floating-point residue: the solver returns *a* direction because it must, not because the data has one. A component under :data:`DEGENERATE_RATIO` of the total variance is reported with that said, so nobody reads a loading pattern out of rounding error.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.is_degenerate#1
records.source: Near-collinear features leave a numerically full-rank matrix whose last directions are floating-point residue: the solver returns *a* direction because it must, not because the data has one. A component under :data:`DEGENERATE_RATIO` of the total variance is reported with that said, so nobody reads a loading pattern out of rounding error.
records.translation: 근접 콜리네어 특징은 숫자적으로 완전한 순위 매트릭스를 남기고, 그 마지막 방향은 흐르는 지점의 남아있다 : 솔버는 *a* 방향을 반환해야하기 때문에, 데이터가 하나를 가지고 있기 때문에 아닙니다. :data:`DEGENERATE_RATIO` 이하의 구성 요소는 전체 변형에 대해 언급되므로 아무도 회전 오류에서 충전 패턴을 읽지 않습니다.

records.context: Every feature loading with the same sign is the classic "size" factor of morphometrics: one end big objects, the other end small ones. It is real, it is usually PC1, and it is usually a statement about segmentation and focus rather than about biology — so it is detected and said out loud rather than left for the reader to notice.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.is_size_like#1
records.source: Every feature loading with the same sign is the classic "size" factor of morphometrics: one end big objects, the other end small ones. It is real, it is usually PC1, and it is usually a statement about segmentation and focus rather than about biology — so it is detected and said out loud rather than left for the reader to notice.
records.translation: 같은 표지판을 가진 모든 특징은 형식의 고전적인 "size" 요소입니다 : 한쪽 끝은 큰 물체, 다른 한쪽 끝은 작은 물체입니다.그것은 실제입니다, 그것은 일반적으로 PC1이며, 그것은 일반적으로 생물학이 아닌 분할과 초점에 대한 진술입니다 - 그래서 그것은 발견되고 말하는 대신 읽는 사람이 알게되었습니다.

records.context: Two guards prevent false detections. It needs three features, because with two "same sign" is a coin flip. And it needs the loading spread over more than one of them: a component that is a *single* feature trivially agrees with itself about sign, and calling that a size axis would be a statement about arithmetic rather than about the objects.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.is_size_like#2
records.source: Two guards prevent false detections. It needs three features, because with two "same sign" is a coin flip. And it needs the loading spread over more than one of them: a component that is a *single* feature trivially agrees with itself about sign, and calling that a size axis would be a statement about arithmetic rather than about the objects.
records.translation: 그것은 두 개의 "same sign"이 동전 플립이기 때문에 세 가지 특징이 필요합니다.그리고 그것은 그들 중 하나 이상에 대한 충전을 확산해야합니다 : *single* 특징이있는 구성 요소는 신호에 대해 자신과 삼각적으로 동의하고, 크기 좌석이 개체 대신 아리트메틱에 대한 진술이 될 것이라고 부르는 것입니다.

records.context: The whole policy is in the module docstring; the short version is that features are standardised unless told otherwise, NaN is never imputed unless told to, constant columns are dropped by name, collinear ones are kept and reported, and no more components are returned than the data has independent directions.

records.source: The whole policy is in the module docstring; the short version is that features are standardised unless told otherwise, NaN is never imputed unless told to, constant columns are dropped by name, collinear ones are kept and reported, and no more components are returned than the data has independent directions.

records.context: The labels and the microplate sample positions share one grid. records.context: The whole laboratory microplate is always repainted. Signals are blocked so that setting a hundred microplate sample positions says the count once rather than a hundred times, and that also silences the ``toggled -> _paint`` connection -- so a microplate sample position chosen without a click, which includes the picker's own starting value and everything kept across a layout change, would be checked and still drawn empty.

Signals are blocked so that setting a hundred wells says the count once rather than a hundred times, and that also silences the ``toggled -> _paint`` connection -- so a well chosen without a click, which includes the picker's own starting value and everything kept across a layout change, would be checked and still drawn empty.

records.context: Every default in :class:`DesignSpec` is the fitted value for the real *T. gondii* screening experiment this simulator was built against, as recorded in ``proposals/SIM_PORT_PLAN.md`` §1 and §10 and in the port's own docstrings: 452 genes at ~4 guides each, spotted into 4 x 384 microplate sample positions at ~4.6 constructs per microplate sample position, ~123 cells imaged per microplate sample position (var ~8000), a MaxViT machine-learning classification model at 0.80 / 0.12, ~2.5 % of genes true hits, ~3e4 reads per microplate sample position. That makes the screening experiment open on a working example rather than on filler, and it means the first number a user sees is one they can check against a screening experiment that has actually been run.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.power_design#10
records.source: Every default in :class:`DesignSpec` is the fitted value for the real *T. gondii* screen this simulator was built against, as recorded in ``proposals/SIM_PORT_PLAN.md`` §1 and §10 and in the port's own docstrings: 452 genes at ~4 guides each, spotted into 4 x 384 wells at ~4.6 constructs per well, ~123 cells imaged per well (var ~8000), a MaxViT classifier at 0.80 / 0.12, ~2.5 % of genes true hits, ~3e4 reads per well. That makes the screen open on a working example rather than on filler, and it means the first number a user sees is one they can check against a screen that has actually been run.
records.translation: :class:`DesignSpec`의 각 기본 값은 실제 *T. gondii* 스크린 실험에 대한 설정된 값이 시뮬레이터는 ``proposals/SIM_PORT_PLAN.md`` §1 및 §10에 기록된 바와 같이 항구의 자체 도크스트링에 대항하여 구축되었습니다 : ~4 가이드 각각의 452 유전자, ~4.6 건물에 대 한 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에 4 x 384 미생물, ~123 세포에 대하여 묘사 된 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 (var ~8000), 0.80 / 0.12에서 MaxViT 기계 학습 분류 모델, ~2.5 %의 유전자 진정한 히트, ~3e4는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 읽습니다.

records.context: :class:`DesignSpec` — the experiment as a screener describes it (genes, guides, microplate sample positions, laboratory microplates, effect size, prevalence, depth), plus the real-screening experiment values for everything the screener does not want to name.

records.context: A **live view** is a panel that re-renders the module's own output from the current settings, on real input, before a processing session. That is Mask, Timelapse, Measure and Motility, and it is what the **Live** toggle opens. The Image UMAP explorer is not one: it makes an already-computed embedding clickable, and no setting changes what it draws. Its toggle therefore says **Interactive**, not Live — the same word had been on both.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract#59
records.source: A **live view** is a panel that re-renders the module's own output from the current settings, on real input, before a run. That is Mask, Timelapse, Measure and Motility, and it is what the **Live** toggle opens. The Image UMAP explorer is not one: it makes an already-computed embedding clickable, and no setting changes what it draws. Its toggle therefore says **Interactive**, not Live — the same word had been on both.
records.translation: **live view**은 현재 설정에서 모듈의 자체 출력을 실제 입력, 처리 세션 전에 다시 배달하는 패널입니다.이것은 마스크, 타임 랩스, 측정 및 모틸리티이며, 그것은 **Live** toggle이 열리는 것입니다. Image UMAP 탐색기는 하나가 아닙니다 : 그것은 이미 컴퓨팅 된 임베딩을 클릭 할 수있게하고 설정이 무엇을 끌어 들이는지 변경하지 않습니다.그것의 toggle 따라서 **인터랙티브**, 라이브가 아닌 - 동일한 단어가 둘 다있었습니다.

records.context: **Cancel** and **Stop** are also different words. A live view's Cancel throws the pass away: nothing it produced is kept, because a half -segmented field is not a result. A hyperparameter search's Stop (:class:`spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam.HyperparamPanel`) finishes the trial in flight and keeps every trial already scored, marking the result partial. Same button position, deliberately different verbs, because a user who presses one expecting the other loses either nothing or hours.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract#60
records.source: **Cancel** and **Stop** are also different words. A live view's Cancel throws the pass away: nothing it produced is kept, because a half -segmented field is not a result. A hyperparameter search's Stop (:class:`spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam.HyperparamPanel`) finishes the trial in flight and keeps every trial already scored, marking the result partial. Same button position, deliberately different verbs, because a user who presses one expecting the other loses either nothing or hours.
records.translation: **취소** 및 **중지**는 또한 다른 단어입니다. 라이브 보기의 취소는 통과를 던집니다 : 생성 된 것은 아무것도 보존되지 않습니다, 반 분할 된 필드가 결과가 아니기 때문에. 하이퍼 파라미터 검색의 중지 (:class:`spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam.HyperparamPanel`)는 비행에서 테스트를 완료하고 모든 테스트가 이미 점수를 유지하고 결과를 부분적으로 표시합니다.

records.context: :func:`preview_cellpose_model` is the other half of the sharing. ``model_type=`` is accepted and ignored by Cellpose 4, so a preview that passed it silently segmented with ``cpsam`` — including for a user who had just trained their own checkpoint in spaCR's Train Cellpose module. One constructor here means a Cellpose API change needs one fix.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract#63
records.source: :func:`preview_cellpose_model` is the other half of the sharing. ``model_type=`` is accepted and ignored by Cellpose 4, so a preview that passed it silently segmented with ``cpsam`` — including for a user who had just trained their own checkpoint in spaCR's Train Cellpose module. One constructor here means a Cellpose API change needs one fix.
records.translation: :func:`preview_cellpose_model`은 공유의 다른 절반입니다. ``model_type=``은 Cellpose 4에 의해 받아 들여지고 무시되므로 ``cpsam``로 조용히 분할 된 예보를 통과했습니다 - spaCR의 Train Cellpose 모듈에서 자신의 체크 포인트를 훈련 한 사용자를 포함합니다. 여기서 하나의 건축기는 Cellpose API 변경이 하나의 수정이 필요하다는 것을 의미합니다.

records.context: ``model_type=`` is accepted and ignored by Cellpose 4 — it logs "not used in v4.0.1+" and drops it, leaving ``pretrained_model`` at its ``cpsam`` default. Passing the user's choice there therefore segmented with ``cpsam`` whatever they picked, including a checkpoint they had just trained in spaCR's own Train Cellpose module. :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the workflow uses: it maps the legacy pre-SAM names onto ``cpsam`` and says so once, and returns a path unchanged when the name is a fine-tuned checkpoint.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract.preview_cellpose_model#1
records.source: ``model_type=`` is accepted and ignored by Cellpose 4 — it logs "not used in v4.0.1+" and drops it, leaving ``pretrained_model`` at its ``cpsam`` default. Passing the user's choice there therefore segmented with ``cpsam`` whatever they picked, including a checkpoint they had just trained in spaCR's own Train Cellpose module. :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the pipeline uses: it maps the legacy pre-SAM names onto ``cpsam`` and says so once, and returns a path unchanged when the name is a fine-tuned checkpoint.
records.translation: ``model_type=``은 Cellpose 4에 의해 받아 들여지고 무시됩니다 - 그것은 "v4.0.1+에서 사용되지 않음"을 기록하고 그것을 떨어 뜨리며, ``pretrained_model``를 ``cpsam``의 기본으로 남겨 두고 사용자의 선택을 통과하여 그들이 선택한 ``cpsam``로 분할되며, 그들이 spaCR의 자신의 트레인 Cellpose 모듈에서 훈련 한 체크 포인트를 포함합니다. :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained`는 작업 흐름이 사용하는 것입니다 : 그것은 유산 pre-SAM 이름을 ``cpsam``에 지도하고 한 번 말하고 이름이 잘 정해진 체크포인트가 될 때 변경되지 않은 경로를 반환합니다.

records.source: Four modules ship a live preview — Mask, Measure, Timelapse and Motility — and each of them opens exactly one source at a time. This module lets them move to the next field of view or another channel without reopening the file dialog.

records.context: The sample is **random but reproducible**: the seed is a stable digest of ``"<folder name>|<total sets>|<cap>|<nonce>"`` (:func:`sample_seed`), so the same laboratory microplate at the same cap yields the same sets in this session, the next session, and on another machine or mount point — a preview can be described and returned to. It is deliberately *not* seeded from the clock or from ``hash()``, which is salted per process. Re-rendering never re-draws; only an explicit act does — changing the cap (which is in the seed) or calling :func:`~ImageSetSampler.reshuffle` (which bumps the nonce).

records.context: ``distinct_values`` runs one ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501`` per ``(database, table)`` pair the chosen column appears in — and the columns a user actually excludes on (``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``) hold a handful of distinct values across the whole table, so the LIMIT is never reached and SQLite scans every row. Measured on a 200 000-row × 8-table measurements.db with a warm page cache: **196 ms per column**, and the column combo is editable, so ``currentTextChanged`` fires on every keystroke. Eight quick edits froze the window for **894 ms** in one unbroken block; ``set_source`` itself cost 183 ms and a single deliberate column choice 220 ms. With worker execution, the same three are 29 ms, 5 ms and 2 ms.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.row_exclusion#3
records.source: ``distinct_values`` runs one ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501`` per ``(database, table)`` pair the chosen column appears in — and the columns a user actually excludes on (``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``) hold a handful of distinct values across the whole table, so the LIMIT is never reached and SQLite scans every row. Measured on a 200 000-row × 8-table measurements.db with a warm page cache: **196 ms per column**, and the column combo is editable, so ``currentTextChanged`` fires on every keystroke. Eight quick edits froze the window for **894 ms** in one unbroken block; ``set_source`` itself cost 183 ms and a single deliberate column choice 220 ms. Threaded, the same three are 29 ms, 5 ms and 2 ms.
records.translation: ``distinct_values``는 ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501``을 선택한 열이 나타나는 ``(database, table)`` 쌍마다 한 번씩 실행합니다 — 그런데 사용자가 실제로 제외 기준으로 쓰는 열(``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``)은 테이블 전체에서 고유값이 몇 개뿐이므로 LIMIT에 도달하지 않고 SQLite가 모든 행을 스캔합니다. 페이지 캐시가 데워진 200 000행 × 8테이블 measurements.db 파일에서 측정하면 **열당 196 ms**이고, 열 콤보는 편집할 수 있으므로 ``currentTextChanged``가 키 입력마다 발생합니다. 빠른 편집 여덟 번에 창이 끊김 없이 **894 ms** 동안 멈췄고, ``set_source`` 자체는 183 ms, 신중하게 고른 열 하나는 220 ms가 걸렸습니다. 스레드로 처리하면 같은 세 작업이 29 ms, 5 ms, 2 ms입니다.

records.context: Qt aborts the process when an executing QThread is destroyed, and a worker that delivers into a widget on its way out is a use-after-free. ``JobRunner.shutdown`` handles both.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.row_exclusion.RowExclusionEditor.closeEvent#1
records.source: Qt aborts the process when a running QThread is destroyed, and a worker that delivers into a widget on its way out is a use-after-free. ``JobRunner.shutdown`` handles both.
records.translation: Qt 낙태를 시행할 때의 절차 QThread 그것은 파괴되고, 그것의 출구에있는 위젯에 배달하는 워커는 사용 후 무료입니다. ``JobRunner.shutdown`` 둘 다 처리합니다.

records.context: Not the only line of defence, deliberately, because it is not always reached: this editor is a child inside a settings panel, and navigating away from that panel destroys it without any close event. What covers that case is the runner itself — the QThreads are unparented and retire themselves, and ``JobRunner._relay`` catches the ``RuntimeError`` PySide6 raises when a worker settles after its runner's C++ half has gone.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.row_exclusion.RowExclusionEditor.closeEvent#2
records.source: Not the only line of defence, deliberately, because it is not always reached: this editor is a child inside a settings panel, and navigating away from that panel destroys it without any close event. records.translation: 의도적으로 방어의 유일한 라인이 아니기 때문에 그것은 항상 달성되지 않습니다 : 이 편집자는 설정 패널 내부에있는 아이이며, 그 패널에서 멀리 탐색하면 가까운 이벤트없이 파괴됩니다. QThreads 그들은 퇴직하고 자기 자신을 떠나고, ``JobRunner._relay`` 캡처 The ``RuntimeError`` PySide6 워커가 실행자의 C++ 절반이 사라졌을 때 일어난다.

records.context: Timelapse first generates masks for a time series and then links adjacent frames. The costs differ greatly: segmenting twelve frames with Cellpose takes tens of seconds, while relinking *the twelve existing label images* with a new ``timelapse_displacement`` takes milliseconds. The preview separates these stages so a slider change does not rerun segmentation:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview#1
records.source: The Timelapse module is mask generation over a time series followed by frame-to-frame linking. Those two halves cost wildly different amounts: segmenting twelve frames with Cellpose is tens of seconds, re-linking the *same* twelve label images with a new ``timelapse_displacement`` is milliseconds. A preview that re-segments on every slider move is unusable, so this panel splits them:
records.translation: Timelapse는 먼저 시간 시리즈를위한 마스크를 생성하고 그 다음 근처 프레임을 연결합니다. Cellpose 수십 초가 걸리며, 쉬는 동안 *12 개의 기존 레이블 이미지* 새로운 것과 함께 ``timelapse_displacement`` 미리 보기는 이러한 단계를 분리하여 슬라이더 변경은 분할을 망치지 않습니다 :

records.context: Same contract as :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.LivePreviewPanel`, and the same code for the shared half: a standalone ``QWidget``, a ``QThread`` worker that emits results over signals, :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract.LivePreviewContract` for the processing session/cancel/status protocol, :meth:`set_propagate_callback` to push tuned values back into the main settings panel, and a ``build_*_card`` factory.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview.TimelapsePreviewPanel#1
records.source: Same contract as :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.LivePreviewPanel`, and the same code for the shared half: a standalone ``QWidget``, a ``QThread`` worker that emits results over signals, :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract.LivePreviewContract` for the run/cancel/status protocol, :meth:`set_propagate_callback` to push tuned values back into the main settings panel, and a ``build_*_card`` factory.
records.translation: :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.LivePreviewPanel`과 같은 계약, 그리고 공유 절반에 대한 동일한 코드 : 단일 ``QWidget``, 신호를 통해 결과를 발행하는 ``QThread`` 워커, 처리 세션/ 취소/ 상태 프로토콜을위한 :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract.LivePreviewContract`, :meth:`set_propagate_callback` 튜닝 값을 주요 설정 패널으로 다시 밀어 넣고 ``build_*_card`` 공장.

records.context: Raw frames are retained for the movie, so a cache miss reads each frame exactly once and hands that same array to segmentation.  ``cancelled`` is checked between frames and before linking; the production callback reads the worker QThread's interruption flag, which lets lowering the Fields cap stop an expensive sibling before it retains the rest of the sequence.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview.build_movie_field#1
records.source: Raw frames are retained for the movie, so a cache miss reads each frame exactly once and hands that same array to segmentation.  ``cancelled`` is checked between frames and before linking; the production callback reads the worker QThread's interruption flag, which lets lowering the Fields cap stop an expensive sibling before it retains the rest of the sequence.
records.translation: 원료 프레임이 영화를 위해 보존됩니다., 그래서 캐시 미스는 각 프레임을 정확히 한 번 읽고 동일한 범위에서 분할에 손을 잡습니다. ``cancelled``은 프레미드 사이와 연결하기 전에 검사됩니다; 생산 호출은 워커의 QThread 중단 깃발을 읽습니다., 필드 캡을 낮추는 것은 비싼 형제를 막기 전에 나머지 순서를 유지합니다.

records.context: Composition rather than a subclass: the graph spec is a complete, serialisable description of one chart, and a trellis is that chart *and* a layout. Keeping them apart means a trellis can hand its inner spec to the Graph Builder, the data-selection boundary editor or the feature explorer unchanged, and a chart built anywhere can be dropped into a grid without conversion.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.TrellisSpec#1
records.source: Composition rather than a subclass: the graph spec is a complete, serialisable description of one chart, and a trellis is that chart *and* a layout. Keeping them apart means a trellis can hand its inner spec to the Graph Builder, the gate editor or the feature explorer unchanged, and a chart built anywhere can be dropped into a grid without conversion.

records.context: ``spacr.ml.regression_model`` can return a statsmodels ``OLS``, ``WLS``, ``RLM``, ``QuantReg``, a ``GLM`` in any of six families, a ``MixedLM``, a ``BetaModel``, a sklearn ``Lasso``/``Ridge``/``ElasticNet`` or a ``LinearSVC``. Those objects agree on almost nothing: a sklearn ``Lasso`` has no p-values, no covariance matrix and no ``fittedvalues``; a ``MixedLM`` has no hat matrix; a Gaussian model has no calibration curve worth drawing. Every panel therefore either draws or raises :class:`PanelUnavailable` carrying the *reason*, and the reason is printed on the combined report page and returned in the manifest. A panel is never silently omitted, and never faked with a substitute statistic that does not mean what the axis label says.

records.context: spaCR routes ``logit``/``probit`` through GLM-Binomial with a *continuous* fraction response weighted by cell count, so a binomial family does **not** imply binary labels — and ROC/PR are undefined without them. This is the distinction that decides it.

records.translation: ``base`` 및 ``variance``이 레지스트리에서 나오는 곳 - GLM 또는 베타 피트를위한 Pearson 나머지 및 GLM 분산, ``sqrt(w) * (y - fitted)`` 및 WLS의 가중치 오류 변수, 견고한 피트에 대한 ``y - fitted``과 ``scale ** 2``, 그리고 양적 회복 또는 기계 학습 분류 모델에 대해 아무것도 없습니다. 레지스터가 올바른 규모가 없다는 것을보고 할 때, ``std_resid``은 모두 ``NaN``, ``standardisation.reason``은 왜 말하고, 그 이유로 표준화 된 나머지는 스키에 구축 된 6 개의 패널입니다.

records.context: **An imported copy is released before measure appends to its table.** ``measure_crop`` appends, so the moment spaCR measures a microscope field of view into a canonical table an import filled, its rows and theirs sit in the same table with nothing marking the seam and every per-microplate sample position count becomes the sum of two populations. :func:`supersede_imported_copies` executes before the first insert and removes that copy — but only when every microscope field of view it covers is either already measured into that table or queued to be measured now, and only after :func:`spacr.foreign.release_canonical_copy` has proved, row by row, that each row it removes still exists in ``foreign_<object>``. A half-released table is worse than an unreleased one, so anything less than a complete, lossless release is refused and reported instead, together with the two lines that do it by hand.

records.translation: **수입 된 복사본은 측정이 그것의 테이블에 첨부되기 전에 발행됩니다.** ``measure_crop`` 첨가, 그래서 순간 spaCR는 수입 채워진 캐논 테이브에 현미경 시야를 측정하고, 그것의 라인과 그들의 좌석은 같은 테이프에 아무것도 표시하지 않고 각 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 계산은 두 인구의 합이됩니다. :func:`supersede_imported_copies`는 첫 번째 삽입 전에 실행하고 그 복사를 제거합니다 - 그러나 그것을 커버하는 모든 미생물을 이미 측정되었을 때 또는 지금 측정 될 것입니다, 그리고 단지 :func:`spacr.foreign.release_canonical_copy` 후에, 라인에 따라, 그것을 제거하는 각 라인은 여전히 존재한다 ``foreign_<object>``. 절반 풀려난 테이블은 풀려나지 않은 테이브보다 더 나쁘다, 그래서 완전하고 손실없는 풀려나는 것보다 작은 것은 거부되고 대신 두 라인과 함께 손으로 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures microscope fields of view in a process pool. Under ``spawn`` (Windows, macOS, ``SPACR_START_METHOD=spawn``, and Python 3.14 on Linux) a worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry: a filter registered with :func:`~spacr.measure_hooks.register_region_filter_hook` in the parent applies to **nothing at all**, the processing session completes, and every object in the microscope field of view is measured while the user believes only the ROI was. That is a silent scientific error, so this module refuses to rely on inheritance: :func:`enable_roi_filter` writes the ROI to disk and names ``spacr.roi:install`` in :data:`~spacr.measure_hooks.HOOKS_ENV_VAR`, and each worker installs the filter for itself from the environment it inherits. :func:`worker_delivery_status` answers "will this actually reach the workers?" before the processing session rather than after it.

That is a silent scientific error, so this module refuses to rely on inheritance: :func:`enable_roi_filter` writes the ROI to disk and names ``spacr.roi:install`` in :data:`~spacr.measure_hooks.HOOKS_ENV_VAR`, and each worker installs the filter for itself from the environment it inherits. :func:`worker_delivery_status` answers "will this actually reach the workers?" before the run rather than after it.

records.context: **One seed for every random number generator.** :func:`seed_everything` seeds Python, NumPy (legacy global *and* the :class:`~numpy.random.Generator` stream :func:`spacr_rng` hands out), Torch on CPU and every CUDA device, and — through those two — Cellpose, so field shuffling, fold splits and Cellpose initialisation repeat between runs with the same seed. sklearn has no global seed at all; :func:`random_state` is what estimator construction sites pass. What cannot be made deterministic is listed in :attr:`SeedReport.caveats` and in :func:`seed_everything`'s docstring.
records.translation: **One 시드는 각 우연한 번호 생성기.** :func:`seed_everything` 시드 Python, NumPy (유형 글로벌 *and* :class:`~numpy.random.Generator` 스트림 :func:`spacr_rng` 손을 꺼내), CPU 및 각 CUDA 장치에 토크, 그리고 - 이 두 가지를 통해 - Cellpose, 은 이 다, 동일한 시드를 가진 레이스 사이에 Cellpose 이니셔티브를 반복합니다. sklearn은 전 세계적으로 시드를 가지고 있지 않습니다. :func:`random_state`은 추정기 건설 사이트가 통과하는 것입니다. 결정적으로 할 수 없는 것은 :attr:`SeedReport.caveats`과 :func:`seed_everything`의 도크스트링에 나열되어 있습니다.

records.source: Matching is one-to-one and optimal, not greedy. A greedy pass down the IoU matrix is cheaper and gives a different answer when one prediction overlaps two truths: it takes the first pair it sees rather than the assignment that maximises total overlap, so the score depends on label ORDER, which is an implementation detail of whoever wrote the mask. :func:`match_objects` uses ``scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment``, so relabelling either mask cannot change the result.
records.translation: IoU 매트릭스를 통과하는 것은 저렴하고 하나의 예측이 두 가지 진실을 초과 할 때 다른 대답을 제공합니다 : 그것은 전체 초과를 최대화하는 임무가 아닌 첫 번째 쌍을 볼 수 있으므로 점수는 레이블 ORDER에 달려 있습니다. :func:`match_objects` 마스크를 작성 한 사람의 구현 세부 사항입니다 ``scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment``, 그래서 다시 설정 또는 마스크는 결과를 변경할 수 없습니다.

records.context: NOT the area under a precision-recall curve, despite the name. The segmentation literature uses this quantity and calls it AP, and reporting the other thing under the same label is how two papers' numbers stop being comparable. Named explicitly here for that reason.
records.label: spacr.scorecard.Match.average_precision#1
records.source: NOT the area under a precision-recall curve, despite the name. The segmentation literature uses this quantity and calls it AP, and reporting the other thing under the same label is how two papers' numbers stop being comparable. Named explicitly here for that reason.
records.translation: 이름에도 불구하고 정확성 기록 곡선 아래의 영역이 아닙니다. 분할 문학은이 양을 사용하고 AP라고 부르며, 같은 라벨 아래의 다른 것을 보고하는 것은 두 종이의 숫자가 어떻게 비교 될 수 없다는 것입니다.

records.context: A predicted boundary pixel counts as correct when a true boundary pixel lies within ``tolerance`` pixels of it, and vice versa. A tolerance is used because two people labelling the same cell disagree by a pixel or two, so a zero-tolerance boundary score measures the annotator as much as the model.
records.label: spacr.scorecard.boundary_f1#1
records.source: A predicted boundary pixel counts as correct when a true boundary pixel lies within ``tolerance`` pixels of it, and vice versa. A tolerance is used because two people labelling the same cell disagree by a pixel or two, so a zero-tolerance boundary score measures the annotator as much as the model.
records.translation: 예측된 경계 픽셀은 진정한 경계 피크셀이 ``tolerance`` 픽슐 내에 있는 경우에 정확하게 계산되며, 반대로 관용은 동일한 세포를 표시하는 두 명이 픽젤 또는 두 명에 동의하지 않기 때문에 사용됩니다, 따라서 0 관용 경계 점수는 모델만큼 어노테이터를 측정합니다.

records.context: ``count_error`` is ``n_pred - n_truth`` and is signed because its direction distinguishes the failure: a model that finds too many objects is over-segmenting and one that finds too few is merging or missing, and an absolute count error does not show which.
records.label: spacr.scorecard.counts_and_areas#1
records.source: ``count_error`` is ``n_pred - n_truth`` and is signed because its direction distinguishes the failure: a model that finds too many objects is over-segmenting and one that finds too few is merging or missing, and an absolute count error does not show which.
records.translation: ``count_error``은 ``n_pred - n_truth``이며 그것의 방향이 실패를 구별하기 때문에 서명됩니다 : 너무 많은 개체를 발견하는 모델은 과도하게 분할되고 너무 적은 개체가 합병되거나 사라지고 있으며 절대적인 계산 오류는 어느 하나를 보여주지 않습니다.

records.context: ``size outliers`` The fraction of objects whose equivalent diameter falls outside ``median ± seg_qc_outlier_mad * 1.4826 * MAD``. Median and MAD, not mean and standard deviation: five pieces of debris inflate a standard deviation until nothing is an outlier any more, which is the exact case this check exists to catch (``tests/test_seg_qc.py`` contrasts the two). *k* = 5 is deliberately loose — real size distributions are lognormal and heavier tailed than Gaussian, so 3 sigma flags a few percent of a perfectly good field. The flag fires when more than ``seg_qc_outlier_fraction`` (0.15) of objects are out there. Heavy tails, mixed populations and segmentation defects can all trigger it; the flag does not identify which is present. Border objects are excluded from every size statistic, exactly as ``diameter._region_diameters`` excludes them, because a truncated object's area is underestimated.
records.label: spacr.seg_qc#11
records.source: ``size outliers`` The fraction of objects whose equivalent diameter falls outside ``median ± seg_qc_outlier_mad * 1.4826 * MAD``. Median and MAD, not mean and standard deviation: five pieces of debris inflate a standard deviation until nothing is an outlier any more, which is the exact case this check exists to catch (``tests/test_seg_qc.py`` contrasts the two). *k* = 5 is deliberately loose — real size distributions are lognormal and heavier tailed than Gaussian, so 3 sigma flags a few percent of a perfectly good field. The flag fires when more than ``seg_qc_outlier_fraction`` (0.15) of objects are out there. Heavy tails, mixed populations and segmentation defects can all trigger it; the flag does not identify which is present. Border objects are excluded from every size statistic, exactly as ``diameter._region_diameters`` excludes them, because a truncated object's area is underestimated.
records.translation: ``size outliers`` 동등한 직경이 ``median ± seg_qc_outlier_mad * 1.4826 * MAD`` 이외에 떨어지는 물체의 부분. 중간 및 MAD, 의미와 표준 변동이 아닙니다 : 5 조각의 쓰레기는 아무것도 더 이상 외부가 될 때까지 표준 변화에 침투합니다, 이것은 정확한 경우이 체크가 캡처하기 위해 존재합니다 (``tests/test_seg_qc.py``는 두 가지를 대조합니다). *k* = 5은 의도적으로 빈 - 실제 크기의 분배는 가스보다 lognormal이고 더 무겁다, 그래서 3 sigma는 완벽하게 좋은 필드의 몇 퍼센트를 표시합니다. 깃발은 ``seg_qc_outlier_fraction`` (0.15) 이상의 물체가 밖으로 나갈 때 불타고 있습니다. 무거운 꼬리, 혼합 인구 및 분할 결함은 모두 그것을 유발할 수 있습니다; 깃발은 누가 존재하는지 알 수 없습니다. 국경 물체는 ``diameter._region_diameters``이 그들을 배제하는 것과 마찬가지로 모든 크기 통계에서 배제되며, 흔들린 물체의 영역이 과소 평가되기 때문입니다.

records.context: ``empty / near-empty fields`` Zero objects is a failure. Fewer than ``seg_qc_min_objects`` (10) is a warning and suppresses the per-microscope field of view robust statistics, because below ten objects a MAD is not a reliable spread estimate — the same threshold at which diameter.py collapses its confidence two levels. If the *laboratory microplate* median is also below that floor (a low-MOI pathogen channel, say), empty microscope fields of view are demoted to a warning: that is a property of the assay, not of the microscope field of view.
records.label: spacr.seg_qc#12
records.source: ``empty / near-empty fields`` Zero objects is a failure. Fewer than ``seg_qc_min_objects`` (10) is a warning and suppresses the per-field robust statistics, because below ten objects a MAD is not a reliable spread estimate — the same threshold at which diameter.py collapses its confidence two levels. If the *plate* median is also below that floor (a low-MOI pathogen channel, say), empty fields are demoted to a warning: that is a property of the assay, not of the field.
records.translation: ``empty / near-empty fields`` 0 개의 개체는 실패입니다. ``seg_qc_min_objects`` (10)보다 적은 경고이며, 견고한 통계를 억제 하기 때문에, 10 개의 객체 아래에 MAD는 신뢰할 수 있는 확산 추정치가 아닙니다 - 같은 경계에서 diameter.py 그것의 신뢰의 두 수준이 붕괴 합니다. 만약 *실험실 마이크로 플레이트* 미디어는 또한 그 바닥 아래에 있다면 (낮은 MOI 병원체 채널, 말하자면), 빈 마이클로스코프의 시야 필드는 경고로 분해 됩니다 : 그것은 시야의 속성, 아니면 마이크로스 코프 시야.

records.context: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every image data channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full laboratory microplate that is hours. A laboratory microplate whose segmentation collapsed — an image data channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone, but checking them by hand means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files. Mask statistics can highlight suspicious microscope fields of view, but cannot establish their cause or validate biological interpretation.
records.label: spacr.seg_qc#2
records.source: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full plate that is hours. A plate whose segmentation collapsed — a channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone, but checking them by hand means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files. Mask statistics can highlight suspicious fields, but cannot establish their cause or validate biological interpretation.
records.translation: ``measure_crop``은 spaCR에서 비싼 단계입니다 : 그것은 각 마스크를 열고, 각 이미지 데이터 채널에서 각 개체를 자르고, 개체 당 수백 개의 특징을 계산하고 SQLite로 작성합니다. 전체 실험실 마이크로 플레이트는 시간입니다. 분할이 붕괴 된 실험소 마이크 - 이미지 데이터 센터에서, 직경이 두 배 잘못되었고, 스프레이에 융합 된 혼합 롤러 - 정확히 동일한 시간을 소요하고 그 후에 던져야하는 측정 테이블을 생성합니다. 실패는 마스크에서만 분명하지만, 수천 ``.npy`` 파일을 수동으로 검사합니다. 마스크 통계는 의심스러운 미크로스코프 필드를 강조 할 수 있지만, 그들의 유효한 생물학적 해석 원인을 확인할 수 없습니다.
