records.context: **A request** (:class:`ObjectRequest`) is neither: it is one act of routing. "Open exactly these twelve objects, because they are the cells this model called infected and the annotator called uninfected." A filter and a selection are *state* that every view reads; a request is an *event* that travels once, from the view that made it to the view that can show it. It carries the reason with it, because a view showing twelve extracted image regions out of ninety thousand has to be able to say why those twelve — otherwise they read as the whole dataset.
records.label: spacr.selection#11
records.source: **A request** (:class:`ObjectRequest`) is neither: it is one act of routing. "Open exactly these twelve objects, because they are the cells this model called infected and the annotator called uninfected." A filter and a selection are *state* that every view reads; a request is an *event* that travels once, from the view that made it to the view that can show it. It carries the reason with it, because a view showing twelve crops out of ninety thousand has to be able to say why those twelve — otherwise they read as the whole dataset.
records.translation: **A request** (:class:`ObjectRequest`)는 아니 : 그것은 라우팅의 하나의 행위입니다. "이 모델이 감염 된 이름으로 이 12 개의 개체를 정확히 열기 때문에 그들은 세포이며, 어노테이션터가 감염되지 않은 이름으로 불리기 때문입니다." 필터와 선택은 *state* 각 시각이 읽는 것입니다; 요청은 한 번 여행하는 *이벤트*, 그것을 보여줄 수있는 시각으로 만든 시각에서.

records.context: **The object type is part of that identity.** Object tables are one type per table, so without the type a nucleus labelled 1 and a pathogen labelled 1 in the same microscope field of view compose to the *identical* structured-data name. A cell's own children are exactly the objects most likely to collide, which is where object linking is most useful — four objects would open as three extracted image regions, and which one you got would depend on the row order of ``png_list`` (:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` keeps the first). The type now goes into the object component of the structured-data name, exactly as :func:`spacr.schema.object_id` writes it
records.label: spacr.selection#14
records.source: **The object type is part of that identity.** Object tables are one type per table, so without the type a nucleus labelled 1 and a pathogen labelled 1 in the same field compose to the *identical* key. A cell's own children are exactly the objects most likely to collide, which is where object linking is most useful — four objects would open as three crops, and which one you got would depend on the row order of ``png_list`` (:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` keeps the first). The type now goes into the object component of the key, exactly as :func:`spacr.schema.object_id` writes it
records.translation: **이 개체 유형은 그 정체성의 일부입니다.** 개체 테이블은 표 당 하나의 유형입니다, 그래서 유형이없는 동일한 마이크로스코프 시야에서 1을 표시하는 핵과 1을 나타내는 병원체는 *identical* 구조화 된 데이터 이름으로 구성됩니다. 세포의 자녀는 정확히 가장 충돌 할 가능성이있는 개체입니다, 이것은 개체 연결이 가장 유용한 곳입니다 - 4 개의 개체는 3 개의 추출 된 이미지 영역으로 열릴 것이며, 당신이 얻는 하나는 ``png_list``의 순서 순서에 달려있을 것입니다 (:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys`은 첫 번째를 유지합니다). 유형은 이제 구조화된 데이터 이름의 개체 구성 요소로 이동하며, :func:`spacr.schema.object_id`이 그것을 쓰는 것과 마찬가지입니다.

records.context: **A filter** narrows the population everyone is looking at: "microplate sample positions with at least 200 cells, laboratory microplate 3 only". It is declarative, cheap to describe, and survives being written to a settings file.
records.label: spacr.selection#8
records.source: **A filter** narrows the population everyone is looking at: "wells with at least 200 cells, plate 3 only". It is declarative, cheap to describe, and survives being written to a settings file.
records.translation: **필터**는 모든 사람들이보고있는 인구를 단축합니다 : "최소 200 개의 세포, 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 3만이있는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치."그것은 선언적이며, 설명하기 저렴하며 설정 파일에 기록되어 생존합니다.

records.context: Types are matched by specificity, exactly as :meth:`Selection.mask_for` describes: an exact match first, then a structured-data name that states no type, then a typed structured-data name against a row that states none. Trying them in that order is what keeps a request naming both a nucleus 1 and a pathogen 1 opening as two rows rather than one.
records.label: spacr.selection.ObjectRequest.select_from#2
records.source: Types are matched by specificity, exactly as :meth:`Selection.mask_for` describes: an exact match first, then a key that states no type, then a typed key against a row that states none. Trying them in that order is what keeps a request naming both a nucleus 1 and a pathogen 1 opening as two rows rather than one.
records.translation: 유형은 특성에 따라 일치합니다, 정확히 :meth:`Selection.mask_for` 설명 : 먼저 정확한 일치, 그 다음 유형이 없음을 나타내는 구조화 된 데이터 이름, 다음 하나를 나타내지 않는 순서에 대한 구조화된 데이터 이름.이 순서로 그들을 시도하는 것은 핵 1과 병원체 1을 두 줄로 열어주는 요청을 유지하는 것입니다.

records.context: two typed keys match when they agree — a nucleus 1 is not a pathogen 1, which is the collapse this exists to end;
records.label: spacr.selection.Selection.mask_for#3
records.source: two typed keys match when they agree — a nucleus 1 is not a pathogen 1, which is the collapse this exists to end;
records.translation: 두 개의 타입 키가 동의 할 때 일치합니다 - 핵 1은 병원체 1이 아닙니다, 즉 붕괴는 끝내기 위해 존재합니다.

records.context: ``src`` must contain gzip-compressed FASTQ files whose names let spaCR pair R1 and R2 reads.  The run also needs a CSV reference table per barcode, with ``sequence`` and ``name`` columns.  A run that decodes the three barcodes spaCR shipped names them as ``row_csv``, ``column_csv`` and ``grna_csv``, and a run that decodes any other number of barcodes lists them under ``barcode_set`` instead, one entry per barcode.  ``target_sequence`` anchors the barcode window, while ``offset_start``, ``expected_end``, and a regex naming one group per barcode describe its layout.  The shipped regex names ``columnID``, ``grna`` and ``rowID``.  Use ``mode='paired'`` for a quality-weighted R1/R2 consensus or ``mode='single'`` with ``single_direction`` when only one mate should be read.
records.label: spacr.sequencing#4
records.source: ``src`` must contain gzip-compressed FASTQ files whose names let spaCR pair R1 and R2 reads.  The run also needs a CSV reference table per barcode, with ``sequence`` and ``name`` columns.  A run that decodes the three barcodes spaCR shipped names them as ``row_csv``, ``column_csv`` and ``grna_csv``, and a run that decodes any other number of barcodes lists them under ``barcode_set`` instead, one entry per barcode.  ``target_sequence`` anchors the barcode window, while ``offset_start``, ``expected_end``, and a regex naming one group per barcode describe its layout.  The shipped regex names ``columnID``, ``grna`` and ``rowID``.  Use ``mode='paired'`` for a quality-weighted R1/R2 consensus or ``mode='single'`` with ``single_direction`` when only one mate should be read.
records.translation: ``src``에는 gzip 압축 FASTQ 파일이 포함되어 있어야 하며, 그 이름은 spaCR 쌍의 R1과 R2가 읽을 수 있습니다. 실행에는 바코드 당 CSV 참조 테이블이 필요하며, ``sequence`` 및 ``name`` 열이 있습니다. spaCR 바코드를 해독하는 라운드는 ``row_csv``, ``column_csv`` 및 ``grna_csv``로 이름을 지정하고, 다른 바코드 수를 해독 하는 라운드는 대신 ``barcode_set`` 아래에 그들을 나열합니다. ``target_sequence``은 바코드 창을 묶고, ``offset_start``, ``expected_end``와 한 그룹을 바코드로 명칭하는 레지크스는 그 배열을 설명합니다. 배송된 레지크스 이름은 ``columnID``, ``grna`` 및 ``rowID``입니다. ``mode='paired'``을 사용하여 품질 가중치가 높은 R1/R2 합의 또는 ``mode='single'``을 ``single_direction``로 사용하면 단 하나의 동료만 읽을 수 있습니다.

records.context: Turn a folder of pooled-screening experiment FASTQ files into per-microplate sample position sgRNA count tables usable by :func:`spacr.ml.perform_regression`.
records.label: spacr.sequencing.generate_barecode_mapping#0
records.source: Turn a folder of pooled-screen FASTQ files into per-well sgRNA count tables usable by :func:`spacr.ml.perform_regression`.
records.translation: 융합 스크린링 실험 FASTQ 파일의 폴더를 :func:`spacr.ml.perform_regression`로 사용할 수 있는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 sgRNA 계산 테이블로 변환합니다.
records.retired_reason: 2026-10-18: superseded by the direct exact-source retranslation of the API summary paragraph in 2026-10-18-api-summary-retranslation.json; kept verbatim as evidence, not loaded.

records.context: Per sample it writes ``annotated_reads.h5`` (optional), ``unique_combinations.csv`` (the per-microplate sample position gRNA counts) and ``qc.csv``.
records.label: spacr.sequencing.generate_barecode_mapping#3
records.source: Per sample it writes ``annotated_reads.h5`` (optional), ``unique_combinations.csv`` (the per-well gRNA counts) and ``qc.csv``.
records.translation: 샘플에 따라 ``annotated_reads.h5`` (선택), ``unique_combinations.csv`` (마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 gRNA 계산) 및 ``qc.csv``을 입력합니다.

records.context: Loads one or more count CSVs, drops control microplate sample positions, computes per-microplate sample position gRNA fractions, sweeps thresholds to find the value producing the requested unique-count average, and plots both the sweep curve and the resulting per-laboratory microplate heatmap.
records.label: spacr.sequencing.graph_sequencing_stats#1
records.source: Loads one or more count CSVs, drops control wells, computes per-well gRNA fractions, sweeps thresholds to find the value producing the requested unique-count average, and plots both the sweep curve and the resulting per-plate heatmap.
records.translation: 하나 이상의 계산을 충전합니다. CSVs, 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 제어하는 방울, per-microplate 표본 위치를 계산 gRNA 부분, 요청된 단일 계산 평균을 생성하는 값을 찾기 위해 임계값을 굴리고, 굴곡 곡선과 결과적으로 실험실 당 마이크로 플레이트 열지도 모두를 굴립니다.

records.context: The two settings answer different questions. ``target_unique_count`` sets how many gRNAs a microplate sample position should end up with and is answered from the counts; the calibration finds the cut-off at which imaging and sequencing agree and is answered from the control microplate sample positions. The processing session reports both numbers, but the switch is read only in ``ml._perform_regression``, for three reasons.
records.label: spacr.sequencing.graph_sequencing_stats#5
records.source: The two settings answer different questions. ``target_unique_count`` sets how many gRNAs a well should end up with and is answered from the counts; the calibration finds the cut-off at which imaging and sequencing agree and is answered from the control wells. The run reports both numbers, but the switch is read only in ``ml._perform_regression``, for three reasons.
records.translation: 두 개의 설정은 다른 질문에 대답합니다. ``target_unique_count``는 gRNAs 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치가 얼마나 끝나고 계산에서 대답됩니다. 칼리브레이션은 이미지와 순서가 동의하는 절단을 찾고 컨트롤 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에서 대응합니다. 처리 세션은 두 숫자를 보고하지만 스위치는 3 가지 이유로 ``ml._perform_regression``에서만 읽을 수 있습니다.

records.context: First, the calibration needs imaging inputs -- a per-cell machine-learning classification model score, the microplate sample position each cell is in, and the laboratory microplate design naming the pure positive- and negative-control blocks. This function receives only the count tables, so reading the switch here would require undocumented structured-data names or a silent fallback to the counts-based answer when they are absent.
records.label: spacr.sequencing.graph_sequencing_stats#6
records.source: First, the calibration needs imaging inputs -- a per-cell classifier score, the well each cell is in, and the plate design naming the pure positive- and negative-control blocks. This function receives only the count tables, so reading the switch here would require undocumented keys or a silent fallback to the counts-based answer when they are absent.
records.translation: 첫째, 캘리브레이션은 이미지 입력을 필요로합니다 - 세포 당 기계 학습 분류 모델 점수, 각 세포의 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치, 그리고 순수한 긍정적이고 부정적 인 제어 블록을 이름으로 실험실 마이크로플레이트 디자인.이 기능은 계산 테이블 만 수신, 그래서 여기에서 스위치를 읽는 것은 문서화되지 않은 구조 데이터 이름 또는 그들이 없을 때 계산 기반 응답에 조용한 떨어지는 필요가있을 것입니다.

records.context: Reads R1/R2 in ``chunk_size`` blocks, farms them out to :func:`process_chunk` workers, and lets :func:`saver_process` write HDF5 / CSV outputs concurrently.
records.label: spacr.sequencing.paired_read_chunked_processing#1
records.source: Reads R1/R2 in ``chunk_size`` blocks, farms them out to :func:`process_chunk` workers, and lets :func:`saver_process` write HDF5 / CSV outputs concurrently.
records.translation: R1/R2를 ``chunk_size`` 블록으로 읽고, :func:`process_chunk` 워커들에게 그들을 뿌리고 :func:`saver_process`가 HDF5 / CSV 출력을 동시에 작성하도록 허용합니다.

records.context: worker processes; defaults to ``cpu_count() - 3``.
records.label: spacr.sequencing.paired_read_chunked_processing#18
records.source: worker processes; defaults to ``cpu_count() - 3``.
records.translation: 워커 프로세스; ``cpu_count() - 3``로 가정

records.context: 1. *Did the run work?* — reads per microplate sample position and which microplate sample positions are starved, how many reads never mapped, whether the barcode references are distinguishable at all, whether a laboratory microplate row or column is systematically under-read, and how evenly the library is covered. 2. *Where do I cut?* — a gRNA is kept in a microplate sample position when its share of that microplate sample position's reads reaches an abundance threshold. Too low and a microplate sample position collects bleed-through guides it never contained, so no phenotype can be attributed to any one of them; too high and microplate sample positions lose the guides they did contain, and with them the statistical detection sensitivity of the screening experiment.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc#2
records.source: 1. *Did the run work?* — reads per well and which wells are starved, how many reads never mapped, whether the barcode references are distinguishable at all, whether a plate row or column is systematically under-read, and how evenly the library is covered. 2. *Where do I cut?* — a gRNA is kept in a well when its share of that well's reads reaches an abundance threshold. Too low and a well collects bleed-through guides it never contained, so no phenotype can be attributed to any one of them; too high and wells lose the guides they did contain, and with them the statistical power of the screen.
records.translation: 1. *경주가 작업을 했습니까?* - 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에 따라 읽고, 어떤 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치가 배고프고, 얼마나 많은 읽기가 결코 맵화되지 않았는지, 바코드 참조가 전혀 구별될 수 있는지, 실험실 마이크 또는 열이 체계적으로 읽지 않은지, 그리고 도서관이 어떻게 균등하게 덮여 있는지. *어디서 절단할까요?* — a gRNA 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에 보관되면 그 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 리더의 비율이 풍부함의 한계에 도달합니다. 너무 낮고 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치는 그것이 결코 포함되지 않은 혈액을 통해 가이드를 수집, 그래서 어떤 현상 유형은 그들 중 하나에 기인 할 수 없습니다; 너무 높고 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치는 그들이 포함 된 가이드를 잃고, 그들과 함께 스크린 실험의 통계적 인 감지 민감성을 잃습니다.

records.context: False when even keeping every observed gRNA falls short of the target — the library, not the threshold, is the limit, and ``threshold`` is then the most permissive cutoff there is.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.ThresholdChoice#6
records.source: False when even keeping every observed gRNA falls short of the target — the library, not the threshold, is the limit, and ``threshold`` is then the most permissive cutoff there is.
records.translation: False 각각의 관찰을 유지할 때 gRNA 목표가 짧아지면 도서관이 아니라 임계값이 제한이다. ``threshold`` 그렇다면 가장 허용되는 코토프가 있습니다.

records.context: optional restriction of the microplate sample position population, as ``prc`` keys. Excluding starved microplate sample positions here keeps them from biasing the derived threshold: a microplate sample position with nine reads reports one gRNA at any cutoff and pulls the median down.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.WellFractions#3
records.source: optional restriction of the well population, as ``prc`` keys. Excluding starved wells here keeps them from biasing the derived threshold: a well with nine reads reports one gRNA at any cutoff and pulls the median down.
records.translation: ``prc`` 키로 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 인구의 선택적 제한을 제외하고 여기에서 굶주린 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 제외하면 추출 한 경계를 극복하지 못하게합니다 : 9 개의 읽기와 마이크로는 각각 gRNA를 보고하고 중간을 내려 줍니다.

records.context: gRNAs surviving each threshold, as ``[n_wells, n_thresholds]``.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.WellFractions.counts_at#0
records.source: gRNAs surviving each threshold, as ``[n_wells, n_thresholds]``.
records.translation: gRNAs 각각의 임계값을 벗어나고, ``[n_wells, n_thresholds]``.
records.retired_reason: 2026-10-18: superseded by the direct exact-source retranslation of the API summary paragraph in 2026-10-18-api-summary-retranslation.json; kept verbatim as evidence, not loaded.

records.context: The population is fixed — a well that loses its last gRNA stays in the denominator as a zero — and that is what makes the result a non-increasing function of the threshold: every well's count only ever falls, so every order statistic of them only ever falls. Dropping emptied microplate sample positions instead would let the median jump *up* when a sparse well is removed, and a target could then be met at two thresholds far apart with no way to say which was meant.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.WellFractions.statistic_at#1
records.source: The population is fixed — a well that loses its last gRNA stays in the denominator as a zero — and that is what makes the result a non-increasing function of the threshold: every well's count only ever falls, so every order statistic of them only ever falls. Dropping emptied wells instead would let the median jump *up* when a sparse well is removed, and a target could then be met at two thresholds far apart with no way to say which was meant.
records.translation: 인구는 고정되어있다 - 마지막을 잃는 바 gRNA 명칭자에서 0으로 남아있다 - 그리고 그것이 결과를 한계의 증가하지 않는 기능으로 만듭니다 : 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 계산은 단지 언제든지 떨어지므로 각 순서 통계는 언제든지가 떨어지지 않습니다. *위로* 흩어진 덩어리가 제거되면, 목표가 두 개의 임계값에서 멀리 떨어져서 무엇을 의미했는지 말할 수 없을 때.

records.context: Two barcodes of the same length within ``max_distance`` substitutions are a **collision**: one miscalled base moves a read from one microplate sample position (or one guide) to another, and nothing downstream can tell that it happened. Exact duplicates are reported too, at distance 0 — those are fatal rather than risky, and :func:`spacr.sequencing.map_sequences_to_names` refuses to run on them.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.barcode_collisions#1
records.source: Two barcodes of the same length within ``max_distance`` substitutions are a **collision**: one miscalled base moves a read from one well (or one guide) to another, and nothing downstream can tell that it happened. Exact duplicates are reported too, at distance 0 — those are fatal rather than risky, and :func:`spacr.sequencing.map_sequences_to_names` refuses to run on them.
records.translation: 동일한 길이의 두 개의 바코드 내부 ``max_distance`` 교체는 A **충돌**: 하나의 잘못된 기초는 한 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 (또는 하나의 가이드)에서 다른 위치로 읽기를 이동하고, 아무것도 그것이 일어났다는 것을 말할 수 없습니다. :func:`spacr.sequencing.map_sequences_to_names` 그들은 그들 위에서 실행을 거부합니다.

records.context: optional ``prc`` restriction of the microplate sample position population — pass the non-starved microplate sample positions to keep unusable microplate sample positions out of the fit.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.derive_threshold#7
records.source: optional ``prc`` restriction of the well population — pass the non-starved wells to keep unusable wells out of the fit.
records.translation: 옵션 ``prc`` 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치 인구의 제한 - 사용하지 못한 마이크를 모니터 위치를 통과하여 적합하지 않은 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치를 유지합니다.

records.context: A pooled screening experiment is pipetted, and pipetting has geometry: an edge row that dried, a column the multichannel missed. Both show up as a whole row or column of microplate sample positions sitting at a different depth from the rest of the laboratory microplate, and both bias every per-microplate sample position fraction computed inside them.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.position_effects#1
records.source: A pooled screen is pipetted, and pipetting has geometry: an edge row that dried, a column the multichannel missed. Both show up as a whole row or column of wells sitting at a different depth from the rest of the plate, and both bias every per-well fraction computed inside them.
records.translation: 조합 스크린링 실험은 파이페트되고, 파이프팅은 지질을 가지고있다 : 건조한 가장자리 라인, 멀티 채널이 놓친 열. 둘 다 실험실 마이크로 플레이트의 나머지 부분과 다른 깊이에 앉아있는 마이클 또는 샘플 위치의 전체 라인 또는 열으로 나타나며, 둘 다 그 안에 계산 된 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 부분을 비아.

records.context: Evaluate the whole trade-off at each threshold.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.threshold_sweep#0
records.source: Evaluate the whole trade-off at each threshold.
records.translation: 각 임계값에 있는 전체 트레이프를 평가하십시오.
records.retired_reason: 2026-10-18: superseded by the direct exact-source retranslation of the API summary paragraph in 2026-10-18-api-summary-retranslation.json; kept verbatim as evidence, not loaded.

records.context: ``collision_rate`` — share of **all** microplate sample positions over the budget; non-increasing, because each microplate sample position's gRNA count only falls.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.threshold_sweep#10
records.source: ``collision_rate`` — share of **all** wells over the budget; non-increasing, because each well's gRNA count only falls.
records.translation: ``collision_rate`` - 예산 위에 **모든** 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치의 비율; 증가하지 않기 때문에 각 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치의 gRNA 계산은 단지 떨어집니다.

records.context: A set of five barcodes needs five named groups, and the failure this answers is a regex that names four. That used to surface as a bare "no such group" from inside a worker process, several frames from anything a user configured, so the message here names the barcode that has no group and then lists the groups the regex does define.
records.label: spacr.settings.BarcodeSet.resolve_groups#1
records.source: A set of five barcodes needs five named groups, and the failure this answers is a regex that names four. That used to surface as a bare "no such group" from inside a worker process, several frames from anything a user configured, so the message here names the barcode that has no group and then lists the groups the regex does define.
records.translation: 다섯 바코드의 집합은 다섯 명의 이름 그룹이 필요하며, 이 답변의 실패는 네 명을 지정하는 레지크스입니다.그것은 워커 프로세스의 내부에서 빈 "no such group"로 표면하는 데 사용되었으며, 사용자가 구성 한 무언가에서 여러 프레임이 있으므로 여기서 메시지는 그들이 그룹을 가지고 있지 않은 바코드를 지정하고 그 후에 레지가 정의하는 그룹들을 나열합니다.

records.context: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.label: spacr.submodules#2
records.source: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.translation: 4 개의 spaCR 타일은 현재 이 착륙 페이지를 공유하지만 다른 생물학적 질문에 대답합니다. :func:`analyze_plaques` 세그먼트 플레크 이미지 및 플레이트 번호 및 영역을 요약합니다. :func:`analyze_recruitment`은 숙주 시토플라스마와 관련하여 병원체이나 액포 주위에 있는 플루오레스센 마커를 측정한다. :func:`analyze_invasion`은 차별적 인 pre/post-permeabilization을 사용하여 기생충을 숙주 세포 내부에 붙어 있거나 침입 된 것으로 분류합니다. :func:`analyze_replication`은 각 파라시토포로스 바쿠올 내에서 기생충을 계산하고 결과적인 반복-국가 분배를 비교합니다. Cellpose 훈련, 테스트 및 모델 응용 도구도 여기에 살고 있지만, 그들은 4 개의 시험 입력 포인트를 대체하지 않습니다.

records.context: Plaque analysis accepts a folder of TIFF images, or existing masks beneath that folder, plus Cellpose settings and a bundled, catalogue, or local plaque model.  Recruitment starts from a spaCR ``measurements.db`` containing joined cell, nucleus, pathogen, and cytoplasm features; it needs a fluorescence image data channel, object filters, and laboratory microplate metadata that assign cell type, pathogen, and treatment.  Invasion and Replication both need one row per segmented parasite in a measurement table and condition metadata.  Invasion additionally needs the outside- and total-stain image data channels and preferably known control microplate sample positions; Replication needs a defensible ``vacuole_key`` or spatial-linking distance. The Cellpose utilities require paired images and masks for training/testing, or an image folder and model path for inference.
records.label: spacr.submodules#4
records.source: Plaque analysis accepts a folder of TIFF images, or existing masks beneath that folder, plus Cellpose settings and a bundled, catalogue, or local plaque model.  Recruitment starts from a spaCR ``measurements.db`` containing joined cell, nucleus, pathogen, and cytoplasm features; it needs a fluorescence channel, object filters, and plate metadata that assign cell type, pathogen, and treatment.  Invasion and Replication both need one row per segmented parasite in a measurement table and condition metadata.  Invasion additionally needs the outside- and total-stain channels and preferably known control wells; Replication needs a defensible ``vacuole_key`` or spatial-linking distance. The Cellpose utilities require paired images and masks for training/testing, or an image folder and model path for inference.
records.translation: 플레이트 분석은 그 폴더 아래에 TIFF 이미지 또는 기존 마스크의 폴드와 Cellpose 설정을 수락하고 묶여있는, 카탈로그, 또는 지역 플레트 모델을 수락합니다. 고용은 spaCR ``measurements.db``에 의해 시작되며 연결된 세포, 핵, 병원체 및 시토플라스마 특성을 포함합니다. 그것은 fluorescence 이미지 데이터 채널, 개체 필터, 그리고 세포 유형, 병원체, 치료를 부여하는 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 메타 데이터가 필요합니다. 침입과 반응 모두 측정 테이블 및 상태 메타 데이터에 분할 된 기생충 당 하나의 줄이 필요합니다. 침입은 또한 외부 및 전체 염색 이미지 데이터 채널과 선호 알려진 컨트롤 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 필요로합니다. 반응은 방어 가능한 ``vacuole_key`` 또는 공간 연결 거리가 필요합니다. Cellpose 유틸리티는 훈련 / 테스트를 위해 깔끔한 이미지와 마스크, 또는 추론을위한 이미지 폴더 및 모델 경로가 필요합니다.

records.translation: 플레이트의 경우, 계산 또는 영역을 해석하기 전에 마스크를 검사합니다. 취업을 위해, 치료를 비교하기 전에 개체 필터, 조건 명칭 및 per-microplate 샘플 위치 명칭을 확인합니다. 침입, 시야 수준의 한계, 통제 합의, bimodality 및 민감성 깃발의 마이크로스코프 필드를 검사 하기 전에 효율성 테이블을 사용 하 여. 반응, 액포 집합 및 보고 하지 않는 두 부분을 검사 합니다. 두 개의 분배를 비교 하기 전. 위의 특정 기능 링크를 따르기 전에 네 개의 미생물 이미지 필드는 별도의 API 목적지를 얻을 수 있습니다.

records.context: The analysis unit matters.  Invasion is inferred from *absence* of outside stain, so weak staining can only inflate the invaded fraction; thresholds are therefore recorded per field and statistics use microplate sample positions rather than treating parasites from one microplate sample position as independent replicates.  Replication groups by vacuole, not by host cell, because one cell can contain several vacuoles; 3, 5, 6, and 7 parasites remain in an explicit non-power-of-two QC bucket instead of being rounded into a biologically expected class.  Plaque area is calibrated against the microplate sample position scale when available, so comparisons should retain the acquisition metadata that defines that scale.
records.label: spacr.submodules#9
records.source: The analysis unit matters.  Invasion is inferred from *absence* of outside stain, so weak staining can only inflate the invaded fraction; thresholds are therefore recorded per field and statistics use wells rather than treating parasites from one well as independent replicates.  Replication groups by vacuole, not by host cell, because one cell can contain several vacuoles; 3, 5, 6, and 7 parasites remain in an explicit non-power-of-two QC bucket instead of being rounded into a biologically expected class.  Plaque area is calibrated against the well scale when available, so comparisons should retain the acquisition metadata that defines that scale.
records.translation: 분석 단위 문제. 침입은 *외부 염색의 부재*에서 결론, 그래서 약한 염색은 침입 된 부분에만 침투 할 수 있습니다; 경계는 따라서 필드에 따라 기록되고 통계는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 사용하는 대신 독립적 인 복제. 반응 그룹에 의해 액포, 아니에 의해 숙주 세포, 왜냐하면 하나의 세포는 여러 액포를 포함 할 수 있기 때문에; 3, 5, 6, 및 7 액포는 생물학적으로 예상되는 클래스에 둥글지 않고 명백한 무력 두 QC 구멍에 남아있다.

records.translation: 빨간색/녹색 침입 추측은 두 번 염색합니다. permeabilization 전에 항체는 숙주 세포의 여전히 **outside** 기생충에만 도달합니다, 그래서 그들은 이미지 데이터 채널 모두에서 긍정적입니다; 세포는 그 다음에 permeability 및 두 번째 항체가 **all** 기생충을 염색하므로, 그래서 항체에만 긍동적 인 post-permeabilisation 이미지 자료 채널 내부에있다.

records.context: **Statistics use the microplate sample position as the unit of replication.** Parasites within a microplate sample position share a coverslip, an antibody bath and a focal image layer, so they are not independent; the reported test is a Mann-Whitney U on the per-microplate sample position efficiencies. A pooled-parasite chi-squared is reported beside it purely so its inflation is visible. See :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#10
records.source: **Statistics use the well as the unit of replication.** Parasites within a well share a coverslip, an antibody bath and a focal plane, so they are not independent; the reported test is a Mann-Whitney U on the per-well efficiencies. A pooled-parasite chi-squared is reported beside it purely so its inflation is visible. See :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`.
records.translation: **Statistics는 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 복제 단위로 사용합니다.** 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 내에있는 기생충은 커버리프, 항체 욕조 및 포크 이미지 층을 공유하여 독립적이지 않습니다. 보고된 테스트는 per-microplate 샘플 위치 효율성에 대한 Mann-Whitney U입니다. 융합 된 기생충 chi-squared는 분명히 그것 옆에 순전히 그래서 그것의 인플레이션이 눈에 띄게됩니다. 참조 :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`

records.context: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a microplate sample position, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#2
records.source: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a well, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.
records.translation: *Toxoplasma gondii*은 내분비에 의해 복제되며, 어머니 안에서 두 딸이 형성되므로, 기생충 액포는 1, 2, 4, 8 또는 16 개의 전염병을 보유하고 있습니다. 반복 분석의 재현은 따라서 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 통해 **분배**이며, 중간이 아닙니다 : 3.2의 중간은 "everything at 3-ish"를 구별 할 수 없습니다, 이는 생물학적으로 불가능합니다, 2s와 4s의 건강한 혼합에서. 반복을 느리게하는 약물은 8 및 4 덩어리에서 2 및 1으로 무게를 움직이고, 배포만이 그것을 보여줍니다.

records.context: **The counting unit is the vacuole.** Not the parasite, and not the host cell — one host cell routinely carries several vacuoles, so grouping on ``cell_id`` reports their combined count as a single vacuole and produces a plausible but meaningless number. See :func:`_assign_vacuole_ids` for how the vacuole is derived and what each ``vacuole_key`` costs you.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#3
records.source: **The counting unit is the vacuole.** Not the parasite, and not the host cell — one host cell routinely carries several vacuoles, so grouping on ``cell_id`` reports their combined count as a single vacuole and produces a plausible but meaningless number. See :func:`_assign_vacuole_ids` for how the vacuole is derived and what each ``vacuole_key`` costs you.
records.translation: **계산 단위는 vacuole입니다.** 기생충이 아닙니다., 그리고 숙주 셀이 아닙니다. — 한 개의 숙주 세포는 일상적으로 여러 개의 액포를 운반합니다., 그래서 ``cell_id``에 그룹화하는 것은 그들의 결합 계산을 단일 액포로 보고하고 확실한 숫자를 생성합니다. 그러나 의미없는 숫자. :func:`_assign_vacuole_ids`을 참조하여 액포가 어떻게 추출되고 각 ``vacuole_key``이 당신에게 얼마나 비용이 들었는지 확인하십시오.

records.context: Rosettes of 3, 5, 6 or 7 are counted into an explicit ``non_power_of_two`` bucket that is always reported and never folded into a neighbouring bucket. That bucket is the assay's own quality control: a microplate sample position where 30% of vacuoles are off the power-of-two ladder has a segmentation problem, and its replication number should not be trusted.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#4
records.source: Rosettes of 3, 5, 6 or 7 are counted into an explicit ``non_power_of_two`` bucket that is always reported and never folded into a neighbouring bucket. That bucket is the assay's own quality control: a well where 30% of vacuoles are off the power-of-two ladder has a segmentation problem, and its replication number should not be trusted.
records.translation: 3, 5, 6 또는 7의 로세트는 항상 알려져 있고 이웃 바켓에 결코 포장되지 않는 명확한 ``non_power_of_two`` 바켓으로 계산됩니다.이 바켓은 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에서 30 %의 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치가 전력-두 계단에서 떨어져있는 것은 분할 문제를 가지고 있으며 반응 번호는 신뢰할 수 없습니다.

records.context: This is a separate pass rather than a branch inside the segmenter because the two shapes of input differ in what a result row means. One microscope field of view per image gives one row per image; a laboratory microplate gives one row per microplate sample position, and the microplate sample position has to be named or the conditions are pooled into a single meaningless count. Splitting first makes every downstream row a microplate sample position, whichever shape arrived.
records.label: spacr.submodules.split_wells#4
records.source: This is a separate pass rather than a branch inside the segmenter because the two shapes of input differ in what a result row means. One field per image gives one row per image; a plate gives one row per well, and the well has to be named or the conditions are pooled into a single meaningless count. Splitting first makes every downstream row a well, whichever shape arrived.
records.translation: 이것은 세그먼터 내부의 지점이 아닌 별도의 통과이기 때문에 두 가지 형태의 입력은 결과 순서가 의미하는 것에 따라 다릅니다. 이미지 당 현미경 시야 필드는 이미지 당 하나의 순서를 제공합니다; 실험실 마이크로 플레이트는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 한 줄을 제공하고, 마이크록 플레트 샘프 위치는 이름을 지정하거나 조건은 단일 무의미한 계산으로 분할되어야합니다.

records.context: Pooled screens provide guide counts for each microplate sample position, not a guide identity for each cell. This module combines those count constraints with similarity in measurement space. It selects high-confidence anchor cells, propagates their labels over a k-nearest-neighbour graph, and projects the result onto the per-microplate sample position guide fractions reported by sequencing.
records.label: spacr.sudoku#1
records.source: Pooled screens provide guide counts for each well, not a guide identity for each cell. This module combines those count constraints with similarity in measurement space. It selects high-confidence anchor cells, propagates their labels over a k-nearest-neighbour graph, and projects the result onto the per-well guide fractions reported by sequencing.
records.translation: 바닥 화면은 각 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치에 대한 가이드 계산을 제공하고, 각 세포에 대해 가이드 정체성이 아닙니다.이 모듈은 측정 공간의 유사성과 같은 계산 제한을 결합합니다. 그것은 높은 신뢰의 앙커 세포를 선택하고, k-가장 가까운 차트를 통해 그들의 라벨을 확산하고, 결과를 분류에 의해보고 된 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치 가이드 부분에 프로젝트합니다.

records.context: Assignments can therefore borrow evidence for the same perturbation across microplate sample positions while retaining an explicit abstention state. The propagated mass, competing-label evidence, and total anchor reach remain available separately so ambiguous or unsupported calls can be inspected instead of forced.
records.label: spacr.sudoku#2
records.source: Assignments can therefore borrow evidence for the same perturbation across wells while retaining an explicit abstention state. The propagated mass, competing-label evidence, and total anchor reach remain available separately so ambiguous or unsupported calls can be inspected instead of forced.
records.translation: 대출은 따라서 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를 통해 동일한 혼란에 대한 증거를 대출 할 수 있으며, 명백한 퇴보 상태를 유지합니다. 확산 된 질량, 경쟁 레이블 증거 및 전체 앙커 범위는 별도로 사용할 수 있으므로 양심적이거나 지원되지 않은 통화가 강제 대신 검사 될 수 있습니다.

records.context: minimum sequencing fraction for a microplate sample position to contribute anchors. This limits anchor selection to microplate sample positions in which a high-scoring cell is plausibly associated with the guide.
records.label: spacr.sudoku.anchors_for#6
records.source: minimum sequencing fraction for a well to contribute anchors. This limits anchor selection to wells in which a high-scoring cell is plausibly associated with the guide.
records.translation: 마이크로 플레이트 샘플 위치를위한 최소 순서 부분은 앵커를 기여합니다.이것은 높은 색상 세포가 가이드와 확실히 연결되어있는 마이크로플레이트 시료 위치에 대한 앙커 선택을 제한합니다.

records.context: Anchor selection uses the machine-learning classification model score. To avoid circular inference, :func:`sudoku` excludes that score from graph features by default; cell morphology then determines propagation beyond the anchors.

The fork's result is compared with this score; the plan accepts "the plain stitcher is already good enough" as a possible outcome.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_baseline#2
records.source: Step 2 of the timeflows plan is a baseline score. Before a third Cellpose head is written, trained and maintained, every frame is segmented independently, the frames are linked by mask overlap, and the result is scored against the ground truth with the standard Cell Tracking Challenge measures. The fork's result is compared with this score; the plan accepts "the plain stitcher is already good enough" as a possible outcome.
records.translation: 시간 흐름 계획의 단계 2는 기본 점수입니다. 세 번째 Cellpose 헤드가 작성되고, 훈련되고 유지되기 전에, 각 프레임은 독립적으로 분할되며, 프레드는 마스크로 묶여 있으며, 결과는 표준 세포 추적 도전 측정으로 지상 진실에 맞서 점수됩니다. 포크의 결과는이 점수와 비교됩니다.

records.context: Most consecutive frames are nearly still, so drawing pairs uniformly shows the head mostly easy pairs. Each pair's median displacement over diameter falls in one of ``bins`` equal-width bins across the range seen, and a pair's weight is the inverse of its bin's size. Quantile bins are not used because they collapse when most pairs move alike.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.pair_sampling_weights#1
records.source: Most consecutive frames are nearly still, so drawing pairs uniformly shows the head mostly easy pairs. Each pair's median displacement over diameter falls in one of ``bins`` equal-width bins across the range seen, and a pair's weight is the inverse of its bin's size. Quantile bins are not used because they collapse when most pairs move alike.
records.translation: 대부분의 연속 프레임은 확실히 여전히, 그래서 유일하게 그린 커플은 머리가 대부분 쉬운 커플을 보여줍니다. 각 커플의 직경을 넘는 중간 이동은 ``bins`` 평등한 폭의 쌍 중 하나에 떨어지고, 커플 가중치는 그것의 엉덩이 크기의 반대입니다. 양 쌍은 대부분의 커플이 동일하게 움직일 때 그들이 붕괴하기 때문에 사용되지 않습니다.

records.context: The Cell Tracking Challenge publishes tracking ground truth as markers -- a small blob inside each cell, labelled with its track id in every frame -- and full outlines separately (the silver ``ST/SEG`` masks, labelled per frame). Only one-to-one assignments are retained: the object contains exactly one marker ID and that ID overlaps no other segmented object. Unmarked, merged and split assignments are excluded rather than guessed.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.track_masks_from_ctc#1
records.source: The Cell Tracking Challenge publishes tracking ground truth as markers -- a small blob inside each cell, labelled with its track id in every frame -- and full outlines separately (the silver ``ST/SEG`` masks, labelled per frame). Only one-to-one assignments are retained: the object contains exactly one marker ID and that ID overlaps no other segmented object. Unmarked, merged and split assignments are excluded rather than guessed.
records.translation: Cell Tracking Challenge는 표지판으로 지상 진실을 추적하는 것을 발표합니다 - 각 셀 내부에있는 작은 블로브, 각 프레임에 트랙 ID로 표시됩니다 - 그리고 개별적으로 완전한 출처 (프레임 당 표시되는 실버 ``ST/SEG`` 마스크). 단 하나에서 하나의 임무만 유지됩니다 : 개체에는 정확히 하나의 마커 ID가 포함되어 있으며 ID는 다른 분할 된 개체를 초과하지 않습니다.

records.context: The timeflows plan rests on one claim about the training data: an object keeps the same label in every frame it appears in. A time-flow head is trained to point from a pixel of an object in frame ``t`` at that object's centre in frame ``t+1``, and the only thing that says which object in ``t+1`` is the same object is the label. If the annotation recycles a label after its object dies or leaves, the model is trained to point at an unrelated cell, and no later score catches it -- the held-out check scrambles the same wrong labels and agrees with itself.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_qc#2
records.source: The timeflows plan rests on one claim about the training data: an object keeps the same label in every frame it appears in. A time-flow head is trained to point from a pixel of an object in frame ``t`` at that object's centre in frame ``t+1``, and the only thing that says which object in ``t+1`` is the same object is the label. If the annotation recycles a label after its object dies or leaves, the model is trained to point at an unrelated cell, and no later score catches it -- the held-out check scrambles the same wrong labels and agrees with itself.
records.translation: 시간 흐름 계획은 훈련 데이터에 대한 하나의 주장에 의존합니다 : 개체는 그것이 나타나는 각 프레임에서 동일한 라벨을 유지합니다. ``t`` 그 프레임에 있는 그 개체의 중심에 있는 ``t+1``그리고 그것이 무엇을 의미하는지에 대한 유일한 말입니다. ``t+1`` 만약 레이블이 그것의 개체가 죽거나 사라지면 표지를 재활용한다면, 모델은 연결되지 않은 세포를 지적하도록 훈련되며, 나중에 점수가 그것을 잡지 않는다면 - 체크인은 동일한 잘못된 표지를 흔들고 동의한다.

records.context: **k-fold runs keep their folds.** ``folds='per_fold'`` (the default) draws every fold; ``folds='mean'`` draws the fold mean with a ±1 sd band and labels it ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` draws both. A mean curve rendered as if it were a single run hides precisely the fold-to-fold variance k-fold was added to expose — and because folds can stop at different epochs (early stopping), the mean carries an ``n_folds`` column so a tail computed from two of five folds is visible rather than implied.
records.label: spacr.train_compare#11
records.source: **k-fold runs keep their folds.** ``folds='per_fold'`` (the default) draws every fold; ``folds='mean'`` draws the fold mean with a ±1 sd band and labels it ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` draws both. A mean curve rendered as if it were a single run hides precisely the fold-to-fold variance k-fold was added to expose — and because folds can stop at different epochs (early stopping), the mean carries an ``n_folds`` column so a tail computed from two of five folds is visible rather than implied.
records.translation: **K-fold 라운드는 그들의 폴더를 유지합니다.** ``folds='per_fold'`` 그들은 각각의 을 끌어들인다. ``folds='mean'`` ±1 sd 밴드와 함께 폴드 중간을 끌고 그것을 표시합니다. ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` 중간 곡선은 마치 단일 실행이었던 것처럼 정확히 폴드에서 폴드로 변형 k-fold이 노출되도록 추가되었으며 - 그리고 폴드는 다른 에포크에 멈출 수 있기 때문에 (초기 중지), 중간은 ``n_folds`` 열 그래서 두 개의 다섯 개의 폴드에서 계산 된 꼬리가 의도하는 대신 눈에 띄게됩니다.

records.translation: **훈련 기반.** 분류 (CV)는 이미 세 가지를 가지고있다 : ``dataset_mode``는 ``'metadata'``, ``'annotation'`` 또는 ``'measurement'``이며 :mod:`spacr.io`는 ``class_metadata``/``metadata_rules``, ``annotation_columns``/``annotation_values``에 따라 데이터 세트를 구축합니다. 분류 (ML) 두 가지가 있었고, 그들 사이에서 선택 **implicitly**: ``ml.py`` ``annotation_column``가 ``None``인지 물었다. 설정 패널에서 아무것도 그렇게 말하지 않았으므로 어노테이션 열을 채우는 사용자는 실험실 마이크로 플레이트 컨트롤에 대한 훈련을 조용히 중단했습니다.

records.context: The default ingest route, ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files``, collapses z before any array reaches segmentation. With ``z_stack=True`` and ``z_segmentation_mode='volumetric'``, :func:`spacr.io.preprocess_img_data` uses a separate raw TIFF route that keeps z, and ``spacr.measure`` accepts ``(Z, Y, X)`` label volumes. :func:`plan_from_settings` returns ``None`` whenever the 3D settings are off -- which is the default -- so the 2-D path is untouched, and :mod:`spacr.object` raises :class:`ZAxisNotPresentError` rather than projecting when the settings are on but the batch it receives has no z axis.
records.label: spacr.zstack#11
records.source: The default ingest route, ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files``, collapses z before any array reaches segmentation. With ``z_stack=True`` and ``z_segmentation_mode='volumetric'``, :func:`spacr.io.preprocess_img_data` uses a separate raw TIFF route that keeps z, and ``spacr.measure`` accepts ``(Z, Y, X)`` label volumes. :func:`plan_from_settings` returns ``None`` whenever the 3D settings are off -- which is the default -- so the 2-D path is untouched, and :mod:`spacr.object` raises :class:`ZAxisNotPresentError` rather than projecting when the settings are on but the batch it receives has no z axis.
records.translation: 기본적으로 삽입된 경로는 ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files``, 각 경로는 분할에 도달하기 전에 z가 붕괴됩니다. ``z_stack=True``과 ``z_segmentation_mode='volumetric'``에서 :func:`spacr.io.preprocess_img_data`는 Z를 유지하는 별도의 원료 TIFF 경로를 사용하고 ``spacr.measure``는 ``(Z, Y, X)`` 라벨 볼륨을 수락합니다. :func:`plan_from_settings`는 3D 설정이 꺼질 때마다 ``None``를 반환합니다 - 이는 기본입니다 - 그래서 2-D 경로는 터치되지 않으며 :mod:`spacr.object`는 설정을 진행할 때 프로젝트하는 대신 :class:`ZAxisNotPresentError`를 올립니다.

records.context: **Stitching 2-D image layers is not 3-D segmentation.** Both are legitimate and they give different answers. Per-image-layer segmentation followed by IoU linking (:data:`MODE_STITCH`) sees each image layer independently and cannot recover an object that is invisible in one image layer; true volumetric segmentation (:data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC`) uses the z gradient but is far more sensitive to a wrong anisotropy. The mode is therefore explicit, never inferred, and :class:`ZStackResult` records which one actually ran so it can be written next to the numbers it produced.
records.label: spacr.zstack#5
records.source: **Stitching 2-D planes is not 3-D segmentation.** Both are legitimate and they give different answers. Per-plane segmentation followed by IoU linking (:data:`MODE_STITCH`) sees each plane independently and cannot recover an object that is invisible in one plane; true volumetric segmentation (:data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC`) uses the z gradient but is far more sensitive to a wrong anisotropy. The mode is therefore explicit, never inferred, and :class:`ZStackResult` records which one actually ran so it can be written next to the numbers it produced.
records.translation: **Stitching 2D 이미지 레이어는 3D 분할이 아닙니다.** 둘 다 합법적이며 다른 답변을 제공합니다. IoU 링크(:data:`MODE_STITCH`)에 따라 각 이미지 층을 독립적으로 볼 수 있으며 하나의 이미지 레이어에서 보이지 않는 개체를 회복할 수 없습니다. 진정한 볼륨 분할 (:data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC`)은 z 그라디언트를 사용하지만 잘못된 anisotropy에 훨씬 더 민감합니다. 따라서 모드는 명시적이며 결코 결론을 내리지 않으며 실제로 실행한 :class:`ZStackResult` 레코드가 생성된 숫자 옆에 기록될 수 있습니다.

records.context: A z-stack is ``n_z`` times a microscope field of view, and volumetric segmentation transiently needs several copies of it. :func:`estimate_peak_bytes` gives the number for a given microscope field of view; the workflow processes **one microscope field of view at a time** and never holds a laboratory microplate. For a 2048x2048 microscope field of view at 21 image layers in float32 that is ~350 MB for the volume, and ~1.4 GB peak in :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` with resampling at anisotropy 5 (the isotropic copy is ``anisotropy`` times taller). This is why :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` is not the default.
records.label: spacr.zstack#9
records.source: A z-stack is ``n_z`` times a field, and volumetric segmentation transiently needs several copies of it. :func:`estimate_peak_bytes` gives the number for a given field; the pipeline processes **one field at a time** and never holds a plate. For a 2048x2048 field at 21 planes in float32 that is ~350 MB for the volume, and ~1.4 GB peak in :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` with resampling at anisotropy 5 (the isotropic copy is ``anisotropy`` times taller). This is why :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` is not the default.
records.translation: z-stack은 현미경 시야의 ``n_z`` 배이며, 볼륨 분할은 통과적으로 그것의 여러 복사본이 필요합니다. :func:`estimate_peak_bytes`은 특정 마이크로스코프 시야의 숫자를 제공합니다. 작업 흐름은 시간**에서**one 미크로스코프 시야를 처리하고 결코 실험실 마이크로 플레이트를 보유하지 않습니다. 2048x2048 마이크로스코프 필드의 시각은 float32에서 21 개의 이미지 레이어에 ~350 MB의 볼륨이며, :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC`에서 ~1.4 GB의 피크는 anisotropy 5에서 다시 샘플링합니다 (이소트로피 복사본은 ``anisotropy`` 배 더 높습니다). 그래서 :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC`은 기본이 아닙니다.

records.context: Each timepoint goes to :func:`spacr.zstack.segment_3d` with this spec's z settings, so the per-timepoint behaviour is *identical* to a 3-D run and the two cannot drift apart. Segmentation is deliberately per-timepoint and independent: linking is a separate decision made by :func:`track_4d`, and fusing the two is what makes a tracker's mistakes indistinguishable from a segmenter's.
